jobs.description:
Property Maintenance Coordinator (Yardi / AppFolio / Buildium) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (with flexibility for urgent maintenance issues)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Property Maintenance Coordinator to manage the end-to-end maintenance lifecycle across a portfolio of residential properties.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused property operations role. You’ll serve as the central point of coordination between tenants, vendors, property managers, and owners, ensuring maintenance requests are properly documented, prioritized, dispatched, tracked, and resolved.

You’ll be responsible for keeping a high volume of maintenance requests moving while maintaining accurate records in Yardi, AppFolio, Buildium, or similar property management software.

This role is ideal for someone with strong property management or maintenance coordination experience who is highly organized, responsive, and known for following through until every issue is fully resolved.

What You’ll Own

Maintenance Request Intake & Triage

  • Handle approximately 10–20 maintenance requests per day through phone, email, and tenant portals.
  • Log complete and accurate maintenance requests in Yardi, AppFolio, Buildium, or similar systems.
  • Assess urgency and prioritize requests appropriately.
  • Identify emergency issues requiring immediate escalation or dispatch.
  • Communicate expected next steps clearly to tenants.
  • Maintain fast response times across incoming requests.

Urgent issues may include:

  • Plumbing leaks
  • HVAC failures
  • Electrical problems
  • Safety concerns
  • Other time-sensitive property issues

Work Order Management

Own maintenance work orders from initial request through confirmed completion.

You’ll:

  • Create, assign, and track work orders.
  • Document repair scope, property information, and tenant details.
  • Monitor tickets through open, scheduled, in-progress, and completed stages.
  • Follow up consistently with vendors on outstanding work.
  • Escalate delayed or unresolved maintenance issues.
  • Maintain accurate notes and supporting documentation.
  • Confirm completion with tenants before closing tickets.
  • Ensure maintenance requests remain within established SLA timelines.

Vendor Coordination & Dispatch

  • Schedule and dispatch vendors for repairs, maintenance, and inspections.
  • Match vendors to jobs based on availability, expertise, location, and urgency.
  • Coordinate access and scheduling between tenants and vendors.
  • Verify vendor licensing and insurance requirements where applicable.
  • Monitor repair progress and follow up on delays.
  • Hold vendors accountable for timelines and service quality.
  • Review invoices against completed work before routing them for approval.
  • Maintain organized vendor records and communication histories.

Tenant Communication & Customer Service

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for maintenance-related communication.
  • Acknowledge maintenance requests promptly.
  • Provide scheduling and repair updates.
  • Communicate vendor delays or appointment changes.
  • Handle frustrated tenants calmly and professionally.
  • Follow up after repairs.
  • Confirm tenant satisfaction and issue resolution.
  • Ensure tenants remain informed throughout the maintenance lifecycle.

Preventive Maintenance Coordination

Coordinate recurring preventive maintenance programs such as:

  • HVAC servicing
  • Pest control
  • Safety inspections
  • Landscaping
  • Routine property inspections
  • Other scheduled property maintenance

Maintain preventive maintenance calendars and service records to ensure recurring work is completed on schedule and reduce avoidable emergency repairs.

Property Management Software & Documentation

Maintain accurate and current records inside platforms such as:

  • Yardi
  • AppFolio
  • Buildium

Ensure maintenance records include:

  • Tenant request details
  • Work order status
  • Vendor assignments
  • Communication notes
  • Repair updates
  • Invoices
  • Completion documentation

Keep all maintenance records organized, accurate, accessible, and audit-ready.

Compliance & Safety Documentation

Maintain documentation related to:

  • Work orders
  • Vendor licensing
  • Insurance requirements
  • Invoices
  • Property inspections
  • Maintenance history

Support compliance with applicable:

  • Local building codes
  • Property safety requirements
  • OSHA-related requirements where applicable
  • Internal property management procedures

Escalate potential safety or compliance concerns promptly.

Reporting & Operational Visibility

Prepare regular maintenance reporting for property managers, owners, and leadership.

Track:

  • Open work orders
  • Aging maintenance requests
  • Resolution times
  • Maintenance costs
  • Vendor performance
  • Recurring property issues
  • Preventive maintenance completion

Identify recurring maintenance problems and opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 2+ years of experience in property management, maintenance coordination, property operations, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one property management platform:
    • Yardi
    • AppFolio
    • Buildium
  • Experience creating and managing maintenance work orders.
  • Experience coordinating and scheduling vendors or contractors.
  • Understanding of maintenance request triage and prioritization.
  • Experience reviewing invoices and service documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • High attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace.
  • Ability to work remotely during U.S. business hours.
  • Ability to manage multiple active maintenance requests simultaneously.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting portfolios of 100+ residential units.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based property management companies.
  • Working knowledge of:
    • HVAC systems
    • Plumbing
    • Electrical systems
    • General residential maintenance
  • Experience managing preventive maintenance programs.
  • Familiarity with vendor licensing, insurance, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience tracking maintenance SLAs and operational KPIs.
  • Exposure to building codes and property safety requirements.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Follow up until issues are actually resolved.
  • Can manage multiple moving work orders without losing track of details.
  • Understand how to prioritize urgent maintenance situations.
  • Communicate professionally with both tenants and contractors.
  • Stay calm and decisive during emergency repairs.
  • Hold vendors accountable while maintaining productive relationships.
  • Keep property management systems accurate and organized.
  • Proactively identify problems before they escalate.
  • Balance tenant experience, cost awareness, operational efficiency, and property protection.
  • Take ownership instead of waiting to be reminded about outstanding tasks.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing and prioritizing new maintenance requests.
  • Checking outstanding and aging work orders.
  • Creating and updating tickets in Yardi, AppFolio, or Buildium.
  • Dispatching vendors and coordinating tenant access.
  • Following up on repairs currently in progress.
  • Communicating status updates to tenants.
  • Escalating urgent or delayed maintenance issues.
  • Reviewing completed work and vendor invoices.
  • Confirming repairs with tenants before closing tickets.
  • Scheduling preventive maintenance.
  • Updating maintenance reports and documentation.

In short: you keep maintenance operations moving from request to resolution while ensuring tenants, vendors, and property teams stay informed and accountable.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Emergency maintenance response within established SLA targets.
  • Standard maintenance requests resolved within established SLA targets.
  • Work order resolution time.
  • Tenant satisfaction.
  • Vendor response and completion rates.
  • Work order documentation accuracy.
  • Invoice accuracy.
  • Preventive maintenance completion rate.
  • Reduction in overdue maintenance requests.
  • Zero avoidable safety or compliance issues.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Full ownership of the maintenance coordination lifecycle.
  • Direct impact on tenant satisfaction and property performance.
  • Hands-on exposure to modern property management systems.
  • Opportunity to manage residential property operations at scale.
  • Strong experience across vendor management, tenant communication, and maintenance operations.
  • Fully remote environment supporting U.S.-based operations.
  • Growth opportunities into Senior Maintenance Coordinator, Assistant Property Manager, Property Operations Manager, Property Manager, or Portfolio Manager roles.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Practical Assessment – Maintenance Coordination / Work Order Scenario
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have experience with property maintenance coordination, work order management, vendor dispatch, and Yardi, AppFolio, or Buildium, we’d love to hear from you.

This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, responsive, and persistent and knows how to keep tenants informed, vendors accountable, and maintenance requests moving through completion.

Job Title: Executive Director, Frontier AI

Job Location: New York, New York, United States|Los Angeles, California, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas – Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease – we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions.

As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Executive Director, Frontier AI

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role as the Executive Director, Frontier AI you will be responsible for frontier AI strategy and the roadmap aligned to Amgen’s business, scientific, and technology priorities. You will also deliver scalable frontier AI capabilities that enable measurable impact across priority use cases.

Responsibilities:

  • Portfolio prioritization and investment recommendations across reinforcement learning, multi-modal AI, model architectures, academic partnerships, and quantum AI/ML.

  • Effective governance of frontier AI activities, including responsible AI, privacy, regulatory, and model-risk considerations, in partnership with CDT for frontier AI security, adversarial resilience, model assurance, and high-risk deployment governance

  • External partnership outcomes, including research collaborations, talent pipelines, publications, prototypes, and applied innovation opportunities.

  • Executive-level visibility into frontier AI performance, including KPIs, adoption, risks, return on investment, and strategic dependencies.

  • Development and retention of top AI talent, including a strong leadership bench and culture of technical excellence.

  • Cross-functional alignment with AI & Data Science, Technology, Security, R&D, Operations, Commercial, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Security stakeholders.

  • Define and lead Amgen’s Frontier AI strategy across foundation models, multi-modal AI, advanced model architecture, academic partnerships, and quantum AI/ML.

  • Build and maintain an enterprise roadmap that translates emerging AI research into scalable, high-value capabilities for R&D, Operations, Commercial, and corporate functions.

  • Lead the development and application of frontier AI capabilities, including foundation models, multi-modal systems, simulation-based learning, and reinforcement learning approaches.

  • Identify and prioritize high-impact use cases where frontier AI can improve scientific discovery, decision-making, productivity, and operational performance.

  • Partner with AI platform, data engineering, architecture, product, domain teams, and CDT to ensure frontier AI solutions are designed for scale, reliability, security, resilience, and operational governance

  • Establish technical standards for model architecture evaluation, experimentation, benchmarking, model validation, and production readiness.

  • Develop Amgen’s academic and external research partnership strategy, including collaborations with leading universities, research labs, vendors, and scientific AI organizations.

  • Evaluate emerging opportunities in quantum AI/ML and quantum-enabled optimization, identifying practical applications aligned to Amgen’s scientific and business priorities.

  • Oversee proof-of-concept, pilot, and production pathways for frontier AI solutions, ensuring appropriate governance, documentation, monitoring, lifecycle management, and joint review processes with CDT for high-risk and security-sensitive deployments

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing frontier AI organization, including leaders and technical experts across reinforcement learning, multi-modal AI, model architecture, and quantum AI/ML.

  • Communicate frontier AI strategy, progress, risks, investment needs, and outcomes to senior leaders and executive stakeholders.

  • Partner closely with CDT for adversarial testing, operational resilience requirements, and security assurance for high-risk AI capabilities

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidate we seek is an experienced leader with the following qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree & 6 years of frontier AI experience OR

  • Master’s degree & 10 years of frontier AI experience OR

  • Bachelor’s degree & 12 years of frontier AI experience AND

  • 6 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Define and lead Amgen’s Frontier AI strategy across foundation models, multi-modal AI, advanced model architecture, academic partnerships, and quantum AI/ML.

  • Build and maintain an enterprise roadmap that translates emerging AI research into scalable, high-value capabilities for R&D, Operations, Commercial, and corporate functions.

  • Lead the development and application of frontier AI capabilities, including foundation models, multi-modal systems, simulation-based learning, and reinforcement learning approaches.

  • Identify and prioritize high-impact use cases where frontier AI can improve scientific discovery, decision-making, productivity, and operational performance.

  • Partner with AI platform, data engineering, architecture, product, domain teams, and CDT to ensure frontier AI solutions are designed for scale, reliability, security, resilience, and operational governance

  • Establish technical standards for model architecture evaluation, experimentation, benchmarking, model validation, and production readiness.

  • Develop Amgen’s academic and external research partnership strategy, including collaborations with leading universities, research labs, vendors, and scientific AI organizations.

  • Evaluate emerging opportunities in quantum AI/ML and quantum-enabled optimization, identifying practical applications aligned to Amgen’s scientific and business priorities.

  • Oversee proof-of-concept, pilot, and production pathways for frontier AI solutions, ensuring appropriate governance, documentation, monitoring, lifecycle management, and joint review processes with CDT for high-risk and security-sensitive deployments

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing frontier AI organization, including leaders and technical experts across reinforcement learning, multi-modal AI, model architecture, and quantum AI/ML.

  • Communicate frontier AI strategy, progress, risks, investment needs, and outcomes to senior leaders and executive stakeholders.

  • Partner closely with CDT for adversarial testing, operational resilience requirements, and security assurance for high-risk AI capabilities

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:

  • Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive

  • Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection

  • Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders

  • Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is $303,534 - $410,664. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Complaints Champion

If you love digging into operational processes, understanding where things might have gone wrong and then putting them right, working across several teams and upholding exceptional service levels, then you could be just right for a Complaints Champion role.

The role

Your mission will be to uphold great service levels for our customers and ensure iwoca is learning from the complaints we receive.

You’ll achieve this by:

  • Investigating customer complaints, ensuring they are dealt with in a timely manner

    • Listening to customer calls

    • Reviewing operations agent’s notes

    • Understanding company wide processes

    • Liaising with other teams / stakeholders in the business

  • Writing complaint responses, ensuring they include findings from the investigation, but also align with our tone of voice

  • Feeding back to operational teams if a mistake has happened and; where necessary, suggesting improvements and changes to current processes

  • Preparing case files for, and liaising with, the Financial Ombudsman Service (“FOS”)

The requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Ideally you'll have:

  • A real curiosity to thoroughly investigate each complaint to find the root cause

  • Excellent communication skills, for dealing with customers (some of whom may be frustrated, angry, vulnerable) as well as a diverse group of internal stakeholders (including Operations team leads, product managers, and senior execs)

  • Excellent writing skills, for being able to craft clear, professional responses to our customers

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

  • A genuine interest in exploring and adopting AI technologies. You should be adept at utilising these tools to tackle challenges, boost efficiency, and enhance the calibre of your output, while applying sound discretion and clearly articulating your rationale for their application.

  • Previous experience working within a complaints role with a proven ability to investigate and respond to complex complaints

  • Previous experience in preparing business files for complaints which have been escalated to the Financial Ombudsman Service (“FOS”)

  • A good understanding of the FCA’s DISP rules

  • Experience working within a financial services firm

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

The salary

We expect to pay from £30,000 - £45,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

jobs.description:
What we do:
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

Who we are:
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

The Role:

Halcyon is looking for a highly experienced Senior Deal Desk Lead to build and operate a disciplined, scalable approach to commercial deal evaluation and approval.

The Senior Deal Desk Lead will serve as a strategic partner to Sales and cross-functional stakeholders, helping ensure deals are structured thoughtfully, evaluated consistently, and routed through the appropriate approval levels based on established criteria.

This role is not simply focused on processing approvals. The Senior Deal Desk Lead will help educate teams on how to construct strong deals, understand the commercial implications of proposed terms, and navigate established deal parameters with greater confidence and consistency.

The Senior Deal Desk Lead will analyze complex and non-standard transactions across pricing, discounting, contract structure, payment terms, product and service considerations, renewal implications, and other commercial elements. They will provide clear recommendations, identify potential risks and trade-offs, and ensure decision-makers have the context necessary to make informed approvals.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment, analytical rigor, operational discipline, and the ability to influence and educate teams across the organization. They should be able to balance speed and flexibility with the need to protect long-term customer and company value.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of coordination for the evaluation of complex and non-standard commercial deals.
  • Analyze proposed deal structures against established commercial criteria, policies, and approval levels.
  • Provide clear, data-informed recommendations on deal exceptions, including the financial, commercial, operational, and long-term implications of proposed terms.
  • Ensure deals requiring exceptions are routed to the appropriate decision-makers based on established levels of authority.
  • Partner closely with Sales to help structure deals that address customer requirements while supporting Halcyon’s commercial objectives.
  • Educate sellers, managers, and other stakeholders on deal criteria, approval requirements, pricing principles, and commercial best practices.
  • Help teams understand the rationale behind commercial policies and approval decisions so that deal quality improves at the point of creation.
  • Evaluate the complete economics and structure of a transaction, including pricing, discounting, contract duration, payment terms, product mix, services, concessions, renewal considerations, and other relevant factors.
  • Identify financial, operational, contractual, and precedent risks associated with proposed deal structures.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Sales leadership, and other stakeholders to ensure proposed deals are aligned and executable.
  • Provide approvers with concise, objective analysis of exceptions, including the business rationale, risks, trade-offs, alternatives, and recommended path forward.
  • Apply established deal criteria consistently while exercising sound business judgment when circumstances require additional consideration.
  • Maintain clear documentation of deal reviews, recommendations, approvals, and exceptions.
  • Identify recurring deal patterns and exception trends that may indicate opportunities to improve commercial policies, pricing, packaging, processes, or field enablement.
  • Use insights from deal activity to improve the quality and consistency of commercial decision-making across the organization.
  • Help simplify and improve the deal review experience by identifying opportunities to reduce unnecessary friction and increase speed for deals that fall within established parameters.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and business systems teams to improve the tools, workflows, and data required to support efficient deal evaluation and approval.
  • Support the continued evolution of Halcyon’s commercial practices as the company, customer base, product portfolio, and go-to-market strategy scale.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Finance, or a similar role within a high-growth SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS and enterprise software deal structures, including pricing, discounting, contract terms, payment structures, renewals, and commercial concessions.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating complex transactions and providing recommendations to sales and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong financial and analytical skills with the ability to assess the complete economics of a deal and understand the implications of different commercial structures.
  • Experience working within structured approval frameworks and applying defined levels of authority to commercial decisions.
  • Strong commercial judgment with the ability to balance customer requirements, revenue objectives, risk, and long-term company value.
  • Ability to identify and clearly articulate financial, operational, contractual, and precedent implications associated with deal decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to educate and influence teams, helping stakeholders understand both commercial guardrails and the rationale behind them.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to develop alternative deal structures when an initial proposal does not meet established criteria.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex deal considerations clearly and concisely to senior decision-makers.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with experience partnering across Sales, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and executive leadership.
  • High attention to detail and a consistent, disciplined approach to commercial decision-making.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple time-sensitive transactions and competing priorities.
  • Experience with CRM, CPQ, contract lifecycle management, and related revenue technology platforms preferred.

Benefits:

Halcyon offers the following benefits to eligible employees:

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with premiums paid in full for employees and dependents.
  • Short and long-term disability coverage, basic life and AD&D insurance plans.
  • Medical and dependent care FSA options.
  • 401k plan with a generous employer contribution.
  • Flexible PTO policy.
  • Parental leave.
  • Generous equity offerings.

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.

The expected base salary range for this position is $175,000 - $215,000. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but are not limited to) role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible to participate in our bonus or commission plans, as well as our benefits offers, and equity awards.

In accordance with applicable state and federal laws, the range provided is Halcyon’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. Base pay is one part of the total package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and equity in the Company.

We understand it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, passionate, curious, and creative people to develop the exceptional product we are building. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Guest Recognition Manager
jobs.excerpt: Orlando Informer is reshaping what’s possible in theme-park hospitality.
jobs.description:
Orlando Informer is reshaping what’s possible in theme-park hospitality. We create distinctive experiences and lifelong memories for families from around the world. We’re looking for an exceptionally thoughtful hospitality professional to lead how we recognize, understand, and celebrate our guests.

Founded in 2011, Orlando Informer is a theme-park vacation-planning company that helps millions of people each year plan better visits to Orlando’s biggest destinations. Since 2015, our signature private events, the Orlando Informer Meetup, have given thousands of guests after-hours access and unique experiences at their favorite theme parks. Orlando Informer is also an authorized retailer of theme-park tickets and hotel stays.

About the role

The Guest Recognition Manager will own Orlando Informer’s guest-recognition program, establishing the strategy, standards, and practices that allow us to create deeply personal and memorable experiences.

You’ll learn what matters to our guests, recognize meaningful occasions and relationships, and turn thoughtful ideas into moments that make people feel genuinely known. You’ll look beyond traditional customer service to find opportunities for emotional connection, transforming birthdays, anniversaries, first visits, family traditions, and even ordinary moments into lasting memories.

This role requires curiosity, creativity, discretion, and exceptional emotional intelligence. You should naturally notice the details others miss, enjoy learning people’s stories, and feel energized by bringing thoughtful ideas to life. You’ll balance imagination with strong organization, sound judgment, budget stewardship, and disciplined execution.

You’ll also build relationships through proactive outreach. By learning what prospective and returning guests hope to experience, you’ll recommend relevant Orlando Informer Meetup dates, tickets, and hotel options. These conversations should feel like a natural extension of our hospitality: personal, helpful, and centered on the guest.

Orlando Informer is a small, nimble, remote-first company, so you’ll collaborate across the business and have meaningful ownership of how we establish a new standard for guest recognition in the theme-park industry.

What you’ll do

Own the guest-recognition program

  • Establish and continually refine Orlando Informer’s guest-recognition strategy, standards, and practices.
  • Develop a thoughtful, consistent approach to recognizing returning guests, important milestones, and meaningful occasions.
  • Build processes for identifying recognition opportunities and sharing relevant guest insights across teams.
  • Create scalable ways to deliver personalized hospitality as our community grows.
  • Establish appropriate guidelines for guest recognition, spending, privacy, documentation, and follow-up.
  • Define measures of success and evaluate the program’s effect on guest sentiment, loyalty, referrals, and repeat engagement.
  • Share program performance, guest insights, and recommendations with leadership.
  • Stay informed about developments in hospitality and guest-experience design, bringing relevant ideas to Orlando Informer.

Create personalized guest experiences

  • Build meaningful relationships with guests before, during, and after their Orlando Informer experiences.
  • Learn about guests’ preferences, interests, celebrations, traditions, and reasons for visiting.
  • Design and execute personalized moments that make guests feel individually known and valued.
  • Develop creative surprise-and-delight experiences, from small gestures to more elaborate moments.
  • Welcome and support returning guests and those celebrating special occasions.
  • Provide attentive, discreet service while respecting guest privacy and personal boundaries.
  • Recognize when a service concern presents an opportunity to restore trust and create a positive, lasting memory.
  • Ensure that every gesture feels personal and sincere rather than scripted or transactional.

Manage planning, partnerships, and execution

  • Own and responsibly manage an annual guest-recognition budget.
  • Determine how program funds should be allocated to create the greatest impact for guests.
  • Track spending, forecast needs, evaluate results, and keep initiatives within budget.
  • Identify, evaluate, and coordinate with partners to bring personalized experiences to life.
  • Negotiate pricing and service arrangements when appropriate.
  • Manage the details, timing, and execution of multiple guest-recognition initiatives simultaneously.
  • Maintain accurate guest preferences, interaction notes, and recognition histories.
  • Prepare guest-recognition plans and arrival information for Orlando Informer Meetup weekends.
  • Be present during OI Meetup weekends to welcome guests, oversee recognition efforts, and respond to opportunities in real time.

Collaborate across Orlando Informer

  • Partner with Guest Experience, Marketing & Sales, Engineering, and leadership to create cohesive guest experiences.
  • Equip team members to recognize opportunities and deliver thoughtful, personalized hospitality.
  • Help train seasonal employees on Orlando Informer’s guest-recognition philosophy, standards, and practices.
  • Share guest-recognition insights and best practices across the company.
  • Identify trends in guest feedback and use them to improve our experiences, products, and processes.
  • Recommend improvements to the systems and tools used to support guest recognition.
  • Serve as an internal advocate for the guest, ensuring their perspective informs relevant decisions.

Build guest relationships

  • Proactively connect with prospective and returning guests to learn about their vacation plans and what they hope to experience.
  • Recommend relevant Orlando Informer Meetup dates, theme-park admission products, and hotel options based on each guest’s needs.
  • Follow up thoughtfully with guests who have expressed interest in Orlando Informer offerings.
  • Build relationships that encourage repeat visits, referrals, and deeper engagement with Orlando Informer.
  • Contribute to outreach and sales goals while ensuring every interaction remains personal, helpful, and hospitality-led.

Requirements

What you’ll bring

  • Four or more years of experience in luxury hospitality, guest relations, concierge services, customer experience, or another high-touch service environment.
  • Experience owning a guest-facing program, initiative, or area of responsibility.
  • Experience managing budgets, vendors, projects, or complex experience details.
  • A genuine fascination with people and a natural ability to make them feel comfortable, understood, and appreciated.
  • Exceptional emotional intelligence, empathy, discretion, and interpersonal judgment.
  • The creativity to imagine memorable experiences and the organizational ability to execute them successfully.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong project-management skills and close attention to detail.
  • The ability to exercise independent judgment and make thoughtful decisions with limited direction.
  • The ability to manage multiple guest experiences, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
  • Confidence initiating conversations and building relationships with prospective and returning guests.
  • A consultative approach to recommending products that begins with listening and understanding.
  • Comfort handling personal guest information responsibly and confidentially.
  • The ability to remain composed, resourceful, and gracious when plans change.
  • A deep knowledge of and passion for Central Florida’s theme parks.
  • A high school diploma or GED. A degree in hospitality, event management, communications, marketing, or a related field is preferred.

Availability requirements

  • This is a remote position, but Florida residency is required.
  • Occasional evening work (15-20 nights per year) may be necessary based on business needs.
  • Full, in-person availability is required during Orlando Informer Meetup weekends.
  • All-day availability is required for our currently announced 2026 OI Meetup dates: November 13–14; December 3–5, 10–12, and 16–18.

Benefits

  • $62,000–$72,000 annually
  • Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
  • In addition to 10 paid holidays, all full-time employees are eligible for our unlimited paid time off policy
  • 6% company-matched 401(k) plan
  • Orlando theme-park access
  • During the interview process, ask us about ways we have rewarded our team in the past.

Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.

What We Need

We are hiring a Director of Product Marketing to identify, package, and take to market the differentiated story that sets NetBrain apart in the emerging Agentic NetOps market. This role translates a deep, technically formidable product into a differentiated story and target use cases that economic buyers reach for, and that sellers can deliver consistently. You will partner with the VP / Head of Solutions Marketing, Product, Sales, and Engineering leadership to define how NetBrain is positioned, packaged, and brought to market across use cases and buyer types.

What You'll Do

Competitive Differentiation & Positioning. NetBrain competes in a crowded network automation and observability market that is evolving quickly. This role's first charter is to spotlight NetBrain's true differentiation, package it into a value architecture that maps to executive outcomes (CIOs, VPs of Infrastructure, and the operators they lead), and take that story to market without losing credibility with technical practitioners. Develop the messaging frameworks Sales, Marketing, and Field SE teams reach for, and keep the differentiated narrative coherent across releases, use cases, and market shifts. Stay close to the competitive landscape so the story is sharpened against real alternatives, not built in a vacuum; battlecards and field competitive enablement sit elsewhere on the team, but the differentiation you lead is what needs to win.

Agentic NetOps Narrative. Lead the product-side narrative for how NetBrain shows up in the emerging Agentic NetOps category, how we apply AI, how customers interact with our agents, and what the value architecture of an agentic platform looks like for infrastructure teams. Develop the message track that connects agentic capability to measurable operational value, fewer outages, faster mean time to resolution, reduced toil, for both economic and technical audiences. Partner with Analyst Relations to land that narrative with the analyst community.

Use Case Discovery & Go-to-Market. Once the differentiated story is set, identify the net-new, high-value use cases inside NetBrain’s product capabilities, together with Product, Sales, and the field, that deserve their own go-to-market treatment rather than living as a buried feature. Build the business case for why a use case is worth taking to market, then lead the motion that gets it there: naming, positioning, proof points, packaging implications, enablement, and launch sequencing. Treat use-case discovery as a repeatable discipline, not a one-time exercise, so NetBrain continually finds new paths to revenue inside capability it has already built.

Marketecture and Launch. Partner with Solutions Marketing, Product, and Engineering to refine the NetBrain product marketecture, the structure, naming, and packaging of how the product portfolio is presented to the market. Lead the launch motion that brings the resulting structure to market: launch messaging, enablement assets, launch sequencing across Sales, Marketing, and Field, and the cross-functional alignment that makes a launch land.

Sales Tools. Lead the sales toolkit that lets Sales and Solutions Engineering sell NetBrain confidently at every stage of the deal—the core pitch deck, discovery and qualification guides, ROI and business-case tools, and objection-handling material. Partner with GTM Enablement to set the enablement roadmap, identify what needs to exist and when, and deliver the flagship assets—directing the Sr. Product Marketing Manager on solution-specific assets—so the toolkit stays current as positioning, use cases, and the competitive landscape shift.

Voice of Market. Build a strong, ongoing relationship with Product Management so Solutions Marketing has a standing voice in roadmap conversations, not a reaction to decisions already made. Bring one unified Solutions Marketing point of view into that relationship, weaving in what the team is learning through pricing and ICP work, competitive intelligence, and the customer-voice program, so Product hears a coherent perspective rather than a stream of disconnected inputs. Use the relationship to keep positioning and the roadmap honest with each other as both evolve, surfacing early where they're converging or drifting apart.

You Might Be a Fit If

  • You have 8+ years in Product Marketing, with at least 4 years leading platform or multi-product positioning in B2B enterprise software
  • You have found and articulated genuine competitive differentiation in a crowded market—not just cataloged features—and packaged it into a story that changes how buyers evaluate the category, not just how they evaluate your product
  • You have launched and positioned a product portfolio—not just a single feature—and can show the narrative architecture you built to connect capability clusters to outcomes
  • You have found and brought a new, non-obvious use case to market inside an existing product—defining it, building the business case, and leading the launch, rather than only marketing what Product handed you already-named
  • You have led a product marketecture redesign or significant repackaging effort, and can talk through what changed and why it landed
  • You translate deeply technical capability into a value story economic buyers act on, without losing the credibility you need with technical practitioners
  • You have marketed to both technical buyers (engineers, IT operations) and business buyers (CIOs, VPs of Infrastructure)
  • You think in narrative architectures, not slide-by-slide assets—you build the story once and let it cascade
  • You are competitively aware—you read the market, factor it into positioning, and work cleanly with the teammates who lead field competitive enablement
  • You have built a trusted, ongoing relationship with Product Management and used it to bring a unified go-to-market point of view into roadmap planning—not just relayed isolated customer requests
  • You have built or led the core sales enablement toolkit for a B2B software team—pitch decks, discovery guides, ROI tools—not just contributed to it
  • You have managed, mentored, or closely partnered with more junior marketers, and are ready to build out the function as this team grows
  • You are analytically rigorous about what is and is not landing, and iterate on positioning with evidence, not opinion
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and a function being built around you
  • You are low ego and high ownership, and drive alignment across Product, Sales, and Marketing without positional authority
  • Manual Dexterity: Repetitive motion of wrists, hands and fingers for using a computer.
  • Stationary Tasks: Sitting for extended periods, remaining in a stationary position.

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing platforms with AI, agentic, or automation capabilities
  • Background in network management, observability, infrastructure automation, or adjacent technical infrastructure markets
  • Experience leading a major product launch or marketecture re-launch
  • Familiarity with the analyst landscape around network automation and observability
  • Bachelor's degree; MBA helpful but not required

What We Offer

Our comprehensive compensation package is vital in how we recognize our people for the impact they make on us reaching our goals as a company.

For this role, the estimated base is $190,000 - $200,000 + Bonus. The actual salary may vary based on a range of factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

The range listed above is a guideline and may be modified. People Experience offers a comprehensive benefits package in addition to cash compensation that includes but is not limited to 401k and medical/dental coverage. Speak with your Recruiter for more details on our Total Rewards philosophy.

Van woordjes leren en opdrachten maken tot chatten met tutoren en deelnemen aan groepslessen: wij bieden een complete toolset om scholieren te helpen slagen.

🎮 Wat ga je doen?

  • Geeft bijles aan leerlingen (individueel of in kleine groepen)

  • Legt complexe stof helder en stapsgewijs uit

  • Helpt leerlingen niet alleen met antwoorden, maar met inzicht en denkstappen

  • Beantwoordt inhoudelijke vragen via de chat

  • Houd het forum mee in de gaten, naast AI-moderatie

  • Waarborgt de kwaliteit van uitleg en begeleiding op het platform

🌟Goed om te weten:

Bijles geven vormt een groot onderdeel van de functie. Tutoring bij StudyGo is in ontwikkeling en beweegt mee met nieuwe vormen van begeleiding. Er wordt getest met 1-op-1 coachinglessen, met meer focus op leren leren in plaats van alleen kennisoverdracht. Dit vraagt flexibiliteit en dat je je prettig voelt in een rol die blijft veranderen.

Requirements

🔥 Wat verwachten we van jou

  • Student WO (wiskunde/biologie/aardrijkskunde/Frans)

  • Uitstekende schriftelijke en mondelinge beheersing van het Nederlands

  • Vertrouwd met wiskunde/biologie/aardrijkskunde of bereid dit te leren

  • Aantoonbaar vermogen om complexe concepten eenvoudig uit te leggen en aan te passen op verschillende niveaus

  • Verklaring omtrent gedrag (deze zullen wij voor je aanvragen)

  • Een veilige en betrouwbare werkplek, het werk is volledig remote

  • Pré: Ervaring met moderatie van online communities of forums

💰Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een bruto salaris tussen de €650 per maand (voor 10 uur per week) - €780 per maand (voor 12 uur per week)

  • 24 vakantiedagen (op basis van een fulltime dienstverband);

  • Collectief pensioen en collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Onbeperkt toegang tot externe coaches via Inuka Coaching

  • Onbeperkt toegang tot Goodhabitz voor professionele en persoonlijke groei

  • Squla en StudyGo accounts voor het leven

  • Mogelijkheid om een organisatie van jouw keuze te ondersteunen via Payroll Giving

Bij Futurewhiz gebruiken we AI om ons werk slimmer en efficiënter te maken. AI helpt ons onze visie "Shape the future of personalised learning for the next generation" te realiseren. We verwachten dat iedereen, ongeacht functie, AI inzet om zijn of haar werk zo goed mogelijk te doen.

😻 Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn een gepassioneerd en divers team, samengebracht door een gedeelde missie: kinderen helpen om te groeien in hun leerproces en hen te versterken met gepersonaliseerd onderwijs.

Onze cultuur is open en authentiek – we geloven dat je het beste werk levert als je jezelf kunt zijn. Of je nu van boekenclubs, maandelijkse borrels, filmavonden, bakwedstrijden, Mario Kart-competities of skireizen houdt, bij Futurewhiz vind je een gemeenschap die als thuis voelt.

Onze platforms zijn voor iedereen, en dat geldt ook voor onze werkplek.

De kracht zit in onze verschillende achtergronden, ideeën, ervaringen en perspectieven. Deze diversiteit helpt ons om alle kinderen te ondersteunen in hun leerproces, ongeacht wie zij – of wij – zijn. Bij Futurewhiz omarmen we elkaars verschillen en creëren we een authentieke werkomgeving waarin iedereen zichzelf kan zijn. Zo maken we het ook makkelijker voor anderen om dat te doen. We zijn toegewijd aan een diverse en inclusieve cultuur, die begint op ons kantoor en zich uitstrekt over al onze platforms – en iedereen is welkom op deze reis.

Word jij onze nieuwe collega?

We nodigen je graag uit om te solliciteren, ook als je niet aan alle vereisten voldoet maar wel enthousiast bent.

Tip: wees vooral jezelf. We omarmen de diversiteit van al onze collega’s en zijn oprecht benieuwd naar jouw unieke perspectief.

Visa sponsorship voor deze rol is niet van toepassing. Alleen kandidaten met een geldige werkvergunning voor Nederland/EU komen in aanmerking voor deze functie.

Upload je motivatie en cv via de sollicitatieknop. We nemen dan zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

When you work as a Director, Key Accounts at KCAS Bio, you get to further our mission by partnering with our key customers to help them understand and utilize our bioanalytical and biomarker services and next generation therapy capabilities. You will be responsible for developing and growing strategic relationships within an assigned portfolio of key accounts, expanding the breadth of business across those organizations, and achieving assigned booking and revenue growth targets.

As part of the KCAS Bio commercial team, you will work closely with Directors of Business Development, Inside Sales, Scientific Advisors, Program Management, Marketing, and Operations to develop and execute coordinated account strategies. While our Business Development team focuses heavily on territory development and new customer acquisition, this role will focus on building deeper, broader, and more strategic relationships within KCAS's key accounts and identifying opportunities to expand those partnerships.

This is a fully remote position and can be based anywhere in the contiguous United States.

  • Lead and support negotiations for potential business opportunities consistent with KCAS's long-term commercial strategy
  • Develop a strong understanding of KCAS's capabilities across LC-MS/MS, ligand binding assays, flow cytometry, and molecular platforms to effectively connect client needs with the appropriate KCAS solutions
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the bioanalytical market, competitive landscape, and emerging scientific and industry trends to identify opportunities for future growth
  • Maintain accurate account, contact, opportunity, and pipeline information within Salesforce and other applicable CRM systems
  • Provide regular account updates, forecasts, risks, and growth opportunities to Sales leadership and other internal stakeholders
  • Collaborate with Marketing to develop and execute account-based marketing strategies and campaigns
  • Attend key industry conferences, client meetings, and events to strengthen relationships and identify new business opportunities
  • Partner with Program Management and Operations to support the overall client experience and ensure continuity across the commercial and operational relationship

  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing strategic account plans within complex client organizations
  • Proven ability to expand existing client relationships by identifying new stakeholders, sites, programs, and service opportunities
  • Demonstrated ability to develop relationships with senior-level and C-suite decision makers
  • Proven ability to navigate and close complex, technical service opportunities
  • Strong understanding of the CRO sales cycle, including opportunity development, proposals, pricing, negotiation, and contracting
  • Outstanding interpersonal, relationship-building, communication, and presentation skills
  • Strong persuasion, negotiation, and objection-handling skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Business Development, Scientific Advisors, Operations, Program Management, Marketing, and other internal partners
  • Strong organizational and strategic planning skills with the ability to manage multiple complex accounts and opportunities simultaneously
  • Experience utilizing CRM systems such as Salesforce to manage account activity, opportunity pipelines, forecasting, and business data
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

You will thrive at KCAS if you enjoy a relational environment, are purpose- and values-driven, embrace constant development and supportive leadership, and enjoy being part of innovative work.

Our benefits include, and extend beyond, the traditional package. At KCAS, you will enjoy company sponsored events like food trucks, family days and spirit days. The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a motivated Outbound Sales Manager (m/f/d) to join our new direct sales team. This role is instrumental in helping small businesses thrive by driving the full sales cycle – from lead qualification to closing deals – and shaping the processes of a foundational team.

The team

The Outbound Sales team is a foundational part of our growth strategy in Germany. As a newly established team, it operates with an entrepreneurial spirit, giving you the freedom to shape the processes and culture that will drive future success. The team works in a fast-paced, collaborative environment to connect German small businesses with the funding they need.

The role

This role offers the chance to be a foundational member of a new team, with the possibility to shape its success.

Impact and Autonomy:

  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of leads, taking full ownership of the sales cycle from initial contact to a closed deal.

  • Identify and qualify prospects, using your judgment to determine which businesses have a genuine need for finance.

  • Shape the team’s sales strategy by sharing best practices and insights to improve collective success.

Growth and Development:

  • Master the iwoca value proposition and learn to communicate complex financial products in a simple, compelling way.

  • Develop your pipeline management and closing skills in a supportive environment with a focus on continuous feedback and improvement.

  • Exceed your KPIs to drive sales growth, with uncapped commission to reward your performance.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

  • At least two years of experience in a sales role, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets.

  • Comfort and proficiency in making a high volume of outbound cold calls.

  • Fluency in German (C1 level) and in English.

  • A highly motivated, target-driven mindset.

Bonus:

  • Experience selling a product or service to small businesses.

  • Experience managing a sales pipeline using a CRM system (Hubspot).

  • A talent for explaining complex products in a simple, understandable way.

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

The salary

  • We expect to pay from €57.000 - €65.000 OTE (€42,000 - €50,000 base salary + bonus, uncapped) for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

  • To ensure your success from day one, for the first three months you receive 2/3 of your on-target commission.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a brilliant place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • A smart, motivated and international team (we represent over 35 different nationalities) with ridiculous growth-mindset.

  • 26 days of vacation a year plus a free day for your birthday.

  • One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years.

  • Mental health support with direct access to certified psychologists via our partner OpenUp.

  • iwoca takes over a ski chalet in winter so that you and your team can ski or snowboard (and work) for a week. During summer we are drawn to the sun. We’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

  • Access to the gym membership program, €25 for either Fit711 or Urban Sports Club.

  • €30 contribution towards the Deutschlandticket.

  • Company Pension with Canada Life.

  • Great office locations. In Frankfurt in the middle of the city, our Berlin office is located in Prenzlauer Berg.

  • A paid volunteer day that gives you the opportunity to invest time to support a charity of your choice.

  • Corporate Benefits discounts.

  • ’iwocans’ also benefit from fully stocked fridges in our offices with whatever is needed to strengthen them. There are snacks (both healthy and less healthy) for the whole day.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone, including a book budget.

  • Learning German budget.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Twilio is seeking an Onboarding Operations Specialist (L1) to join our global Onboarding and Compliance team. In this role, you will work directly with customers and internal teams to support Toll-Free Verification onboarding, ensuring adherence to carrier and regulatory requirements.

This entry-level role focuses on guiding customers through verification, assessing business legitimacy, and identifying risks to ensure a secure and compliant onboarding process. You will also contribute to improving operational workflows and upholding industry standards.

The Onboarding and Compliance team plays a vital role in maintaining trust and reliability in Twilio’s ecosystem by safeguarding against fraudulent activity and streamlining the onboarding experience.   • Review verification submissions for compliance, conduct KYC checks, verify brand legitimacy, and analyze digital footprints to prevent fraud.
  • Perform QA on AI-generated decisions and agent-resolved submissions to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with verification standards.
  • Analyze verification processes and appeals to detect patterns, optimize workflows, and mitigate risks.
  • Handle escalations for complex verification cases, working with internal teams to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to streamline onboarding, improve compliance enforcement, and align on best practices.
  • Maintain process documentation, contribute to best practices, and support team efficiency.

  • Wear the Customer’s Shoes – Provide prompt, high-quality support via email, Slack, and ServiceNow.
  • Draw the Owl – Investigate verification issues, assess inefficiencies, and develop solutions to improve workflows.
  • Ruthlessly Prioritize – Manage high-volume inquiries, meet SLAs, and effectively balance multiple priorities.
  • Be Bold – Stay informed on compliance and industry changes, proactively refining workflows and compliance strategies.
  • Be an Owner – Monitor onboarding progress, troubleshoot verification issues, and guide internal teams & customers to ensure a seamless experience.

If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, demonstrating strong time management, self-discipline, and communication skills.
  • Availability to work Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CT or 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CT
  • 1-2 years of experience in an operations and customer facing role, with exposure to cross-functional collaboration.
  • Strong ability to prioritize tasks, manage workloads efficiently, and meet SLAs.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong attention to detail in document review and risk assessment.
  • A customer-centric mindset, with a commitment to delivering high-quality support and ensuring a seamless experience.
  • Problem-solving mindset, with the ability to assess situations, think critically, and make sound decisions.
  • Quick adaptability to new systems, workflows, and evolving business needs.
  • A collaborative team mindset, with the ability to work both independently and cross-functionally.
  • Self-motivated, receptive to feedback, and committed to continuous improvement.
  • Willingness to take on new challenges and grow with evolving business needs

Desired:

  • Familiarity with Google Workspace and Microsoft 365
  • Experience with ServiceNow, Zendesk, Slack, or similar platforms used for workflow and team collaboration.
  • Experience conducting KYC checks, verifying brand legitimacy, and analyzing digital footprints with strong attention to compliance details.
  • Quality assurance expertise in process review, improvement, and compliance with best practices and code of conduct.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, multi-task effectively, and handle responsibilities within defined SLAs.
  • Experience in project coordination, ensuring smooth task execution, and managing multiple priorities efficiently.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Colombia.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We are looking for an Product Managerto join our Productteam. The Product Manager is responsible for driving the success of the product by overseeing the entire project management process, from ideation to execution. They lead the development and implementation of features and initiatives aimed at enhancing the user experience and achieving business goals. The Product Manager maintains a prioritized product backlog, defines key product problems, sets measurable success metrics, and monitors progress throughout the product life cycle. They also leverage data-driven insights to break down complex challenges into actionable projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams such as design, engineering, and data science to deliver impactful solutions. The Product Manager ensures alignment across teams, articulating the needs of stakeholders to drive the development of optimal product solutions. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

  • Project Management
    • Lead the ideation and execution of features and initiatives that drive user engagement and product outcomes.
    • Develop and maintain a prioritized product backlog that aligns with business and user goals and strategy.
    • Own the product life cycle, from defining key product problems to identifying key performance indicators (KPIs) and monitoring results of experiments and product enhancements.
    • Use quantitative and qualitative data to break down complex challenges and systems into actionable projects and solutions.
  • Product Management
    • Analyze web analytics, consumer feedback, and data to identify potential product enhancements.
    • Work closely with engineers to guarantee product functionality and performance.
    • Compile progress reports and deliver presentations to stakeholders on project updates.
    • Generate innovative product concepts aligned with current and projected market trends.

    • Understand and articulate user needs and pain points, working with designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and drive effective solutions.
    • Collaborate with the Director, Product Management and stakeholders to align products with strategic visions.
    • Coordinate with the marketing team to incorporate new features into marketing materials.
    • Performs other related duties as assigned.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field is required.
  • 4+ years of experience in product management or similar product role.
  • 4+ years experience using product management tools such as JIRA, Trello, Asana, or similar project management software.

  • Understanding of software development processes and methodologies like Agile, Scrum, or Kanban is preferred.

Benefits

  • Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $130,000 - $180,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

MoonTech is an AI-first, agentic workflow company transforming influencer performance marketing through autonomous AI agents.
