Position Title

Business Banking Specialist

Location

Work From Home MI, MI 48098

Job Summary

The Business Banking Specialist is a critical client-facing role within Flagstar's Business Banking division, responsible for client onboarding, ongoing servicing, and operational support for business clients within the $10M–$50M annual revenue segment. This role operates within a collaborative pod structure alongside a Business Development Officer (BDO) and Relationship Manager (RM), ensuring clients receive a seamless, high-quality banking experience from day one.
The BBS serves as the operational backbone of the pod—coordinating across internal teams to deliver exceptional service, resolve client needs efficiently, and support the overall health and growth of the portfolio.

Job Responsibilities:

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Onboarding & Account Setup

  • Lead the end-to-end client onboarding process for newly acquired business banking relationships
  • Coordinate account opening documentation, KYC/BSA requirements, and system setup across internal departments
  • Ensure a smooth transition from the Business Development Officer/Relationship Manager to active client status
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for new clients during the onboarding period, setting expectations and providing guidance on available products and services
  • Conduct onboarding calls and welcome communications to establish a strong initial client experience

Ongoing Client Servicing & Support

  • Serve as the day-to-day operational contact for assigned business banking clients, resolving inquiries and service requests with urgency and professionalism
  • Manage routine client needs including account maintenance, online banking support, and product inquiries
  • Proactively communicate with clients regarding account updates, product enhancements, and service changes
  • Identify and escalate complex client issues to the BDO/RM or appropriate internal teams for resolution
  • Monitor client satisfaction and flag potential attrition risks to the pod team

Documentation & Compliance Coordination

  • Prepare, collect, and review required documentation for account openings, credit facilities, and ongoing compliance requirements
  • Ensure all client files and records are maintained in accordance with bank policies and regulatory standards
  • Support annual review processes by gathering financial statements, insurance certificates, and other required documentation
  • Coordinate with Credit Administration, Legal, and Operations teams to ensure timely processing of client requests

Cross-Functional Coordination & Pod Support

  • Operate as an integral member of the Business Banking pod (BDO + RM + BBS), ensuring coordinated client coverage and communication
  • Support the Business Development Officer and Relationship Manager with research, preparation of client materials, and meeting coordination
  • Collaborate with internal product partners including Treasury Management, Payments, and Operations to deliver solutions and resolve issues
  • Maintain accurate client records, notes, and activity logs within the CRM platform
  • Assist with pipeline tracking and reporting as needed

Referral Identification & Portfolio Growth Support

  • Identify opportunities to deepen client relationships through additional products and services
  • Generate qualified referrals to the Relationship Manager, Treasury Management, Wealth Management, and other internal partners
  • Support client retention efforts by ensuring high service quality and proactive outreach
  • Assist with client event coordination and communication campaigns

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Adhere to all bank policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements in the execution of client servicing activities
  • Demonstrate sound judgment in identifying and escalating potential risks, including fraud, compliance concerns, and operational issues
  • Participate in required compliance training and maintain up-to-date knowledge of applicable regulations
  • Support the bank's Enterprise Risk Management framework through diligent documentation and process adherence
  • Uses independent judgement and discretion to make decisions
  • Analyzes and resolves problems

ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.
  • Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance training. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Required Qualifications:

  • Education level required: High School / High School Equivalency (GED, HiSET, TASC) / Foreign Equivalent
  • Minimum experience required: 4+ Years of experience in banking, financial services, or a client-facing support role
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality service in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency with banking systems, CRM platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and follow-through skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Education level preferred: Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) in business, finance or some other related field
  • Experience in business banking, commercial banking operations, or client servicing
  • Knowledge of business banking products including deposits, lending, treasury management, and payments
  • Experience with client onboarding processes, KYC/BSA documentation, and account administration
  • Familiarity with commercial loan documentation and credit support functions
  • Experience working within a team-based or pod coverage model
  • Proven ability to identify cross-sell opportunities and generate internal referrals

Job Competencies:

  • Client Service Excellence: Commitment to delivering a differentiated, responsive, and proactive client experience
  • Operational Acumen: Strong understanding of banking operations, account administration, and documentation requirements
  • Communication: Clear, professional communication with clients, partners, and internal teams—both written and verbal
  • Organization & Time Management: Ability to manage multiple client requests, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously
  • Attention to Detail: Accuracy in documentation, data entry, and compliance-related tasks
  • Collaboration: Effective teamwork within the pod structure and across functional departments
  • Problem Solving: Ability to identify issues, research solutions, and resolve client concerns efficiently
  • Risk Awareness: Sound judgment in identifying and escalating potential risks and compliance concerns
  • Demonstrates a strong ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders by communicating clearly, engaging in proactive collaboration, and leveraging cross functional insights. Aligns relationship building efforts with enterprise goals to accelerate performance and drive strategic results.
  • Builds trusted client relationships, whether internal or external, by identifying needs and delivering tailored solutions to enhance the overall client experience.
  • Fosters or supports a positive work culture and productive work environment, displaying importance of effective relationships with customers and stakeholders.
  • Some travel may be required for periodic team collaboration sessions and client-facing activities.
  • Physical demands (ADA): No unusual physical exertion is involved.

jobs.description:
About Us and Why We’re Hiring

At Terra Energy, we're committed to making clean energy more accessible by delivering high-quality residential solar solutions. As our business continues to grow, we're looking for an Interconnection Specialist to play a key role in ensuring our projects move efficiently through the utility approval process. This position is essential to keeping installations on track by coordinating interconnection applications, maintaining compliance, and collaborating with customers, utilities, and internal teams throughout the project lifecycle.

If you're highly organized, detail-oriented, and enjoy managing multiple priorities while working with cross-functional teams, we'd love to hear from you. This is an excellent opportunity to join a fast-paced, mission-driven company where your work will directly contribute to delivering renewable energy solutions and creating a seamless experience for our customers.

The Role

As an Interconnection Specialist, you will be responsible for managing the interconnection process for residential solar and energy storage projects from application submission through Permission to Operate (PTO). You'll work closely with utilities, customers, and internal teams to ensure all applications, documentation, and approvals are completed accurately, on time, and in compliance with utility and regulatory requirements.

In this role, you'll track project milestones, maintain organized and audit-ready records, coordinate customer documentation, resolve interconnection-related issues, and help identify opportunities to improve internal processes. Success in this position requires exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational and communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Manage the full interconnection lifecycle for residential solar and energy storage projects, from application submission through Permission to Operate (PTO).
  • Prepare, submit, and track interconnection applications with utilities, ensuring all requirements are met.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for utilities, responding to inquiries and following up on application status.
  • Coordinate directly with customers to obtain required documentation, signatures, and utility access for interconnection applications.
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and audit-ready records of all interconnection documents, agreements, and correspondence.
  • Monitor project timelines, identify potential delays or risks, and proactively escalate issues when necessary.
  • Collaborate with engineering, project management, permitting, and operations teams to keep projects moving efficiently.
  • Support the resolution of interconnection-related challenges, including utility requests, design updates, and technical clarifications.
  • Track interconnection approvals, milestones, and related documentation to ensure compliance with utility and regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to process improvements by helping optimize workflows, documentation standards, and tracking systems.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in solar operations, utility interconnection, project coordination, permitting, or a related role.
  • Experience working with utility companies, interconnection applications, or renewable energy projects is highly preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with customers, utilities, and internal stakeholders.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate documentation and records.
  • Ability to identify issues, solve problems proactively, and escalate risks when appropriate.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with changing priorities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and project tracking or CRM systems.
  • Experience with solar industry platforms and utility portals is a plus.
  • High level of accountability, ownership, and commitment to delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Important to Know

  • This is a fully remote position, but you'll work closely with internal teams, utility representatives, and customers throughout the interconnection process.
  • Success in this role depends on staying organized, managing multiple projects simultaneously, and following up proactively to keep projects moving forward.
  • Strong attention to detail is essential, as you'll be responsible for maintaining accurate documentation and ensuring compliance with utility and regulatory requirements.
  • You'll be expected to communicate professionally with customers, utilities, and cross-functional teams while providing timely updates and resolving issues efficiently.
  • Experience in the residential solar industry or with utility interconnection processes is highly valued and will help you ramp up quickly.
  • This role offers the opportunity to make a direct impact on project success by helping customers achieve a smooth path to Permission to Operate (PTO) and supporting Terra Energy's mission to expand access to clean energy.

How You’ll Work at Terra Energy

At Terra Energy, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement are at the core of everything we do. As an Interconnection Specialist, you'll work cross-functionally with Operations, Engineering, Project Management, and Customer Support teams to keep projects moving efficiently from application submission through Permission to Operate (PTO). Your ability to communicate proactively, stay organized, and build strong relationships with utilities and customers will play a key role in our success.

We trust our team members to take ownership of their work, think proactively, and identify opportunities to improve processes. In this fully remote role, you'll have the autonomy to manage your workload while collaborating with a supportive team that values transparency, problem-solving, and delivering an exceptional customer experience. If you're passionate about renewable energy and thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment, you'll fit right in.

Compensation & Details

  • Location:Remote
  • Reports to: Ops
  • Department: Operations
  • Salary: 45K Annually

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means keeping interconnection projects moving efficiently while ensuring every application, document, and customer interaction is handled accurately and on time. You'll consistently meet project milestones, maintain organized and compliant records, communicate proactively with utilities and customers, and help minimize delays by identifying and resolving issues before they impact project timelines.

You'll thrive by taking ownership of your work, collaborating effectively across teams, and contributing to continuous process improvements. A successful Interconnection Specialist is dependable, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering an exceptional customer experience while helping Terra Energy achieve its operational goals. Performance in this role is measured by timely completion of assigned work order milestones, with a target of 80% or higher.

In Summary

If you're a detail-oriented professional who enjoys coordinating projects, building relationships, and keeping complex processes on track, we'd love to meet you. As an Interconnection Specialist, you'll play a critical role in helping customers transition to clean energy by ensuring interconnection applications are completed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with utility requirements.

Join Terra Energy and become part of a collaborative team that's driving the future of renewable energy. Here, your work will have a direct impact on project success, customer satisfaction, and our mission to make solar energy more accessible—one successful interconnection at a time.

Recruitment Process

  • Initial Contact (HR) – Quick intro and role overview
  • HR Interview – Experience and overall fit
  • Hiring Manager Interview – Technical and role deep dive
  • Offer Letter – Final offer and next steps

Executive Rhythm and Prioritization

Communications and Inbox Leadership

Project and Cross-Functional Execution

Data and Light Reporting

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Sistema.bio, creando valor del desecho

Al brindar acceso a tecnología innovadora de biodigestores, Sistema.bio se dedica a abordar los desafíos interconectados de la pobreza, la seguridad alimentaria y el cambio climático.

En Sistema.bio buscamos a un/a Practicante de Community Management que quiera sumarse al equipo de Marketing y Comunicación para apoyar en la gestión de redes sociales, creación de contenido y ejecución de iniciativas digitales, contribuyendo al fortalecimiento de nuestra presencia digital y posicionamiento de marca en LATAM.

¿Qué harás durante tu estancia formativa?

Este programa está diseñado como un espacio de aprendizaje profesional en un entorno real de trabajo, enfocado en el desarrollo de habilidades, observación activa y práctica guiada, sin que esto implique una relación laboral ni responsabilidades propias de un puesto formal.

  • Participar en propuestas creativas para contenidos orgánicos, campañas temáticas y dinámicas digitales.

Esta es una práctica profesional formativa no remunerada, enfocada en el aprendizaje, la mentoría y la experiencia profesional. No implica una relación laboral ni responsabilidades propias de un puesto formal. La duración de la práctica es de 3 a 6 meses, de acuerdo con los requisitos de cada institución educativa para la liberación de prácticas profesionales.

Más sobre ti:

Buscamos estudiantes de Comunicación, Marketing, Publicidad, Diseño, carreras relacionadas con el sector agropecuario o afines, con interés en desarrollarse dentro del mundo del marketing digital y la comunicación con propósito.

Nos gustaría que tengas:

  • Interés genuino por redes sociales, creación de contenido y tendencias digitales.
  • Buen nivel de redacción, ortografía y comunicación escrita.
  • Curiosidad por el storytelling digital, la sostenibilidad, la innovación social y el sector agropecuario.

  • Afinidad o experiencia con el sector agropecuario, especialmente si tienes facilidad para comunicar temas relacionados con el campo, agricultura, ganadería o sostenibilidad.

Además, será un plus si cuentas con:

  • Una comunidad propia en redes sociales o experiencia creando contenido, especialmente si está relacionada con el sector agropecuario, rural, sostenibilidad o temas afines.
  • Experiencia como creador/a de contenido, micro influencer o embajador/a digital.

Modalidad y duración de la práctica profesional

  • Modalidad: Remota
  • Duración: 3 a 6 meses.
  • Horario: 4 horas diarias.
  • Fecha de inicio: ¡Lo antes posible!

Nuestros valores son FIRE (Fuego) 🔥

Farmer-Centric: Nos inspira la pasión y el trabajo duro de las y los productores en todo lo que hacemos.

Impact-driven: Nos enfocamos en generar un cambio positivo en la Tierra.

Resourceful: Actuamos con iniciativa y eficiencia, enfrentando los retos conforme se presentan.

Ethical: Construimos relaciones sanas basadas en la confianza, la transparencia, la confiabilidad y el respeto.

En Sistema.bio somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Damos la bienvenida y fomentamos la diversidad en el lugar de trabajo, sin distinción de género, raza o color, etnicidad u origen nacional, edad, discapacidad, religión, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género.

WAN, Check Point Firewall & Azure Networking Engineer

Contract Duration: 3 month contract

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced WAN, Check Point Firewall & Azure Networking Engineer to join our technology team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, implementation, administration, monitoring, troubleshooting and optimisation of enterprise network and security environments.

The role requires strong hands-on experience across WAN technologies, Check Point firewalls and Microsoft Azure networking, with a focus on network availability, performance, security and resilience.

Key Responsibilities

WAN & Network Infrastructure

  • Design, configure and support enterprise WAN and LAN network environments.
  • Manage WAN connectivity, routing and network performance.
  • Troubleshoot complex network connectivity and performance issues.
  • Configure and manage routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
  • Monitor network availability, capacity and performance.
  • Work with service providers to resolve connectivity and circuit-related incidents.
  • Support network changes, upgrades and migrations.
  • Ensure network infrastructure meets availability, performance and security requirements.

Check Point Firewall

  • Install, configure, administer and maintain Check Point firewalls.
  • Manage firewall policies, NAT, VPNs, access rules and security configurations.
  • Perform firewall rule reviews and optimisation.
  • Troubleshoot firewall and network security incidents.
  • Monitor firewall performance, logs and security events.
  • Implement security changes in accordance with change management processes.
  • Support high-availability firewall environments.
  • Ensure firewall configurations comply with organisational security standards.

Azure Networking

  • Design, implement and support Microsoft Azure networking environments.
  • Configure and manage:
  • Azure Virtual Networks (VNet)
  • Subnets
  • Network Security Groups (NSGs)
  • Azure Firewall
  • Route Tables / UDRs
  • VPN Gateway
  • ExpressRoute
  • Load Balancers
  • Private Endpoints
  • VNet Peering
  • Support hybrid connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and Azure.
  • Troubleshoot Azure network connectivity and routing issues.
  • Assist with Azure network migrations and cloud transformation initiatives.
  • Implement secure and scalable Azure network architectures.

Technical Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience with WAN technologies and enterprise networking.
  • Strong Check Point Firewall administration and troubleshooting experience.
  • Strong Microsoft Azure Networking experience.
  • Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN and network security.
  • Experience with BGP, OSPF and routing protocols.
  • Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools.
  • Understanding of high availability and disaster recovery principles.
  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments.
  • Strong knowledge of network security principles and best practices.

Qualifications & Certifications

  • Relevant degree, diploma or technical qualification in IT, Networking or a related field.
  • Check Point certification such as CCSA/CCSE would be advantageous.
  • Microsoft Azure networking certification such as AZ-700 would be advantageous.
  • Cisco certification such as CCNA/CCNP would be beneficial.

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving ability.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a production environment.
  • Strong documentation and reporting skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a technical team.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL and change management processes.
  • Excellent attention to detail and security awareness.

Experience

  • 8+ years' experience in enterprise networking and infrastructure.
  • Proven experience supporting WAN environments.
  • Strong hands-on Check Point Firewall experience.
  • Strong experience with Azure Networking and hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience working in large, complex enterprise environments is advantageous.

jobs.excerpt: At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies.
jobs.description:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the Role

As a hands-on Engineering Manager of our agent and developer platform at Ledgy, you'll lead the team that makes everything else possible, the infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, developer and agent tooling, security posture, and platform capabilities that thousands of employees worldwide depend on to experience equity ownership. You'll lead a team of 4–6 engineers building the foundation for Ledgy's next chapter: a platform where AI agents operate as first-class citizens alongside human engineers.

This is a good fit if you see DevOps, CI/CD, and platform engineering not as plumbing, but as one of highest-leverage investment a company can make - especially as AI agents become core contributors to how software is built and delivered. You'll also partner closely with our CISO to shape Ledgy's security strategy, particularly as AI transforms the threat landscape and our enterprise customers demand rigorous security practices. You'll report directly to the Head of Engineering and play a key role in scaling our platform and our engineering culture.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

  • Have a strong vision for what modern platform engineering looks like when AI agents are writing, testing, and deploying code alongside humans
  • Bring deep experience in CI/CD, DevOps, and infrastructure - and opinions about how to make pipelines fast, reliable, and agent-friendly
  • Are excited about building systems that scale: observability, deployment automation, developer experience, and infrastructure-as-code
  • Have a security-minded approach to platform engineering - you understand that when AI agents have access to production systems and sensitive financial data, the security model needs to evolve, and you're eager to help define what that looks like
  • Love developing people, watching engineers grow and tackle increasingly sophisticated challenges
  • Want to remain hands-on - you're comfortable building with Terraform, debugging pipelines, and shipping improvements yourself, and you actively use AI tools to multiply your output
  • Have 3+ years experience in Engineering Management and 6+ years as a Software Engineer, with meaningful time spent in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps roles

What You'll Own

  • Team Leadership: Leading a team of platform engineers, setting technical direction, and creating an environment where people do the best work of their careers.
  • CI/CD & Developer Experience: Our build and deployment pipelines - making them fast, reliable, and optimised for both human and AI-agent workflows. Think: how do we make it seamless for an agent to open a PR, get it reviewed, and ship it?
  • Infrastructure & Observability: Our GCP infrastructure, Terraform configuration, monitoring, and alerting. You'll set SLOs and make sure we can see what's happening in production - including what agents are doing.
  • Security Partnership: Working alongside our CISO to define and execute Ledgy's security strategy. This means helping prioritise what matters most for a regulated fintech serving enterprise clients - from supply chain security and access controls to the new challenges introduced by AI agents operating in production systems. You'll be the engineering leader who turns security strategy into implemented reality.
  • AI Infrastructure & Agent Platform: Building the foundations that let both humans and AI agents operate effectively in Ledgy's systems. This includes an MCP interface that exposes our platform to AI tools, agent identity and access models (distinguishing human from agent actions in audit logs and permissions), dry-run and sandbox environments for safe experimentation.

Our tech stack:

We have a modern, cohesive stack that lets us move fast while maintaining quality:

  • Language: TypeScript
  • Frontend: React, Tailwind CSS, tRPC
  • Backend: tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, Temporal
  • Infrastructure: GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, Github Actions

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 Days

  • Build meaningful relationships with your direct reports and understand their career aspirations
  • Get hands-on with our CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure, and deployment processes - identify the biggest friction points
  • Understand how AI agents are already being used in our engineering workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, automated PRs) and where the gaps are
  • Join the engineering leadership team and understand how we translate product vision into technical reality
  • Meet with our CISO and understand Ledgy's current security posture, compliance requirements, and where the biggest gaps are

First 3 Months

  • Own and drive improvements to pipeline reliability and speed - set measurable SLOs for build times, deployment frequency, and failure rates
  • Define and begin executing a roadmap for making our platform agent-ready: what needs to change so that AI agents can contribute code safely and at scale?
  • Have regular 1:1s with your reports and support them in their growth
  • Shape platform strategy alongside the Head of Engineering and CTO
  • Partner with the CISO to define a security roadmap that accounts for AI-specific risks - agent access controls, code provenance, data exposure through AI tooling - and begin executing on the highest-priority items

6–12 Months

  • Be recognised as the technical leader who defines how Ledgy's platform scales - for both humans and agents
  • Have delivered measurable improvements to developer experience, deployment velocity, and infrastructure reliability
  • Lead meaningful career development conversations and conduct performance reviews
  • Own engineering initiatives that influence how the entire organisation ships software
  • Be a trusted partner to product and engineering leadership on technical direction

The Interview Process

  1. Getting to know you (30 min): meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to answer questions about the role
  2. Live Coding (60 min): A problem-solving session using your preferred language and IDE
  3. System Design (60 min): Walk us through an architecture you've significantly contributed to — we'll explore CI/CD, infrastructure, and scaling aspects based on your experience
  4. Mock 1:1 (45 min): A mock coaching conversation with one of our engineers to see how you approach people management and development
  5. Culture & Vision (30 min): Meet one of our founders to discuss Ledgy's mission and how you think about building platforms that scale
  6. Offer 🎉

Being part of Ledgy means:

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.
  • For candidates based in London or Zurich we use a hybrid work model of 2 days in the office per week.

jobs.description:
About Us

Dutch Vet is transforming veterinary care by making expert treatment accessible anytime, anywhere. Our mission is simple: help every pet live their happiest, healthiest life by connecting pet parents with licensed vets through seamless virtual visits.

We’re the only veterinary telemedicine service that can diagnose, prescribe, and ship medications directly to customers in most states. For less than $100 per year, Dutch offers real relief and convenience for pets and their families.

As one customer put it: “Dutch was the only site that would diagnose and prescribe meds as well as ship the meds.”

Here’s what other customers have said about Dutch Vet:

"The easiest vet visit you'll ever have.”

"More thorough than my in-person vet.”

"No nonsense, quick, easy and friendly veterinarian. Much cheaper than our regular local vet that couldn’t get us in. So glad I found Dutch!"

Backed by world-class investors including Forerunner Ventures, Eclipse Ventures, and Bling Capital, our team is made-up of successful startup founders (Hims, PlushCare, Nasty Gal) with expertise in scaling enterprises (TripAdvisor, Walmart, BARK). Featured in TechCrunch, Forbes, Wired, and Axios, Dutch is setting the standard for quality, accessibility, and compassion in pet care.

The Role

We're looking for a Director of Customer Experience to own the full member journey — from the moment someone signs up to the ongoing relationship we build with them over years of pet care. This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of operations, product, and brand: you'll shape how Dutch members feel at every touchpoint, build and scale the team that makes it happen, and advocate relentlessly for the customer inside the organization.

You'll report directly to the VP of Operations and work closely with Clinical, Product, Engineering, Marketing and Finance to make sure our customer experience isn't just a support function — it's a competitive advantage.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

    Member experience strategy. Define what a world-class Dutch experience looks like across every channel — messaging, email, live support, prescription delivery, and everything in between. Set the vision, build the roadmap, and hold the bar.

    Support operations. Lead and grow our CX team, including team leads, support specialists, and CX ops. Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and team culture. Build systems that scale without sacrificing the warmth and responsiveness that make Dutch different.

    Voice of the customer. Own NPS, CSAT, and member retention metrics. Build the listening infrastructure — surveys, tagging, trend analysis — that turns member feedback into actionable product and operational insights. Make sure leadership hears what members are actually experiencing.

    Cross-functional advocacy. Partner with Product and Engineering to surface and prioritize member pain points. Partner with Clinical to ensure the handoff between vet care and member support is seamless. Partner with Growth to understand what's bringing members in and what's keeping them.

    Tooling and process. Evaluate, own, and improve the tech stack that powers CX — help desk software, CRM, automation, AI-assisted workflows. Build for efficiency without losing the human touch that pet parents need when they're worried about their animals.

    Quality and compliance. Ensure support interactions meet Dutch's quality standards, and that the team operates within relevant regulatory guidelines for a telehealth environment.

    Core Metrics

  • NPS

  • CSAT

  • Response Times

  • SLA adherence on all channels (email, chat, live phones, SMS)

  • Review Site Ratings

  • Refund Rate

  • Cancellations & Retention

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

    You have 8+ years of customer experience or customer operations experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership role. You've built and scaled CX teams at a DTC, health, or subscription company — ideally in an environment where the stakes were high and the margin for error was low.

    You lead with empathy, but you're also deeply analytical. You know how to use data to diagnose problems, prioritize work, and make the case for investment. You're comfortable presenting to executives and equally comfortable getting into the weeds with your team on a thorny support issue.

    You have a strong point of view on what great customer experience looks like — and the experience to back it up. You don't just respond to problems; you build systems that prevent them.

    Passion for animals is a genuine plus. Our members are reaching out because they're worried about their pets. The right person for this role feels that weight and uses it as motivation.

    Specifically, you bring:

  • A track record of improving customer retention and satisfaction at scale

  • Experience owning CSAT, NPS, and related metrics as a business driver — not just a reporting exercise

  • Strong people leadership: you know how to hire well, develop your team, and build a culture people want to be part of

  • Experience working in a cross-functional environment where CX doesn't own everything but influences everything

  • Familiarity with modern CX tooling (Zendesk, Intercom, Kustomer, Gorgias, Gladly) and a strong opinion about how AI and automation should (and shouldn't) be used in member support

  • Excellent written and verbal communication — you can write a sharp escalation policy and a thoughtful member-facing apology email with equal facility

  • Comfort in a fast-moving, high-accountability startup environment

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

    In your first 90 days, you've done a deep audit of the current member experience, built relationships across the org, and have a clear picture of the biggest gaps between where we are and where we need to be.

    At six months, you have a roadmap the team believes in, the key hires in place, and early movement on the metrics that matter most.

    At a year, Dutch members notice the difference — and our data reflects it.

WHY WORK FOR DUTCH?

  • Competitive salary range between $150,000 - $180,000

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance

  • Life and Disability Insurance

  • Flexible PTO

  • Mental Wellbeing Options

  • Robust Holiday Schedule

  • Retirement savings plan

  • Growth Opportunities

DUTCH'S GUIDING PRINCIPLES:

  • Pets First – business and medical decisions are always guided by the pet's best interest. We'll never compromise on pet health and we're all here because we care about their well-being

  • Agile Like a Cat – We have a bias toward swift action, while maintaining quality and accuracy. For us, that means being able to turn on a dime, like a cat, analyze our options – even ones that may not be on the table – then execute without perfection getting in the way

  • Creativity is our Catnip – Creativity feeds us and helps us push boundaries to always find better solutions, making the complex more accessible and easier to understand

  • Be the Human Your Dog Thinks You Are – Be kind, show care for your colleagues, and even if you're an expert - give others context, reinforce the positive, and help them understand.

jobs.description:
UX Lead, Public Website and CMS Migration

Location: Canada, remote
Engagement: Contract
Compensation: $70–$100/hour, depending on experience

Role summary

Aequilibrium is seeking a Canadian-based UX Lead to lead the public website experience for credit unions transitioning away from the Central 1 Forge platform and its OpenText CMS. This is a public website redesign and CMS migration role, not a SaaS or application product-design role. The successful candidate must have experience modernizing large, content-rich websites and guiding organizations through decisions about what content, navigation, functionality, and user journeys to retain, redesign, consolidate, or retire.

The UX Lead will ensure the migration is not treated as a simple lift-and-shift from OpenText into a new CMS. They will lead discovery, assess the current website, define the target member experience, and help the credit union establish a more effective information architecture, content structure, navigation system, and reusable component framework.

Although the primary responsibility is the public website, the UX Lead must understand how it connects with account opening, digital banking, product applications, calculators, branch and ATM services, and other member touchpoints. The goal is to create a coherent member journey while recognizing that the public website and the authenticated banking product are different platforms.

The ideal candidate combines deep website UX and CMS migration expertise with strong content, information architecture, and stakeholder-facilitation skills. Experience in credit unions, banking, insurance or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.

Key responsibilities

Website discovery and experience strategy

  • Lead discovery and experience strategy for complex public website redesigns and CMS migrations.

  • Assess the current Forge/OpenText website, including its content, information architecture, navigation, templates, functionality, and member journeys.

  • Identify what should be retained, improved, consolidated, redesigned, or retired.

  • Define the target public website experience and establish clear experience principles to guide the migration.

  • Prevent the project from becoming a page-for-page recreation of the existing website.

  • Facilitate discovery sessions and decision-making workshops with credit union executives, marketing, digital, technology, and business stakeholders.

Information architecture and content experience

  • Lead the development of the website’s information architecture, navigation, taxonomy and content hierarchy.

  • Partner with credit union marketing and digital teams on content audits, content prioritization and migration decisions.

  • Simplify complex financial information so members can understand products, compare options and take appropriate action.

  • Design effective paths to products, services, rates, calculators, educational content, branch and ATM information, support and account opening.

  • Help establish content models and page structures that are scalable, maintainable and practical for CMS authors.

  • Incorporate SEO and findability considerations into navigation, content structure and page design.

Member journeys and measurable outcomes

  • Map priority journeys that begin on the public website and continue into account opening, digital banking or other third-party platforms.

  • Identify gaps, friction and inconsistencies across these connected experiences.

  • Develop personas, journey maps or service blueprints where they will support better decisions.

  • Translate business objectives into measurable website outcomes, including qualified leads, account-opening conversion, digital adoption, task completion, accessibility and member satisfaction.

  • Use research, analytics and usability testing to validate recommendations.

Design and implementation

  • Create sitemaps, user flows, wireframes, prototypes and detailed interaction specifications.

  • Define or evolve the website design system and reusable CMS component library.

  • Design components that balance member needs, brand consistency, accessibility and content-author flexibility.

  • Partner closely with the CMS Technical Lead to ensure the proposed experience is achievable within the selected platform.

  • Collaborate with the Front-End Lead throughout implementation to maintain design quality and responsive behavior.

  • Review implemented pages and components, identify gaps and support remediation before launch.

  • Incorporate WCAG accessibility requirements from the beginning rather than treating accessibility as a final-stage review.

Client leadership

  • Present research findings, experience recommendations and design decisions to senior credit union stakeholders.

  • Facilitate discussions where marketing, technology, compliance and business priorities may compete.

  • Explain complex UX and content decisions in practical business terms.

  • Help AEQ position the public website as a critical part of the broader Forge transformation.

Required experience

  • Eight or more years of experience in website UX, digital experience, information architecture or related fields.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, content-rich public website redesigns or CMS migrations.

  • A portfolio showing public website work, including information architecture, navigation, content strategy, wireframes and responsive page design.

  • Experience conducting website and content audits and making evidence-based recommendations about what to retain, redesign, consolidate or retire.

  • Strong understanding of CMS-driven design, content models, templates, reusable components and authoring needs.

  • Experience creating or evolving website design systems and component libraries.

  • Strong knowledge of responsive design and WCAG accessibility requirements.

  • Working knowledge of SEO, website analytics, conversion optimization and usability testing.

  • Strong workshop facilitation, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Ability to work at both the strategic and detailed design levels.

  • Ability to work directly with executives, marketing leaders, digital teams, business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.

  • Must be based in Canada and legally eligible to work in Canada.

Preferred experience

  • Experience with credit unions, banks, insurance companies or other regulated organizations.

  • Experience designing financial-services websites and journeys involving products, rates, calculators, applications, account opening or authenticated banking.

  • Experience migrating websites from OpenText or another enterprise CMS.

  • Familiarity with content governance, migration planning and authoring workflows.

  • Experience defining analytics frameworks and measurable website-experience outcomes.

Important distinction

This position is NOT focused on designing a SaaS platform, internal enterprise application, or digital banking product. Candidates with application or product design experience must also demonstrate substantial experience leading public website redesigns, information architecture, content strategy, and CMS migrations, particularly for credit unions!

Strong visual or product-design skills alone will not be sufficient. The successful candidate must understand how to transform a large public website and its content, not simply redesign application interfaces or move existing pages into a new platform.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Product Manager, Content Platform
jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionArc XP is a cloud-based digital experience platform that helps enterprise companies, retail brands, and media and entertainment organizations create and distribute content, drive digital commerce, and deliver powerful multichannel experiences.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Arc XP is a cloud-based digital experience platform that helps enterprise companies, retail brands, and media and entertainment organizations create and distribute content, drive digital commerce, and deliver powerful multichannel experiences. A division of The Washington Post, Arc XP has powered the digital transformation of customers across the globe, currently serving more than 1,500 sites in 25 countries that reach more than 1.5 billion unique visitors monthly.

Built 100% on AWS, the Arc platform employs a microservice architecture with a headless, API-first approach to content management. All of our software teams use DevOps to deliver and maintain products. Our processes are lightweight, which allows our teams to innovate quickly to bring new ideas to market. New features and products are deployed to our customer base every day.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager who can shape the future of how content is created, structured, and delivered in an AI-native world. This role sits at the intersection of headless content management, intelligent automation, and platform strategy. You will own the product vision for our Content Platform, defining how AI capabilities are woven into the content lifecycle—from authoring and enrichment to orchestration and multichannel delivery. You'll work closely with our Content Creation, Cloud Platform, and Developer Experience teams to build the next generation of tools that empower both human creators and AI agents to produce, manipulate, and distribute content at scale.

As a principal-level Product Manager, you'll operate as a fractional PM across several pods in the content platform space simultaneously, threading a coherent product thesis through related missions rather than going deep on any single pod's backlog. You'll set direction across those pods, mentor other product managers, and own the strategic narrative for where the content platform is going—not just the next quarter, but the next several years.

This isn't about bolting AI onto an existing CMS. We're rethinking what a content platform looks like when AI is a first-class participant in the content supply chain, and we need someone who has a clear, opinionated vision for that future.

What Motivates You

  • You think in systems and see content platforms as orchestration layers, not just storage and retrieval.

  • You get energized by the ambiguity of defining new product categories at the intersection of AI and content.

  • You believe in the empowered product team model, where engineering, design, and product work as true partners in discovery and delivery, not a feature factory.

  • You're comfortable supporting multiple pods simultaneously as a fractional PM, holding the broader product thesis in your head and pulling threads together across related missions rather than living inside one pod's backlog.

  • You're passionate about lean product development—validating assumptions early, learning fast, and shipping incremental value rather than big-bang releases.

  • You want to shape how enterprises create and deliver content over the next five years, not just optimize what exists today.

  • Comfortable leading through influence across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams.

  • You already use AI tools in your daily workflow—for research, writing, analysis, prototyping, or decision-making—and you're excited about pushing those boundaries further because you believe the best way to build AI-powered products is to live the workflow yourself.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Define the long-term vision and product strategy for Arc's Content Platform, establishing how AI transforms content creation, management, orchestration, and delivery.

  • Lead the evolution of AI-native content capabilities by identifying opportunities to embed intelligent automation throughout the content lifecycle while balancing customer needs with long-term platform strategy.

  • Drive the evolution of Arc's content architecture, APIs, and platform capabilities to support both human creators and AI-powered systems.

  • Build and maintain a strategic product roadmap that sequences foundational platform investments, AI capabilities, and developer experience improvements to maximize customer value.

  • Partner with engineering, design, and customer-facing teams to define requirements, evaluate technical approaches, prioritize investments, and deliver platform capabilities through iterative product development.

  • Align product direction across multiple Content Platform, Cloud Infrastructure, and Developer Experience pods, ensuring initiatives reinforce a unified product vision and measurable customer outcomes.

  • Champion AI-first ways of working by applying AI tools throughout product discovery, planning, research, analysis, and prototyping while helping establish best practices across the product organization.

  • Represent Arc XP with customers, industry partners, and standards organizations to influence emerging content platform and AI standards while translating industry direction into product strategy.

  • Build strong feedback loops with customers, developers, internal stakeholders, and go-to-market teams to continuously refine platform direction and strengthen customer outcomes.

  • Define success metrics, monitor platform performance, identify strategic risks, and communicate product progress and investment priorities to executive leadership.

The Skills and Experience You Bring

  • 10+ years in product management, with at least 5 years working on content platforms, headless CMS, or digital experience platforms.

  • Demonstrated experience defining and shipping AI-powered product capabilities (not just integrating third-party APIs, but thinking through how AI changes workflows, data models, and user expectations).

  • Deep familiarity with headless/decoupled content architectures, content modeling, and API-first platform design.

  • Experience setting product strategy at the principal or staff level, including mentoring other PMs and shaping how the broader product organization operates.

  • Experience operating within an empowered product team model, partnering closely with engineering and design through continuous discovery and iterative delivery.

  • Daily, hands-on use of AI-powered tools (LLMs, coding assistants, research agents, etc.) to materially accelerate your own product work—PRDs, research synthesis, competitive analysis, data exploration, and rapid prototyping. You should be able to point to specific workflows you've reinvented around AI, not just tools you've tried.

Preferred

  • BA/BS or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degree welcome but not required.

  • Strong understanding of modern content management paradigms: structured content, headless delivery, COPE (Create Once, Publish Everywhere), content-as-a-service.

  • Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts as they apply to content—including generation, classification, enrichment, summarization, and agentic workflows.

  • Comfort operating in an AI-first team culture where AI tools are expected to be part of how you think, write, analyze, and ship—not a novelty, but a core part of the workday.

  • Proven ability to translate a forward-looking technical vision into a concrete, prioritized roadmap.

  • Track record of operating as a fractional PM across multiple empowered pods at once, framing each pod's work as a sequence of small, hypothesis-driven bets that compound into a larger thesis—not as long, fixed-scope programs with distant delivery dates.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and to articulate a compelling product narrative.

  • Grounded in lean product development principles: hypothesis-driven development, rapid experimentation, validated learning, and outcome-over-output thinking.

  • Experience with news, media, or publishing platforms (understanding editorial workflows, content velocity, and audience-facing delivery).

  • Experience with Platform as a Service (PaaS) product development empowering developers to build on top of your platform.

  • Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks, AI agent architectures, or content-aware AI pipelines.

  • A portfolio or examples of how you've used AI to meaningfully accelerate your own product management work (we'll ask about this in interviews).

  • Experience leading B2B and B2B2C platform products.

  • Background in cloud-native, serverless, or microservice architectures on AWS.

  • Experience representing a company in industry standards bodies or working groups (e.g., IAB Tech Lab, W3C), particularly around content monetization, syndication, or AI/agent access standards.

  • Experience shipping subscription or paywall products — pricing, metering, entitlements, or churn/retention work for digital content platforms.

  • Background in advertising technology (programmatic, header bidding, ad ops, or ad-serving integrations) and how platform architecture exposes inventory and signal to drive revenue.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Nine paid holidays and two personal days

  • 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent

  • Robust mental health resources

  • Backup care and caregiver concierge services

  • Gender affirming services

  • Pet insurance

  • Free Post digital subscription

  • Leadership and career development program

Benefits may vary based on the job, full-time or part-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status

The salary range for this position is:

$131,500 - $219,100 Annual

The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process.

The Post strives to provide its readers with high-quality, trustworthy news and information while constantly innovating. That mission is best served by a diverse, multi-generational workforce with varied life experiences and perspectives. All cultures and backgrounds are welcomed.

It is a core strategy to fulfill Airbnb’s belongs anywhere mission.We are building a world-class payments platform that moves billions of dollars, in 191 countries, with 75 currencies, through a complex ecosystem of payments partners. Payments Transactions team and Payments Payouts team are part of the core platform of the Airbnb Payments ecosystem. The teams are building the core billing system and payouts system for Airbnb money movements. The team engineers are responsible for the seamless orchestration and recording of Airbnb’s payment obligations with our community. They initiate, advance, and realize Airbnb’s payment commitments with our community in a way that is reliable, accurate, timely, scalable, and auditable.

You will be involved in the technical details of building highly available services in close collaboration with product, data science and operations teams to understand and react to the ever evolving business needs and to make Airbnb the world’s safest while easiest to use payments platform.

  • Work with other engineering teams to advance Airbnb’s engineering processes and technical foundations

  • Proven experience in defining product/technical strategy and driving alignment with cross-functional leaders and stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with experience driving initiatives that span across teams, departments and leadership.

THE POSITION:

Medical Information is a critically important customer-facing function that supports the safe and effective use of pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical device, and digital therapeutic products by providing timely, scientifically balanced, evidence based, non-promotional information in response to unsolicited requests from healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, and payers.

This role requires medical information and medical content experience and knowledge, including excellent communication skills (both verbal and written),

The role is home office based, (full-time position), and the eligible candidates must hold a valid work permit in the European Union, or the UK.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

  • Plays an essential role supporting Global Medical Information / Medical Content Development Team on content development-related engagements for clients who require medical content development and management services.

  • Supports creating/updating the SOPs, checklists, templates, style guides, and guidance documents as necessary.

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Education: Doctorate or Master of Science (MSc) degree in Life Sciences or healthcare or equivalent.

Experience developing global medical information materials, e.g., scientific response documents (SRDs), frequently asked questions (FAQs), custom response documents (CRDs), etc.
  • Exceptional written, oral, interpersonal, and presentation skills including the ability to independently interpret and summarize complex results. Ability to establish credibility with a variety of audiences; especially with clients
  • Ability to effectively interface with all levels of management and staff and to succeed in a matrix team setting while meeting or exceeding timelines.

  • Experience conducting literature searches and working with tools such as PubMed, Ovid, Embase, etc.

  • Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and best practices in relationship to Medical Information, Medical Affairs and promotional and non-promotional materials review
  • Excellent project management skills and proven track record of being results driven
  • Ability to conceptualize, design and deliver best in class solutions.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Education: A Pharm.D. or Pharm.M or a Degree in Medicine or PhD is preferred. Relevant Bachelor’s Degree in a Life Science also considered.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

We are seeking a Senior Integration & Systems Engineerto design, implement, and maintain reliable system integrations and technical infrastructure that support critical business operations for imaServe, our behavioral health EHR and billing platform. This role is well suited for someone who works independently, applies sound technical judgment, and produces structured, high-quality work in environments where accuracy and system reliability matter.

Our systems run in customer-managed environments, both on premises and in Azure, across multiple generations of Red Hat-based Linux. You'll work within each customer's VPN, security, maintenance-window, and change-control requirements.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Build and maintain scripts, services, and scheduled interfaces that exchange data with hospitals, HIEs, payers, and partners.

  • Monitor interfaces and resolve failed, delayed, or rejected transactions through confirmed delivery.

  • Launch new integrations from specification and testing through cutover and documentation.

  • Administer source control and manage builds, releases, backups, and tested rollback procedures.

  • Lead our transition to Git, automated builds, and CI/CD.

  • Configure, secure, patch, monitor, and troubleshoot customer-hosted Linux systems.

  • Maintain storage, capacity, backups, disaster recovery, certificates, credentials, and system performance.

  • Support varied Linux versions and lead migrations away from end-of-life operating systems.

  • Coordinate directly with customer IT and security teams during maintenance, implementations, incidents, and go-lives.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation and scheduled after-hours maintenance.

  • Create clear inventories, runbooks, and technical documentation.

  • Use Claude Code daily for scripting, code review, legacy-code analysis, and documentation—while carefully validating all output.

During your first few months, you’ll document our interfaces and customer environments, establish a repeatable release process, verify backups, improve monitoring, and assess systems requiring modernization.

Our stack includes an AlphaBASIC application transpiled to C, Red Hat–family Linux, a FairCom c-tree ISAM database, and a Windows client. Experience with these specific technologies is not required. Curiosity, patience, and sound judgment when working with unfamiliar legacy systems are essential.

This role offers significant autonomy, direct customer relationships, and the opportunity to modernize systems that support real clinical and billing operations. All work is performed under HIPAA obligations and requires careful handling of Protected Health Information.


Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Linux systems administration, DevOps, or systems/integration engineering within a production environment where system availability is critical.

  • Strong systems thinking and sound judgment, with the ability to work independently through complex technical problems with depth, precision, and accountability.

  • Clear written communication skills for documentation, specifications, technical handoffs, and correspondence with trading partners and customer IT teams.

  • Ability to manage competing technical priorities in environments with changing requirements.

  • Strong Bash/POSIX shell scripting skills, including writing reliable scripts with effective error handling, logging, and idempotent behavior.

  • In-depth experience with Red Hat–family Linux across multiple versions, including RHEL, CentOS, Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux, or Oracle Linux. Knowledge should include storage, permissions, systemd and SysV services, yum/dnf, cron, networking, firewalls, SELinux, SSH, package management, logging, and performance troubleshooting.

  • Experience administering customer-owned on-premises servers or cloud environments through customer-managed access tools such as AnyConnect, GlobalProtect, FortiClient, OpenVPN, WireGuard, Azure VPN, or Bastion, including MFA and jump hosts.

  • Experience working within customer change-control processes, including approvals, maintenance windows, and coordination with IT and security teams.

  • Experience operating unattended data interfaces using SFTP/FTPS, HTTPS/REST, curl or equivalent tools, certificates, and credentials, with a focus on verifying successful delivery.

  • Experience administering version-control repositories, along with strong Git proficiency.

  • Build and release management experience, including compiling and linking C applications on Linux, working with makefiles, and managing controlled production deployments.

  • Working knowledge of TLS/PKI and secure secrets management.

  • Ability to work carefully within a large, long-lived legacy codebase with limited documentation—and to improve that documentation over time.

  • Willingness to use Claude Code or similar AI-assisted development tools daily for writing and reviewing code. Candidates must be able to critically evaluate AI-generated work and take responsibility for everything they ship.

  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and perform scheduled maintenance outside normal business hours.

  • Ability to work under HIPAA requirements and pass a background check.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare interface experience with HL7 v2—including ADT, ORU, or SIU—C-CDA/CCD, IHE XDS.b, X12 EDI 837/835, Direct secure messaging, or HIE integrations.

  • Production experience with an EHR, practice-management, or revenue-cycle system.

  • Experience with ISAM or other non-relational, record-oriented databases, particularly FairCom c-tree, Btrieve, or similar technologies.

  • Exposure to legacy business languages such as AlphaBASIC, Business BASIC, COBOL, or MUMPS, or to source-to-C transpilation toolchains.

  • Microsoft Azure IaaS experience, including virtual machines, disks, snapshots, network security groups, VPN Gateway, Bastion, and backups—particularly within customer-owned subscriptions. Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms is also welcome.

  • Experience with end-of-life operating-system migrations, including CentOS 7 migrations to RHEL, Rocky Linux, or AlmaLinux; in-place major-version upgrades; or rebuild-and-migrate projects for legacy application servers.

  • Experience migrating from CVS to Git and developing CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.

  • Experience applying configuration management or infrastructure-as-code tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Terraform across varied environments. Container experience is also valuable.

  • Experience supporting infrastructure for multiple customers at a software company or managed service provider.

  • Experience with monitoring and alerting platforms such as Nagios, Icinga, Zabbix, Prometheus, or ELK.

  • Python or Perl experience for operational tooling and log analysis.

  • Hands-on Claude Code experience, including custom commands, subagents, hooks, MCP servers, or maintainingCLAUDE.md-style repository context.

  • Familiarity with HIPAA Security Rule technical safeguards, SOC 2, or HITRUST.


Benefits

Fully Remote Workforce

As a virtual-first organization, we can attract the best talent no matter where we all live. This allows for added flexibility and a schedule that works for you.

Essential Benefits

We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance; 40l(k) with match; legal benefits; short-term and long-term disability coverage; life insurance; and paid time off.

Employee Recognition

Team members can reward each other with points to celebrate everyday wins and going above and beyond. It’s our way of saying “nice job” in a way that really sticks.

Financial Incentives

Employees can benefit financially through the company’s success, referring top talent, and performance-based bonuses.

Salary: $115,00 - $135,000
We are not able to offer visa sponsorships at this time.

Job Summary

Mirantis is looking for a Technical Product Manager to own storage for k0rdent AI, our control plane for GPU infrastructure and distributed AI workloads. In this role, you will define the storage strategy, roadmap, and feature priorities that determine how operators provision, tier, and scale storage across GPU clusters running large-scale training and inference.

GPU cloud storage sits at the intersection of high-performance computing and multi-tenant cloud, and the product must hold both worlds together. You will shape how k0rdent AI reasons about parallel file systems (Lustre, GPFS, BeeGFS, WEKA, VAST, DAOS), S3-compatible object stores for training data and checkpoints, automated tiering between hot NVMe and capacity tiers, and GPUDirect Storage paths that bypass the CPU to feed accelerators at line rate. These layers are typically operated as disconnected silos, with storage admins, platform teams, and ML engineers each owning a slice. Your job is to make them a coherent, declarative product.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical fluency in classical storage and the AI stack. You will work directly with engineering to shape requirements, with marketing to sharpen positioning, and with field teams to convert technical depth into wins in competitive GPU cloud and NeoCloud deals.

Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, roadmap, and priorities for k0rdent AI storage, defining how customers design, automate, and operate every aspect of their storage stack, including parallel file systems, object storage, tiering, snapshots, data protection, and more
  • Translate requirements from NeoClouds, GPU clouds, telcos, sovereign clouds, and enterprise platform teams into clear product direction
  • Partner with engineering and architecture to define requirements, evaluate trade-offs, and ship secure, scalable, reliable storage capabilities
  • Manage the storage backlog, using feedback from production deployments and design partners to refine roadmap priorities and positioning
  • Define positioning, packaging, and competitive differentiation for k0rdent AI storage
  • Create field-facing assets, including technical briefs, battlecards, and reference architectures; support strategic accounts as the storage product lead
  • Represent Mirantis at events, analyst briefings, and customer advisory boards; engage storage, silicon, and ecosystem partners on reference architecture alignment

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in product management, technical product management, or a senior technical role owning a storage product, platform, or large-scale storage estate
  • Hands-on familiarity with parallel and distributed file systems (Lustre, GPFS/Spectrum Scale, BeeGFS, WEKA, VAST, DAOS), S3-compatible object storage, and block storage at scale
  • Fluency in Linux storage, Kubernetes storage (CSI, dynamic provisioning, storage classes), software-defined storage, hyperscale or service provider storage, or storage automation
  • Hands-on experience with modern GPU cluster storage, including GPUDirect Storage and RDMA data paths, NVMe-oF, hot/warm/cold tiering for training datasets and checkpoints, and high-throughput ingest pipelines

Why you’ll love Mirantis

  • Build the storage foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises
  • Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence
  • Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry.
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies.
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.
  • Professional development and training.
  • Attend conferences and working groups.
  • Customized workstation (macOS, Windows).
  • A competitive compensation package with strong benefits plan and stock options.
