Recognized by TIME as one of the Top 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Director of Demand Generation, you will own Pindrop's marketing-sourced pipeline across three distinct growth motions: our Core product suite, emerging Healthcare vertical, and Pulse for Meetings. You'll report to the VP of Growth and serve as the connective tissue between Growth pods, PMM, Brand, BDRs, Sales, and RevOps. You’re someone who has experience turning great strategies into campaigns that create pipeline.

You will start as a hands-on individual contributor and grow into managing a mix of FTEs and contractors as the function scales.

Here's what the role looks like:

Own the pipeline number. Carry the marketing-sourced pipeline target for your campaigns, manage full-funnel performance from lead to closed-won, and run weekly readouts with cross-functional leads.

Architect the integrated campaign portfolio. Design and run campaigns end-to-end including audience targeting, messaging activation, channel mix, content requirements, calendar, and budget allocation that are all tied to pipeline outcomes, not activity metrics.

Lead the campaign strategy AND execution. You’re well-versed on connecting all of the teams that support an integrated campaign. That means briefing with PMM on messaging, Brand on creatives, Digital on paid motions, Lifecycle on nurture, ABM and BDRs on account plays, and Sales on follow-up SLAs. You not only identify all of the internal levers to pull, you create the motion to activate and track all of your launch partners.

Run an agile campaign engine. Operate inside our sprint-based pod model: brief, build, launch, learn, scale or sunset — in weeks, not quarters.

Optimize budget like a P&L owner. Allocate against pipeline-per-dollar, reallocate based on evidence, and manage agency and contractor resources to extend capacity.

Apply AI-first thinking. Use AI tooling to increase campaign velocity, sharpen personalization, and improve targeting precision across all three growth motions.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You are a pipeline owner, not a program manager. You sign up for a number and build the system to hit it.
  • You are a player-coach: comfortable executing hands-on today and building a team tomorrow.
  • You orchestrate across various teams. You align pods, agencies, and stakeholders through crisp briefs, RACIs, and DRIs, not meetings.
  • You think full-funnel: awareness through expansion, not just MQLs.
  • You show the receipts: dashboards, cohort analysis, insights, and blameless post-mortems to drive applied learnings for future iterations.
  • You thrive at speed. You ship campaigns in weeks, not quarters. You’re nimble and able to comfortably pivot like a pro when priorities shift.

YOUR SKILL-SET

Must-haves:

  • 10+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation or growth marketing, with 3+ years owning a marketing-sourced pipeline target.
  • Proven experience operating an integrated campaign model: one campaign architecture spanning paid, email, events, ABM, webinars, and content, with shared goals across teams.
  • Track record of building demand engines at fast-paced, high-growth companies and moving at startup velocity.
  • Experience orchestrating cross-functional teams (PMM, brand, digital, BDR, sales) to a shared revenue goal.
  • Fluency in funnel math: conversion rates, velocity, CAC, pipeline coverage models.
  • Hands-on with Salesforce, Marketo, and ABM platforms (Demandbase or 6sense).

Nice-to-haves:

  • Vertical marketing experience in healthcare or FSI.
  • Experience launching demand for a new product line (0-to-1 pipeline motion).

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About the Revenue team

The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. GTM Strategy & Operations takes product and pricing initiatives and creates commercially viable, operationally sound go-to-market motions. We partner with Product, Product Marketing, Legal, Rev Ops, and Pricing to design rollout groups, coordinate implementation, and equip the field — CSMs, AEs, and TAMs — with the processes they need to create world-class go-to-market. As an individual contributor, the Lead owns the go-to-market for a specific product line or segment end to end. You're handed the objective ("drive adoption for this new feature") and you decide how: the rollout plan, the enablement, the tracking. You turn half-formed product and pricing inputs into a plan a rep can actually execute.

  • Own the go-to-market for a product line or segment end to end — rollout design, enablement, and the adoption target you're driving toward.

  • Turn inputs from cross-functional stakeholders like Product, Pricing, and PMM into a coherent GTM strategy, and track adoption against goal.

  • Build and maintain the materials, processes, and playbooks the field needs.

  • Sit close to the field, and turn what you hear into recommendations for Product Marketing.

  • Analyze performance data to find where a launch is stalling, and flag risks early.

jobs.excerpt: This role migrates a SQL Server enterprise data warehouse and its SSIS integration layer from Azure to AWS — the Microsoft data stack, not the open-source one.
jobs.description:
This role migrates a SQL Server enterprise data warehouse and its SSIS integration layer from Azure to AWS — the Microsoft data stack, not the open-source one. The scope for year one: 70% of the client's data workloads still run on this SQL Server warehouse (the remaining 30% has already moved to Databricks), with 1,060 stored procedure call dependencies from pipelines that must keep resolving through the migration. The SSIS package estate (SSISDB) loads the Operational Data Store and the warehouse, driven by configurable runtime values, and the ODS→EDW→BI dependency chain — including PowerShell-triggered SSIS runs for CRM and core business application feeds — must stay intact throughout.

Requirements

What you will do

  • Migrate the SQL Server enterprise data warehouse from Azure VMs to AWS, preserving the ODS to EDW to BI dependency chain.

  • Move and re-point SSIS packages, including those triggered by PowerShell after upstream file downloads.

  • Keep 600+ stored procedures and 1,060 pipeline call dependencies working, and refactor the ones that cannot come across as-is.

  • Reconcile row counts and business measures against source before cutover.

Required

  • Real experience building and operating SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) packages. Central to this role.

  • Advanced T-SQL: able to read a 500-line stored procedure and explain what it actually does.

  • SQL Server Enterprise Edition in production, including performance tuning.

  • Dimensional modeling: star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and the judgment to know when to rebuild versus lift-and-shift.

  • Working-level AWS (EC2, RDS, S3); certification expected within the first year if not already held.

  • Proven experience validating that a migrated warehouse is correct, not just moved.

  • Professional written and spoken English.

Nice to have

SSRS, SSAS/OLAP cubes, Power BI, AWS DMS, AWS Glue, Databricks, Python, PowerShell, Informatica, dbt, financial services reporting, CRM data.

Engagement details

  • Full-time

  • Start date: February 2027

  • Open to candidates from all LATAM

Highlights

SQL Server, SSIS, T-SQL, Dimensional Modeling, AWS (EC2, RDS, S3), SSRS, SSAS/OLAP, Power BI, AWS DMS, AWS Glue, Databricks, Python, PowerShell, Informatica, dbt

At Havenpark Communities, our mission is to make caring communities attainable for responsible residents across America. We acquire, improve, and operate manufactured home communities. You may be asking yourself - what makes us different? It is our culture. Our unique culture is fun, rewarding, and inclusive of all. Our five core values guide our everyday behavior: Respect, Grit, Collaboration, Stewardship, and Boldness.

As Utilities Manager, you'll own recapture performance end to end: a minimum of 90% on water, sewer, and stormwater, and 100% on trash, at every community where costs are billable to residents. This is a player coach role. You'll lead a team of analysts, set their priorities, and hold them accountable, while staying hands on with rate analysis, billback launches, submetering, and vendor contracts yourself. You'll work daily with accounting, legal, community managers, and outside vendors, and residents will feel the difference when you get it right.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership

  • Give every community a named owner for recapture performance, either an assigned analyst or yourself
  • Run a monthly cadence: review results against the 90%/100% targets, work the miss list community by community, and track every item to a named owner and date
  • Review analyst work before it reaches leadership; rate analyses and billback recommendations need to be right the first time
  • Coach analysts on rate analysis and state compliance so the whole team gets sharper
  • Catch performance issues early, whether the problem is a community underbilling or an analyst not moving their list

Utility Recapture and Reporting

  • Own the monthly recapture cycle: expense versus resident billing income by community, fund, and utility line
  • Investigate every miss and document the root cause, whether it's rates, billing setup, occupancy, or a provider increase nobody caught
  • Maintain the billback opportunity pipeline, and drive it from rate analysis through first bill
  • Flag over recapture as well as under recapture, and prepare the executive roll ups for P&L calls

Billing Operations

  • Manage rate table changes and new billback launches in the billing platform (ManageAmerica or similar), including high and low read exception review
  • Audit provider invoices against resident billing to confirm pass through accuracy

Submetering

  • Oversee the installation pipeline across properties and vendors, from contract through permitting, install, and billing activation
  • Keep the master submetering contracts tracker current across the portfolio

Contracts and Vendors

  • Negotiate and manage waste hauler, cable, and internet agreements, including rate escalation terms
  • Route agreements through legal, and track renewals so nothing expires by accident

Compliance

  • Maintain the rate notice compliance tracker across every operating state
  • Keep Havenpark at 100% legal compliance on notice timelines and content, no exceptions

Budgeting

  • Build annual utility budgets from trailing actuals, provider rate schedules, and contract terms
  • Support the broader budget cycle with utility trend analysis

What You Bring

  • 4+ years in utility management, property operations, or revenue or financial analysis
  • Real people management experience: you set expectations, review work, and have the hard conversation when someone isn't hitting their numbers
  • Advanced Excel skills, comfortable in large GL exports
  • Working knowledge of multi state utility pass through regulation, or the ability to build it fast
  • Strong vendor negotiation skills
  • Clear written communication; you'll draft resident notices, regulator responses, and executive summaries

    • Nice to Have

  • Experience with utility billing platforms like ManageAmerica or Conservice
  • A track record running multiple recurring cycles (reporting, notices, renewals) without a dropped ball

If you'd rather find the root cause of a recapture miss than just report it, and you get real satisfaction from a team that hits its numbers, this is your role.

Apply now and take ownership of a portfolio that's counting on you to close the gap.

We offer our employees a golden work experience, including a competitive salary, comprehensive health benefits, generous PTO, paid holidays, a 401(k) with a 6% company match, and above all, infinite opportunities to learn, develop, and sharpen their skills. Come be a part of a company that knows what it means to succeed as a team.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Coupa Integration Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$170,000 Annually
Experience Required: 8+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a Coupa Integration Developer to design, develop, and maintain integrations between Coupa BSM (Business Spend Management) and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on Coupa Integration Cloud, API-based integrations, supplier onboarding flows, and data synchronization between Coupa and ERP, finance, HR, and payment systems. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful Coupa integrations in production, understands the source-to-pay process end-to-end, and applies disciplined integration engineering practices. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop integrations between Coupa and enterprise systems including ERP, finance, payroll, and supplier networks.
  • Build integrations using Coupa Integration Cloud, Coupa Open APIs, and middleware platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Workato.
  • Implement supplier onboarding integrations including supplier master, contracts, and catalog data flows.
  • Develop integrations supporting requisition, purchase order, invoice, and payment processes.
  • Implement chart-of-accounts, expense category, and lookup data synchronization between Coupa and source systems.
  • Build user, role, and approval-hierarchy synchronization between Coupa and identity systems.
  • Design error handling, retry, and reconciliation strategies for integration flows.
  • Implement integration security across Coupa endpoints, including OAuth flows, SSO patterns, and certificate-based authentication, ensuring that integration credentials follow least-privilege and lifecycle best practices.
  • Profile and optimize integration performance and batch sizing for high-volume scenarios, applying systematic measurement, targeted improvements, and data-driven validation to deliver quantifiable gains in throughput, latency, or resource efficiency.
  • Participate in Coupa release planning, regression testing, and platform upgrades.
  • Collaborate with procurement, finance, and IT stakeholders on integration requirements.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Support production incidents related to Coupa integrations and drive durable fixes.
  • Stay current with Coupa releases and BSM platform evolution, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of integration engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience integrating Coupa with enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of Coupa Integration Cloud and Coupa Open APIs.
  • Experience with at least one major iPaaS such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Workato.
  • Strong understanding of source-to-pay and procure-to-pay processes.
  • Solid SQL and data transformation skills.
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, and integration security.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Coupa certifications.
  • Experience integrating Coupa with SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite ERP systems.
  • Familiarity with Coupa Pay, Coupa Risk Assess, or Coupa Treasury.
  • Exposure to supplier-network integrations.
  • Experience supporting global BSM rollouts.

Review CRFs (electronic or paper) and subject source documentation for validity and accuracy

Verify proper management and accountability of Investigational Product

Timely reporting of actions taken during monitoring visits in Monitoring Visit Report including findings, corrective and preventive actions already taken and update applicable tracking systems, as required; escalate observed deficiencies and issues as appropriate.

Providing site with the listing of issues identified during monitoring visit and action items which will need to be addressed in a timely manner.

project tracking,

monitoring plans,

Review of monitoring reports

CRA resources management within the project

May act as a mentor to CRAs.

May develop and implement therapeutic area training for other CRAs and project team members.

May participate in capabilities presentations.

Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in life science or nursing; or equivalent

  • 5 years of independent on-site monitoring experience and at least 1 year experience as an unmasked monitor is required.

At least 1 year Ophthalmology, ideally within a retina indication (i.e. Age-related Macular Degeneration, Diabetic Macular Edema, Geographic Atrophy, RVO, BRVO, CRVO, etc.), experience is preferred.

Able to work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

Understand basic medical terminology and science associated with the assigned drugs and therapeutic areas.

Possess the understanding of Good Clinical Practice regulations, ICH guidelines.

Ability to work independently as well as in a team matrix organization.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Fluent in English and local language

Excellent organizational skills

Technology savvy and good software and computer skills

Soft skills requirements: Self-awareness, resolute, flexibility, collaborative mindset, proactivity, analytic approach, and attention to detail, coach ability, motivated to take on new challenges, facilitation of discussion, diplomacy in difficult situations.

Ability to take the ownership of the assigned tasks.

Ability to manage complex or early phases studies.

Ability and willingness to travel up to 60-80%, overnight and abroad, if applicable.

We provide a competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You’ll be joining a team that values collaboration, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of patients

Our journey began over 25 years ago in Sweden, in the city of Lund. We currently operate in 17 countries across Europe, North America, Asia Pacific and the Middle East.

Our core values of Trust, Quality, Flexibility and Passion are what make TFS Healthscience the successful company it is today. Our values shape our culture and work ethic. They reflect what we stand for and guide our organization.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

The world’s finest art, automobiles, and antiques are sold at auction—so too is luxury real estate. Enter the smart way to buy and sell luxury properties. Our expert team curates the world’s finest properties, matches them with the most capable property connoisseurs from across the globe, and facilitates easy, market-driven transactions.

Since 2008, we have closed over $5B in luxury properties, with the typical sale ranging between $2.5M and $30M—and are dominating the $20M-plus industry. Our business has spanned the globe, including 46 US states and 38 countries, and we host a database of nearly 1 billion global contacts. Majority owned by Sotheby’s, the world’s premier destination for fine art and luxury goods, and Compass (NYSE: COMP), Concierge Auctions continues to operate independently, partnering with real estate agents affiliated with many of the industry's leading brokerages to host luxury property auctions for clients.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

Concierge Auctions is hiring an IT Administrator to own the day-to-day administration of our core internal systems, with a primary focus on Google Workspace and Rippling. This person is the first point of contact for employee technology needs — accounts, devices, access, and everyday troubleshooting — and keeps onboarding and offboarding running smoothly and securely.

Beyond day-to-day administration, this role is a direct partner on a strategic initiative: building a unified access control layer across all Concierge Auctions applications and systems. Working alongside our technology lead, this person will help inventory every system we use, define role-based access standards, consolidate identity and provisioning, and automate how access is granted, reviewed, and revoked across the company.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role well suited to someone with 1–3 years of IT support or systems administration experience who wants ownership of a modern, cloud-first stack and real exposure to identity and access management (IAM) architecture.

Requirements

Google Workspace administration

  • Manage users, groups, organizational units, and aliases in the Google Admin console
  • Administer Gmail, Drive, shared drives, Calendar, Meet, and Groups settings
  • Enforce security policies: 2-step verification, app access controls, third-party OAuth review, and device management
  • Monitor admin audit and login reports; investigate suspicious activity and respond to phishing reports
  • Manage license assignment and storage usage; handle data retention, exports, and account transfers on departures

Rippling administration

  • Maintain employee records, org structure, and role-based permissions in Rippling
  • Build and run onboarding and offboarding workflows, including app provisioning and de-provisioning
  • Administer app management and SSO connections for third-party tools
  • Support device inventory, enrollment, and MDM policies through Rippling
  • Partner with HR and Finance on employee lifecycle changes, reporting, and app spend visibility

Access control layer (major initiative)

This person will work directly with our technology lead to design, build, and operate a company-wide access control layer. Expect roughly 30–40% of the role to be dedicated to this initiative.

  • Build and maintain a complete inventory of applications, systems, and data stores, including owners, sensitivity, and current access methods
  • Help define a role-based access control (RBAC) model that maps job roles and departments to standardized permission sets
  • Consolidate authentication behind SSO where possible; document exceptions and plan remediation for systems that cannot integrate
  • Implement automated provisioning and de-provisioning so access follows the employee lifecycle (hire, transfer, promote, depart) without manual steps
  • Build recurring access review workflows and produce evidence that reviews were completed
  • Instrument logging and alerting for privileged access, permission changes, and anomalous sign-ins
  • Document access policies, request and approval paths, and break-glass procedures; keep them current in Notion
  • Track and report on progress: systems covered, percentage behind SSO, orphaned accounts closed, average time to provision and de-provision

End-user support and IT operations

  • Serve as first-line support for hardware, software, account, and access requests
  • Track, prioritize, and resolve tickets within agreed response targets; escalate when needed
  • Prepare, image, ship, and recover laptops and peripherals for a distributed workforce
  • Maintain accurate asset inventory and license records
  • Write and maintain internal documentation, how-to guides, and IT onboarding materials in Notion
  • Support conference room A/V, VPN, printers, and other office technology as needed

Security and compliance

  • Apply least-privilege access principles across all managed systems
  • Run periodic access reviews and confirm timely removal of departed users
  • Assist with security awareness reminders and incident response tasks
  • Follow documented change and approval procedures for policy or permission changes

Required qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in IT support, helpdesk, or systems administration
  • Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace (users, groups, security settings, admin console)
  • Experience with an HRIS or IT lifecycle platform — Rippling strongly preferred (Gusto, Justworks, BambooHR, or Okta/JumpCloud experience considered)
  • Working knowledge of macOS and Windows support, plus basic networking (DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi)
  • Comfort with SaaS app administration, SSO, and role-based permission models
  • Genuine interest in identity and access management, and the patience to do the inventory, documentation, and cleanup work that a real access control program requires
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain technical topics to non-technical staff
  • Strong organizational habits, discretion with confidential data, and a bias toward documentation

Preferred qualifications

  • Google Workspace Administrator certification or CompTIA A+ / Network+
  • Experience supporting a fully remote or hybrid workforce
  • Familiarity with MDM tooling, endpoint security, or device compliance programs
  • Basic scripting or automation experience (Apps Script, Python, or similar) and comfort working with app APIs or SCIM provisioning
  • Exposure to IAM tooling (Okta, JumpCloud, Entra ID) or to SOC 2 / access review and audit processes
  • Exposure to Slack, Zoom, Notion, Salesforce, or Atlassian administration


    Success in the First 90 Days
  • 30 days: Fully ramped on Google Workspace and Rippling configuration; handling routine tickets independently
  • 60 days: Onboarding and offboarding checklists documented and running end to end without escalation; draft RBAC role-to-permission map in review
  • 90 days: Completed a full access review, cleaned up license and asset inventory, published core IT documentation, and delivered a full application and access inventory as the foundation of the access control layer

Benefits

  • Employment type: Contract
  • Reports to: Technology leadership
  • Location: Remote

Restb.ai is seeking a VP of Industry Relations to be our senior voice in the Multiple Listing Service (MLS) and enterprise brokerage community. Reporting to the President of the MLS Division, you will be the executive face of Restb.ai to MLS leadership and large brokerages — building trust, moving strategic deals across the finish line, and representing the company on the industry’s most visible stages.

You bring deep MLS domain knowledge, a genuine network of C-suite relationships, and the credibility to sit as a peer with MLS CEOs, boards, and brokerage leaders. Equally important, you can tell the story of where the industry - and Restb.ai - is heading, including the next generation of AI-native capabilities now under development. You are as comfortable closing an enterprise agreement as you are keynoting a panel or briefing a board on what agentic AI means for their business.

What You Will Work On

  • Serve as an executive-level peer to Tier 1 MLS CEOs, boards of directors, and large brokerage leadership.

  • Willingness and ability to travel significantly (approximately 40–50%) for face-to-face executive meetings and national conferences.

What You Can Expect

  • Compensation: The base salary for this position ranges from $158,000 to $200,000 annually, depending on your location, experience, and qualifications. Additional compensation offerings include a company profit-sharing bonus program, communication stipends, and referral bonuses.
  • Inclusive benefits package offering:
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and company paid vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, voluntary life and AD&D insurance options, voluntary supplemental insurances for accident, critical illness, and legal services, paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays, employee assistance and wellness programs, company paid short term disability coverage, company contributions to health saving funds (with participation in the high deductible health plan. We offer company-paid access to Galileo for virtual primary care and Rula for virtual mental health resources.
  • Career and skill development resources to help advance your career and personal growth.
  • A mission-driven environment where your work makes a measurable impact on the real estate industry.
  • Enjoy competitive compensation, performance incentives, and comprehensive benefits.

What We Value

  • At Restb.ai, we believe our people are what make the company work. We’re a team, a community, and a well-oiled wheel where everyone plays an important part.
  • We value collaboration, open communication, and the belief that everyone’s voice matters. Ideas are welcomed, considered, and shared, no matter where they come from. We support each other, celebrate each other’s wins, and genuinely want to see the people around us grow.

About Us

Restb.ai is the computer-vision leader for real estate, turning property imagery into structured intelligence used across the listing, valuation, and transaction lifecycle. Now part of Clear Capital and combined with CubiCasa, Restb.ai is at the center of one of the industry's most complete property-data ecosystems, bringing together visual intelligence, valuation, appraisal, and spatial data at national scale.

As we continue to grow, we're helping shape the future of how real estate companies understand and use property data. jobs.excerpt: About the Role We are seeking a Sr.  Director, Engineering to lead AI-first transformation across customer-facing SaaS product engineering capabilities.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Sr. Director, Engineering to lead AI-first transformation across customer-facing SaaS product engineering capabilities. This leader will shape technical direction, drive engineering excellence, and deliver scalable, reliable, and high-impact product outcomes in a highly matrixed, globally distributed environment.

This is a people leadership role that requires deep software engineering roots. The successful candidate will be credible with senior engineers and architects, comfortable engaging in critical system design and architecture decisions, and able to translate complex technical direction into clear product, customer, and business outcomes.

The role is accountable for engineering delivery outcomes and technical direction while operating through senior engineering leaders, technical leaders, architects, and cross-functional partners. The ideal candidate is a constructive challenger who can question legacy assumptions, elevate engineering standards, and guide mature SaaS capabilities toward an AI-first future.

Key Responsibilities

AI-First Product and Engineering Transformation

  • Lead the evolution of customer-facing SaaS product engineering capabilities from a mature SaaS model toward an AI-first product and engineering model.
  • Drive AI-enabled product innovation that improves customer workflows, decision support, automation, insight generation, and product differentiation.
  • Apply practical understanding of GenAI tools and AI-assisted engineering practices to improve SDLC effectiveness, developer productivity, software quality, testing, documentation, and modernization efforts.
  • Partner with product, architecture, security, privacy, data governance, and responsible AI stakeholders so AI-enabled capabilities are implemented thoughtfully within enterprise standards.

Engineering Strategy, Architecture, and System Design

  • Define and communicate technical direction for customer-facing SaaS product engineering capabilities in alignment with product strategy, business priorities, and long-term platform evolution.
  • Provide deep technical leadership in architecture reviews, system design discussions, and critical engineering tradeoff decisions.
  • Guide the design and modernization of large-scale distributed systems, cloud-native services, APIs, data-intensive product platforms, and integrated user experiences.
  • Challenge existing technical approaches and identify opportunities to improve scalability, reliability, performance, security, maintainability, cost efficiency, and customer value.
  • Raise the engineering bar around system design, design discipline, architectural decision-making, and long-term technical sustainability.

SaaS Product Engineering Delivery

  • Drive engineering delivery outcomes across complex, customer-facing SaaS product capabilities while ensuring alignment across Product, Architecture, Engineering, and Business stakeholders.
  • Translate product and business goals into executable engineering direction, prioritization, and delivery plans through senior engineering leaders and technical leaders.
  • Balance new AI-first capability development with modernization of mature enterprise SaaS systems, technical debt reduction, and continuity of existing customer commitments.
  • Improve measurable engineering outcomes, including delivery predictability, release quality, engineering productivity, modernization progress, and customer-impacting delivery velocity.
  • Contribute to planning, prioritization, resource allocation, and engineering investment tradeoff decisions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders.

Production Excellence and Engineering Operations

  • Ensure customer-facing SaaS capabilities are designed, delivered, and operated with strong standards for reliability, availability, scalability, performance, security, and quality.
  • Strengthen engineering practices across CI/CD, test automation, observability, operational readiness, incident learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Promote a production-first mindset that treats operability, supportability, resiliency, and cost efficiency as core design considerations.
  • Use engineering metrics and operational signals to identify systemic issues, improve team effectiveness, and guide technical and organizational improvements.

Leadership, Talent, and Matrixed Influence

  • Lead through direct leadership accountability, senior technical credibility, and matrixed influence across Engineering, Product, Architecture, Business, and enabling functions.
  • Develop and mentor Directors, Senior Managers, Principal Engineers, and senior technical talent, building leadership capacity and raising the technical bar across teams.
  • Create a culture of ownership, accountability, constructive challenge, customer focus, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Align globally distributed teams across time zones, cultures, and organizational boundaries.
  • Communicate clearly with executive, technical, and non-technical audiences, translating complex engineering topics into business-relevant decisions and outcomes.

Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 15+ years of progressive technology and software engineering leadership experience.
  • Proven experience leading and developing senior engineering leaders and technical leaders, including Directors, Senior Managers, Principal Engineers, or equivalent roles.
  • Demonstrated success leading engineering for customer-facing enterprise SaaS products, data-intensive platforms, analytics products, or comparable large-scale commercial software platforms.
  • Experience driving engineering transformation across mature SaaS environments, including modernization, technical debt reduction, quality improvement, and delivery acceleration.
  • Current experience leading AI-enabled product capability development within enterprise SaaS or comparable commercial software environments.
  • Experience applying GenAI tools and AI-assisted practices within engineering workflows to improve software delivery, quality, developer productivity, or modernization outcomes.
  • Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams in a matrixed organization.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep software engineering background with strong system design, distributed systems, and architecture experience.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, scalable platform design, data-intensive systems, API design, integration patterns, performance optimization, reliability engineering, and enterprise architecture principles.
  • Prior hands-on engineering experience and leadership familiarity with technologies used by modern SaaS teams, including Java, Python, Angular, Azure cloud services, and AI/GenAI technologies and frameworks.
  • Ability to evaluate architectural options, challenge design assumptions, and guide technical tradeoffs across speed, quality, scalability, cost, security, maintainability, and customer impact.
  • Strong understanding of modern software development practices, including Agile delivery, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, secure engineering practices, and production operations.

Leadership Capabilities

  • Transformative mindset with the ability to move teams from established SaaS operating models toward AI-first product and engineering approaches.
  • Ability to challenge the status quo constructively, challenge self and teams to improve, and bring others along through influence, clarity, and technical credibility.
  • Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • High accountability for engineering outcomes, customer impact, and business-aligned execution.
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, make decisions with incomplete information, and create alignment across competing priorities.
  • Strong coaching and talent development skills, with a track record of building high-performing engineering leadership teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading AI-driven product transformation initiatives that created measurable customer value or commercial impact.
  • Experience with modern AI/GenAI application patterns, orchestration frameworks, model integration, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, or AI-enabled analytics experiences.
  • Experience in retail, CPG, consumer measurement, market intelligence, data analytics, or adjacent data-rich enterprise domains.
  • Background working in product-led technology organizations with close partnership across Product Management, Design, Architecture, Data Science, Security, and Business stakeholders.
  • Experience improving engineering operating models through metrics, platform thinking, engineering productivity practices, and production excellence.

What Success Looks Like

  • AI-enabled product capabilities are being delivered with clear customer value, measurable product impact, and strong engineering foundations.
  • GenAI-enabled engineering practices are adopted in practical, measurable ways that improve productivity, quality, modernization, and developer effectiveness.
  • Mature SaaS capabilities are modernized without compromising reliability, performance, security, customer commitments, or delivery predictability.
  • Architecture and system design decisions are clearer, better documented, and aligned with long-term platform and product direction.
  • Engineering leaders and senior technical talent are operating at a higher bar, with stronger ownership, accountability, and technical judgment.
  • Product, Architecture, Engineering, Business, and enabling stakeholders are aligned around priorities, investment tradeoffs, and delivery outcomes.
  • Customer-facing systems demonstrate measurable improvements in reliability, scalability, performance, quality, and speed of innovation.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a deeply technical engineering leader who has grown into a strategic product engineering executive. They have strong software engineering roots, deep system design judgment, and the credibility to engage senior engineers and architects on complex technical tradeoffs.

They have led enterprise SaaS product transformation, with particular strength in applying AI and GenAI to customer-facing product capabilities. They also understand how AI can improve engineering practices, but they treat AI adoption as a means to improve customer value, quality, speed, and differentiation rather than as a technology trend by itself.

They are a constructive challenger: intellectually curious, self-critical, comfortable questioning legacy approaches, and skilled at bringing people along in a highly matrixed environment. They combine technical depth, people leadership, product orientation, and execution discipline to create durable impact across distributed teams.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent, our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate, the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

Your role

We're looking for a Sales Manager to lead the new business team at Workleap. Reporting directly to the VP of Revenue, you'll own one of the most important bets we're making right now: bringing the Workleap Agent to market and building the team, systems, and culture to do it well. This isn't a quota-management role. It's a coaching, strategy, and execution role — you'll lead from the front, set the standard for what great looks like, and make sure the field and the go-to-market strategy are always in sync.

Your impact:

  • Drive quarterly new business ARR targets by building the conditions for every AE on your team to perform at their best — not just tracking numbers, but actively removing blockers and sharpening the play;
  • Coach a team of AEs across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments through consistent pipeline reviews, call shadowing, and growth conversations that actually move people forward;
  • Own the sales strategy end to end — define it, implement it, and iterate on it to improve conversion rates and deal velocity;
  • Deliver reliable, data-driven forecasts to the VP of Revenue so leadership can make clear decisions with confidence;
  • Build a tight feedback loop between sales, marketing, and product so what the field hears directly shapes how Workleap evolves;
  • Integrate AI tools into the team's daily workflow — from Gong for call intelligence to Claude for prep and enablement — to raise the ceiling on what a lean team can do.

Your team

You'll lead a team of 5 Account Executives covering English and French Canadian markets across SMB through Enterprise. The timing is deliberate — Workleap made a calculated move away from being a suite of HR point solutions and went all-in on something bigger: an agentic HR platform that works alongside managers, not just sits in their stack.

The Workleap Agent is that product, and your team is on the front lines of bringing that story to market for the first time. You'll inherit a team with real wins, real pipeline, and real momentum — and the challenge is to turn that into a repeatable, scalable machine.

What you'll bring

  • +2 years of sales leadership experience in B2B SaaS — HRtech or adjacent is a strong asset;
  • A strong track record as an AE or in business development with consistent quota overachievement — you know what good looks like because you've lived it;
  • A reputation as a genuine sales coach who can lift a team's capabilities fast, not just manage performance after the fact;
  • Discipline around pipeline management and CRM forecasting — you work with data, not around it;
  • Clear, direct communication that lands equally well with your team and at the leadership table;
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where information is imperfect and priorities shift;
  • Daily fluency with AI tools — Claude, Gong, HubSpot, Microsoft 365 — as real work accelerators, not experiments you're still warming up to.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
  • RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gathering twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. We are seeking an experienced Robotics Software Engineer to design, build, and integrate software systems that power autonomous robots and robotic platforms. In this role you will work across the full robotics software stack, from low-level sensor integration and motion planning to high-level perception and behavioral systems. jobs.description:
About the Job:

The Enterprise team builds LaunchDarkly for the customers who push it hardest. Global banks, national health systems, and Fortune 100 manufacturers run us across thousands of engineers and tens of thousands of flags, inside audit and change control processes most software never meets.

That scale breaks things that work fine everywhere else. A permissions model designed for a hundred users can be the reason a rollout to twenty thousand stalls. Volume creates a different class of problem, where a flag payload that costs nothing to deliver once gets expensive across a large service fleet. Your work is to find where a current design stops holding and build what replaces it. You will own that end to end, in Go on the backend and TypeScript and React on the frontend.

The problems fall into a few areas:

  • Governance and access control. Roles, permissions, approvals, and audit trails that satisfy a regulator.
  • Scale and performance. Finding the limit before the customer does, then changing the design rather than tuning around it.
  • Programmatic control. Our public API, Terraform provider, and configuration surfaces, so a platform team can run LaunchDarkly as infrastructure.
  • Resilience under real constraints. Data residency, regional isolation, and sane behavior when a dependency is degraded.

Enterprise runs closer to its own business than most product teams. Roughly half the roadmap traces back to requests from named customers, so you will often know who is waiting on your work and what it unblocks for them. You will speak with those customers directly. The other half is larger forward-looking work, where the brief is a capability our biggest customers will need rather than one they have already asked for.

Responsibilities:

  • Own features end to end: problem framing with your PM and designer, technical design, implementation across backend and frontend, rollout, and the operational life of the thing after it ships.
  • Design for enterprise constraints from the start. Permissions and access control, approval and audit requirements, data residency and regional isolation, and the behavior of the system when a region or dependency is degraded.
  • Find and fix scalability and performance limits before customers do. Identify where a current design stops holding at the top end of our customer base, quantify it, and lead the work to change it.
  • Make LaunchDarkly manageable at fleet scale. Extend our public API, Terraform provider, and configuration surfaces so a platform team can operate LaunchDarkly as infrastructure rather than click through it.
  • Work directly with customers. Join escalations and discovery calls, read the support and account signal, and turn a specific customer's problem into something that serves the whole segment rather than a one-off.
  • Raise operability of what the team owns. Observability, runbooks, and participation in the on-call rotation, plus the follow-through after an incident.
  • Drive alignment beyond your own team. Enterprise depends on and is depended on by several other teams, so surfacing a misalignment early and getting the right people in a room is a real part of the job at this level.
  • Mentor and review. Give substantive review on specifications and pull requests, including for engineers on neighboring teams, and help newer engineers get faster.

Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of features you drove from design through production.
  • Genuine full stack ability. Strong in a statically typed backend language and comfortable owning frontend work rather than handing it off. Our stack is Go on the backend and TypeScript and React on the frontend.

jobs.excerpt: Chez Fresche Solutions, nous offrons un excellent équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée avec des horaires flexibles.
jobs.description:
Chez Fresche Solutions, nous offrons un excellent équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée avec des horaires flexibles. Vous pouvez travailler n'importe où en Amérique du Nord... que ce soit depuis votre domicile ou dans l'un de nos bureaux... la décision vous appartient.

POURQUOI REJOINDRE FRESCHE ? Nous croyons en notre rôle de leader dans notre secteur, nous croyons en l'innovation, nous croyons en la satisfaction de nos clients, en garantissant leur succès et en nous assurant que 100 % de nos clients peuvent servir de référence.

Notre culture d'entreprise distincte fait de nous un employeur de choix, ainsi qu'un choix de premier plan pour nos clients depuis onze (11) années consécutives. Nous travaillons sans relâche pour que nos valeurs imprègnent l'entreprise et se reflètent dans tout ce que nous faisons. Qu'il s'agisse de fixer des priorités, de définir des idées ou d'exécuter des processus, nous nous engageons à ce que nos valeurs se manifestent à tous les niveaux de notre organisation.

Êtes-vous intéressé(e) à aider les organisations à faire un meilleur usage de leurs données et de leurs analyses ? Nous recherchons un(e) Représentant(e) en développement des affaires (BDR) qui aidera à construire le pipeline de ventes pour Fresche Analytics, en connectant les organisations avec des solutions qui améliorent le reporting, la visibilité financière, l'intelligence d'affaires (BI) et la prise de décision basée sur les données.

Fresche Solutions aide les organisations à moderniser leurs applications, leurs données et leurs environnements technologiques. Grâce à Fresche Analytics, nous aidons les clients à tirer une plus grande valeur de leurs données en utilisant des solutions modernes d'analyse, de reporting, d'IA et de données basées sur Microsoft.

Résumé du poste

En tant que Représentant(e) en développement des affaires (BDR) – Fresche Analytics, vous serez un membre crucial de notre équipe de vente, responsable de la génération de leads qualifiés et de la construction d'un solide pipeline d'opportunités Analytics.

Un point central de ce rôle sera d'engager les directeurs financiers (CFO), les leaders de la finance, les équipes FP&A (Planification et analyse financières), les contrôleurs et d'autres parties prenantes de l'entreprise qui peuvent bénéficier d'une amélioration du reporting financier, des analyses et de l'accès aux données d'entreprise.

Votre objectif principal sera d'identifier de manière proactive les comptes cibles, d'engager les décideurs clés, de qualifier les opportunités potentielles et de planifier des réunions d'introduction de haute qualité pour l'équipe de vente Analytics.

Responsabilités

Prospection proactive

  • Identifier et rechercher des clients potentiels et des comptes cibles pour les solutions Fresche Analytics.
  • Identifier les décideurs clés, y compris les directeurs financiers (CFO), les leaders de la finance, les équipes FP&A, les contrôleurs et les leaders de l'analytique.
  • Utiliser des outils de prospection tels que LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo et des bases de données de l'industrie pour créer des listes de prospects ciblées.

Sensibilisation et engagement

  • Mener des actions de prospection sortante par téléphone, e-mail, LinkedIn et d'autres canaux pour susciter l'intérêt pour Fresche Analytics.
  • Articuler clairement la manière dont les solutions d'analyse peuvent améliorer le reporting financier, l'intelligence d'affaires, la visibilité des données et la prise de décision.
  • Adapter l'approche en fonction de l'industrie du prospect, de ses défis commerciaux, de son rôle et de son environnement technologique existant.

Qualification des leads

  • Mener des conversations de découverte initiales pour comprendre l'environnement actuel du prospect en matière de reporting, d'analyse et de données.
  • Identifier les défis tels que le reporting manuel, la dépendance aux feuilles de calcul, les données fragmentées, la visibilité limitée ou les processus de reporting financier inefficaces.
  • Déterminer si les prospects ont un besoin potentiel pour les solutions Fresche Analytics.
  • Documenter avec précision les informations de qualification dans Salesforce et les plateformes d'engagement commercial.

Planification de réunions

  • Planifier des réunions d'introduction qualifiées entre les clients potentiels et l'équipe de vente Analytics.
  • Fournir un contexte clair concernant les défis du prospect, ses priorités commerciales, les parties prenantes et l'opportunité potentielle.
  • Assurer un transfert fluide des opportunités qualifiées aux Chargés de compte (Account Executives).

Génération de pipeline

  • Générer de manière constante des leads et des opportunités Analytics qualifiés.
  • Établir des relations avec de nouvelles parties prenantes de la finance et des affaires au sein des comptes cibles.
  • Suivre et rendre compte des activités de génération de leads, des réunions, des opportunités et du pipeline généré.
  • Collaborer avec les ventes et le marketing pour affiner les campagnes sortantes et les messages axés sur l'analytique.

Gestion du CRM

  • Maintenir des registres précis et à jour des activités de prospection et des interactions dans Salesforce.
  • Suivre les progrès par rapport aux objectifs d'activité, de réunions, d'opportunités et de pipeline.
  • Maintenir des informations précises sur les comptes et les contacts pour soutenir les efforts de prospection en cours.

Connaissance du marché

  • Développer une forte compréhension du paysage des données et de l'analytique, y compris l'analytique financière, l'intelligence d'affaires, le reporting, l'IA et les plateformes de données modernes.
  • Rester informé(e) sur les solutions Fresche Analytics, les cas d'utilisation des clients et les propositions de valeur.
  • Développer une compréhension des défis commerciaux auxquels sont confrontés les directeurs financiers et les organisations financières.

Collaboration

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les Chargés de compte Analytics pour identifier les comptes prioritaires et générer des opportunités qualifiées.
  • Collaborer avec le marketing sur des campagnes ciblées axées sur l'analytique et la finance.
  • Partager des retours sur les objections des prospects, l'efficacité des messages, les tendances du marché et les points de douleur des clients.

Objectifs et indicateurs

  • Activité de prospection sortante constante par téléphone, e-mail et LinkedIn.
  • Réunions qualifiées : Générer environ 8 à 12 réunions Analytics qualifiées par mois.
  • Génération de pipeline : Contribuer constamment au pipeline qualifié pour Fresche Analytics.
  • Pénétration de comptes : Établir de nouvelles relations avec les parties prenantes de la finance et des affaires au sein des comptes ciblés.
  • Suivre la conversion des réunions, la création d'opportunités, le pipeline généré et l'efficacité globale des campagnes.

Qualifications

  • Expérience de succès démontrée dans un rôle de BDR, SDR, ventes internes ou développement des affaires, de préférence dans le domaine de la technologie, de l'analytique, du SaaS ou des services informatiques.
  • Expérience de prospection auprès de parties prenantes commerciales de haut niveau ; une expérience d'engagement auprès de directeurs financiers (CFO) ou de leaders de la finance est un atout.
  • Solides compétences en communication écrite et verbale.
  • Forte présence téléphonique et capacité à engager efficacement des décideurs de haut niveau.
  • Capacité à comprendre et à articuler des concepts analytiques et technologiques de manière claire et axée sur les affaires.
  • Motivé(e), orienté(e) résultats et à l'aise pour travailler de manière indépendante. • Solides compétences organisationnelles et en gestion du temps.
  • Maîtrise du CRM et des outils de prospection tels que Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesloft, Outreach ou des plateformes similaires.
  • Une expérience ou une familiarité avec l'analytique, le reporting financier, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data ou des technologies connexes est considérée comme un atout.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Salaire de base compétitif et structure de commissions basée sur les performances.
  • Programme d'avantages sociaux de premier ordre.
  • Outils et ressources de vente avancés avec un ensemble technologique (tech stack) fourni par l'entreprise.
  • Une culture de l'innovation et des équipes collaboratives axées sur le succès des clients.
  • Environnement entièrement à distance avec des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis et au Canada selon les besoins.
  • L'opportunité de jouer un rôle direct dans la construction et la croissance de l'activité Analytics de Fresche.
  • Si vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement des affaires, l'analytique et la création de nouvelles relations avec des dirigeants d'entreprise, nous aimerions vous connaître.

Nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances et nous nous engageons à favoriser un lieu de travail diversifié et inclusif. Nous ne faisons aucune discrimination fondée sur la race, la religion, la couleur, l'origine nationale, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'âge, l'état civil, le statut de vétéran ou le handicap.

About the Role

If you’re passionate about solving technical issues and providing high-quality support to a diverse community of users, this is the role for you. We’re seeking a motivated Support Engineer (Tier 1) to join our growing team of support professionals. You will serve as the face of the company for a large portion of our community, handling a broad range of tickets that will help flex your technical muscles.

As a Tier 1 engineer, you’ll be part of a distributed team focused on delivering excellent support and proactively solving friction by partnering with our broader CX team and Product/Eng. This role reports directly to the Tier 1 Support Team Lead and will play a key role in our journey.

  • Act as the primary technical resource for less complex issues, resolving a wide range of configuration and networking challenges to keep them unblocked.
  • Manage a high-velocity ticket queue with a consistent focus on meeting targets for time to first response and time to resolution.

Growth through diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an ethical business, we do what is right — including ensuring equal opportunities and fostering a safe, respectful workplace for each of us. We believe diversity fuels both personal and business growth. We're committed to building an inclusive community where all our people thrive regardless of their backgrounds, identities, or other personal characteristics.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Platform Design, Development & Evolution: Architect, build, and continuously evolve the core M&O platform and services, leveraging modern technologies and best practices to provide comprehensive observability and data quality functions.
  • Ensuring System Reliability & Performance: Actively maintain and enhance the stability, availability, and performance of critical applications and data infrastructure by integrating Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles directly into the platform's design and operation.
  • Proactive Issue Detection & Resolution: Develop and integrate intelligent systems within the platform to proactively identify, diagnose, and trigger automated or semi-automated resolution for technical issues, performance bottlenecks, and anomalies across all operational and data systems.
  • Advanced Data Quality Platform Implementation: Build and integrate capabilities within the M&O platform for continuously measuring, monitoring, and reporting on all critical data quality dimensions (Timeliness, Consistency, Completeness, Accuracy, Validity, Uniqueness) across diverse supply chain pipelines, including Warehousing, Transformation, SAP, Manufacturing, and other critical data sources.
  • Centralized Insights & Dashboarding: Develop and manage a unified dashboarding interface (e.g., Grafana, Power BI, Databricks) within the platform to visualize key performance indicators, system health, operational metrics, financial insights (FinOps), and granular data quality metrics for various stakeholders.
  • Automating Infrastructure & Operations: Drive the platform's automation capabilities through Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and extensive scripting (Python, Shell) for provisioning, deployment, and operational workflows.

PerfectServe is looking for a Platform Engineering Manager to lead and grow the team behind our cloud platform.   • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication: Partner with product, security, Platform Operations and engineering teams to line platform priorities up with business goals. You'll communicate technical strategy and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and stakeholders.
  • Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Keep the team current with tools, technologies and best practices, including advances in AI/ML and AIOps, and champion the initiatives that move PerfectServe's platform forward.

Qualifications

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an Embedded Python Data & Automation Engineer to take ownership of an existing Python environment, maintain production systems, improve automations and data pipelines, and develop internal tools and integrations.

Key Responsibilities

  • System Transition & Knowledge Absorption: Shadow the departing programmer and take ownership of the existing Python codebase.
  • Production Support & Maintenance: Troubleshoot live issues, maintain existing systems, and ensure system stability.
  • Data Pipelines & Automations: Maintain, debug, and improve data pipelines and scheduled automations.
  • API & Integration Ownership: Maintain and extend APIs, third-party integrations, authentication flows, and webhooks.
  • Technical Debt: Identify fragile systems, undocumented dependencies, and technical risks and improve them over time.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain system documentation, workflow diagrams, dependency maps, and operating procedures.
  • Internal Tooling: Build practical automation tools and internal software based on business needs.
  • Engineering Practices: Use Git, pull requests, automated testing, changelogs, and staged deployments.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of professional Python experience in a data-focused environment.
  • Experience building or maintaining production data pipelines and automations.
  • Strong experience with APIs, integrations, authentication, and webhooks.
  • Experience working with an existing or legacy codebase.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Familiarity with Git, pull requests, testing, and deployment workflows.
  • Strong written English and technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to work with meaningful overlap with US business hours.

Typical Day

Your day begins with a check on overnight automations and any open production issues. You spend focused blocks working through the current system — reading existing code, running tests, tracing integrations, and filling in documentation gaps. Early in the engagement, a meaningful portion of your time is in handover sessions with the departing programmer. As the transition matures, that time shifts toward new development: building automations, improving pipeline reliability, or scoping a new internal tool with the client. You communicate primarily over Slack and participate in planning sessions and check-ins that align with US business hours. You raise flags early, document as you go, and push changes through staging rather than directly to production.

INDG builds the systems behind large-scale visual content production. We turn physical products into digital twins, CGI content, interactive experiences, and automated product visuals for global brands that need quality, consistency, and scale.

As Senior Project Manager, you own the delivery rhythm for complex client programs where design, 3D production, development, review cycles, vendors, and brand requirements all meet. You are not just moving tasks across a board. You are structuring how work gets made, reviewed, approved, and shipped.

This role exists because INDG’s clients are asking for more than isolated CGI assets. They need repeatable production models: one source product model, many outputs, controlled visual quality, reliable timelines, and clear communication across teams. You will help build that operating layer.

You’ll manage projects in Consumer Products or Healthcare, where product accuracy, visual consistency, compliance, and delivery discipline matter. The outcome is clear: clients receive production-grade interactive experiences and 3D content that can scale across campaigns, platforms, markets, and product lines.

What You Will Do

  • Own complex delivery from kickoff to launch
    You’ll manage multiple interactive and CGI-driven projects at the same time, from scope definition through final delivery. You’ll translate client goals into timelines, resource plans, review flows, dependencies, and delivery milestones. You’ll know when a project is blocked by missing product data, unresolved art direction, technical debt, unclear feedback, or vendor capacity.

  • Connect clients, artists, developers, and vendors
    You’ll be the operating link between client teams, CG artists, designers, developers, producers, vendors, and agencies. You’ll make sure everyone understands what is being built, what quality bar applies, what decisions are pending, and what needs to happen next. You’ll keep communication specific, written, and actionable.

  • Build delivery systems, not one-off project plans
    You’ll improve how projects run. That can mean standardizing intake, tightening feedback loops, clarifying approval gates, improving Jira or project documentation, reducing manual handoffs, or creating better reporting for client and internal teams. You’ll look for repeatable patterns in CGI, digital twin, and interactive delivery and turn them into cleaner ways of working.

  • Protect visual quality while managing constraints
    You’ll understand that delivery is not complete because the file was exported. It is complete when the output meets the brief, the product is accurate, the interaction works, the render quality holds up, and the client can use it confidently. You’ll help teams balance scope, timing, budget, technical limitations, and visual ambition without hiding tradeoffs.

Requirements

Who You Are

You think in systems, timelines, assets, dependencies, and visual outcomes. You can sit with a client discussing business goals, then work with a CG lead or developer to understand what is actually required to deliver the work.

You Have

  • 3 to 5+ years of project management experience in a digital, production, CGI ( healthcare, consumer products) or interactive environment.

  • Experience managing multi-disciplinary teams across design, 3D, development, production, QA, vendors, and client-side reviewers.

  • Working knowledge of traditional project management and Agile methods. Scrum Master, Prince2, or similar certifications are useful, but your delivery judgment matters more than the certificate.

  • A structured approach to documentation, planning, risk tracking, meeting notes, decision logs, project boards, and client reporting.

  • Strong English communication skills, with the ability to make complex delivery situations clear without overloading people.

  • Bonus value: experience with CGI, 3D production, digital twins, DAM/PIM/CMS integrations, healthcare content, regulated content review, or enterprise brand systems.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

Position Title: UI/UX Designer
Location: Remote in the U.S.
Position Type: Part-Time 1099

Who We Are
Management Solutions LLC (MSLLC) is an award-winning management consulting firm delivering solutions for our partners’ most complex challenges. Since 2002, we have supported federal and commercial clients through expertise in project and program strategy, delivery and implementation, engineering and technical advisory services, workforce solutions, and digital solutions.
We are distinguished by our reputation for managing mission-critical projects and helping organizations improve performance through innovative, people-centered solutions. MSLLC has been recognized as Small Business of the Year by the U.S. Small Business Administration, the Department of Energy, and Oak Ridge National Laboratory and has been named one of the Top Employers in the Greater Knoxville area.

Position Summary
Management Solutions is seeking a detail-oriented UI/UX Designer specialized consulting support on a 1099 independent contractor basis. This opportunity is intended to create modern, accessible, and user-centered digital experiences across Microsoft Power Pages, Power Platform, SharePoint, and the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience designing responsive, accessible experiences for Microsoft Power Pages, with additional expertise in Power Apps, including Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps. This role requires strong UI/UX fundamentals and an understanding of the capabilities, design patterns, and constraints of Power Pages and the broader Power Platform.

The successful candidate will translate complex business processes and requirements into simple, intuitive digital experiences while collaborating with Power Platform developers, Microsoft 365 solution teams, and business stakeholders. The role also requires experience designing for SharePoint and familiarity with Microsoft 365 services, integration patterns, and digital workplace experiences.

The anticipated level of effort for this opportunity is approximately 30 + hours per week over an estimated 9-month period. 

What You’ll Do

  • Translate complex business workflows, data, and requirements into clear, efficient, and user-friendly experiences.

  • Design accessible Power Pages portals using responsive layouts, reusable components, forms, lists, role-based access, and Dataverse integration.

  • Create wireframes, prototypes, mockups, user flows, and design specifications that can be effectively implemented within Power Apps and Power Platform capabilities and constraints.

  • Collaborate closely with Power Apps developers to ensure designs are technically feasible and translate effectively into production applications.

  • Establish and apply reusable Power Apps design patterns, components, navigation structures, and visual standards to promote consistency across applications.

  • Design and implement engaging, accessible, and high-performing user interfaces for power platforms, SharePoint, and other internal and external portals.

  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to understand user needs, gather requirements, and define design objectives.

  • Maintain consistent branding and user experience across Power Apps, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and related enterprise platforms.

  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and design reviews to validate design decisions and continuously improve application experiences.

  • Apply accessibility standards and inclusive design principles throughout the design process.

  • Stay current with Microsoft Power Platform capabilities, Power Apps design practices, UI/UX trends, and emerging technologies.

  • Collaborate closely with developers, solution architects, project managers, business analysts, and content strategists to ensure seamless implementation.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Web Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 5+ years of experience designing enterprise applications, digital portals, web-based dashboards, or similar user interfaces.

  • Demonstrated UI/UX design experience with Microsoft Power Apps is required, including Canvas Apps and/or Model-Driven Apps with an understanding of their design differences.

  • Ability to design user-centered experiences using modern tools (Figma, Adobe XD, etc.), including wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and UI specifications.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards, information architecture, and enterprise application design, with experience designing for SharePoint and Microsoft 365 required.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to balance user experience, technical feasibility, and business requirements across Power Platform and related enterprise systems.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience partnering directly with Power Apps developers and/or Power Platform solution teams to take designs from concept through implementation is strongly preferred.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating Power Apps UI/UX work, enterprise application design, and/or portal design is required. Portfolio examples should demonstrate the candidate’s ability to simplify complex workflows and create intuitive enterprise user experiences.

  • Understanding of front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React is beneficial.

  • Experience designing applications backed by Dataverse, SharePoint, or other enterprise data sources.

  • Experience conducting usability testing specifically for workflow-driven business applications.

  • Understanding of Power Platform governance, environment considerations, and application lifecycle concepts from a designer’s perspective.

Work Authorization
