Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation in model serving and inference architectures for advanced AI systems. Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.

  • Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.

  • Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. Set measurable criteria to ensure that these resources effectively evaluate model performance, latency, and memory utilization under various operational conditions.

  • Analyze computational efficiency and diagnose bottlenecks in the serving pipeline by monitoring both processing and memory metrics. Address issues such as suboptimal batch processing, network delays, and high memory usage to optimize the serving infrastructure for scalability and reliability on resource-constrained systems.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate optimized serving and inference frameworks into production pipelines designed for edge and on-device applications. Define clear success metrics such as improved real-world performance, low error rates, robust scalability, optimal memory usage and ensure continuous monitoring and iterative refinements for sustained improvements.

Requirements

  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Must have knowledge of Metal Shading Language (MSL). You should be comfortable writing custom compute shaders from scratch.

  • Proven experience in low-level kernel optimizations and inference optimization on mobile devices is essential. Your contributions should have led to measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications, particularly on resource-constrained devices and edge platforms.

  • A deep understanding of modern model serving architectures and inference optimization techniques is required. This includes state-of-the-art methods for achieving low-latency, high-throughput performance, and efficient memory management in diverse, resource-constrained deployment scenarios.

  • Must have strong expertise in writing GPU kernels for mobile devices (i.e., smartphones) as well as a deep understanding of model serving frameworks and engines. Practical experience in developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from optimizing models for efficient serving to integrating these solutions on resource-constrained devices is required.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to overcome challenges in model serving, such as latency optimization, computational bottlenecks, and memory constraints. You should be proficient in designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on optimization strategies to continuously push the boundaries of inference performance and system efficiency.

  • Distributed Inference Systems: Designing and optimizing high-performance inference engines using techniques like Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism, and Expert Parallelism to handle massive models on GPU clusters.

  • Deep understanding of the math and structure behind Diffusion Models and Vision Transformers

  • Understanding of Pruning, Quantization, Flash attention, KV Cache, Speculative Decoding (Eagle) etc.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.excerpt: 👋 About Boundless LifeBoundless Life empowers remote workers to experience — with their families — the nomad lifestyle many people without children have been enjoying for years.
jobs.description:
👋 About Boundless Life

Boundless Life empowers remote workers to experience — with their families — the nomad lifestyle many people without children have been enjoying for years. It creates a complete “live abroad” immersive experience for families looking to get the most of what the digital age and the world can offer.

Through family-friendly lodging and a cutting-edge education system that follows the children wherever they go, Boundless brings together a community of like-minded families who want to explore the planet while working remotely and having a positive impact on their lives and the world.

Since we were founded in 2021, we have quickly grown to 8 locations across three continents and more than 250 team members of different nationalities.

We’re continuing to grow at a fast pace. This year alone we’re opening 2 new locations, and have ambitious goals to empower people to have more fulfilling lives by designing a lifestyle enabling balance, growth and deeper connections with ourselves, our families, nature and the world.

🙌 The role

As Head of Community, your mission is to create the conditions for the Boundless Life community to thrive.

You will own the community experience across the family journey - from pre-arrival through the on-cohort community experience and post-cohort engagement - ensuring families feel welcomed, connected, supported and empowered to actively contribute to the community.

You will lead and coach a mission-driven Community team and work closely with Operations, Product, Education, Marketing and Sales to build a community experience that is both deeply human and scalable.

A key part of the role will be finding the right balance between high-touch interactions, community self-organization, thoughtful automation and technology - allowing us to deliver a premium experience as the Boundless community grows.

Key responsibilities will include:

1. Family Journey & Onboarding

  • Own and continuously improve the community journey across pre-arrival, on-cohort and post-cohort touchpoints.
  • Design a seamless onboarding experience combining self-service resources, communications, webinars, technology and human interactions so families feel confident and prepared before arriving.
  • Ensure families understand and embrace Boundless Life's values, Community Guidelines and Terms, while handling sensitive community situations when required.
  • Develop the post-cohort experience, including continued community engagement and resources supporting families and children as they transition back home or onto their next adventure.
  • Identify opportunities for existing families and alumni to support prospective families through authentic community interactions and advocacy.

2. Community Engagement & Belonging

  • Define the community engagement strategy and create the rituals, formats and experiences that make the Boundless community distinctive, memorable and consistent across destinations.
  • Lead initiatives such as the Boundless Forum and other community platforms, ensuring conversations are active, useful, welcoming and well moderated.
  • Develop content, benefits, perks and experiences that continuously add value to membership in the Boundless community.
  • Create the conditions for families to connect around shared interests, life stages and ambitions, from sports and hobbies to professional circles and parent communities.
  • Encourage community-led initiatives and empower families to organize activities, groups and experiences themselves.

3. Community Technology, Automation & Scale

  • Own the community technology roadmap from a user and operational perspective.
  • Lead the transition from third-party tools such as Slack and Notion toward the Boundless App, partnering closely with Product/Development and Operations.
  • Design and implement the right role for WhatsApp and other communication channels within the wider community ecosystem, including membership and moderation processes.
  • Introduce AI-enabled customer support and automation where it improves speed and simplicity for families, while protecting the moments where human interaction creates the most value.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve the family experience and enable the Community team to operate effectively as Boundless grows.

4. On-location Community Excellence

  • Equip and support Community Hosts across Boundless destinations to consistently deliver an exceptional community experience.
  • Build playbooks, training, tools and best practices that allow local teams to deliver the Boundless experience while adapting to the personality of each cohort.
  • Ensure we understand families' interests, needs and expectations before arrival and translate those insights into relevant groups, introductions and experiences.
  • Create mechanisms for Community Hosts to share learnings and successful initiatives across destinations.

5. Team Leadership & Community Performance

  • Lead, coach and develop the Community team, creating clear ownership, priorities and standards.
  • Define what a healthy, thriving Boundless community looks like and establish the metrics needed to measure it.
  • Use family feedback, engagement data and qualitative insights to continuously improve the experience.
  • Champion the voice of the community internally and ensure family insights influence Boundless Life's wider product and experience decisions.

Your success will be measured by:

Community Growth & Engagement

  • Achieve a 90% onboarding satisfaction rate, ensuring families feel supported pre- and post-arrival.
  • Ensure a 90% response rate within 30 minutes (between 8 am-8 pm) across community platforms.

Community at Destinations

  • Develop framework for families participation in community-led-events
  • Drive a 100% increase in participation in community-led events and experiences.

Community Tools implementation

  • Launch, roll out and track usage of Boundless App and WA groups in Q4
  • Implement AI customer support by Q1 2027

Community Perks & Partnerships

  • Launch and manage Boundless Perks partnerships and content creating value to the community so we can charge an annual membership fee of at least €500 per family

Overall Community KPIs

  • Increase rebooking rate by 10% over previous 12-month period
  • Improve Community NPS by 10 points

🤝 Your manager

You will work directly with Elodie, Co-founder & Chief Revenue Officer.

💥 What’s in it for you

  • Fully-remote role and a truly flexible work environment
  • Fast-growing company with strong financials
  • Be part of creating a new lifestyle concept in the experience economy
  • Potential to grow with the team as the company grows
  • A mission-driven company and team
  • Autonomy to make strategic decisions and plans
  • Discounts to participate in Boundless Life cohorts in all locations

🫶 About you

To be successful in this role, you’ll combine community-building expertise, operational excellence, technology fluency, and a passion for human connection. You will be valued for:

  • Proven experience building and scaling communities or customer experiences in a fast-growing environment
  • Strong leadership skills, with experience coaching customer-facing, mission-driven teams
  • Ability to turn strategy into scalable journeys, processes, playbooks, and operating rhythms
  • High technology fluency, with experience using community platforms, automation, AI, and customer support tools to improve both experience and efficiency
  • Strong customer instinct, with a deep understanding of what drives belonging, engagement, trust, and advocacy
  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial mindset, able to work effectively across Operations, Product, Education, Marketing, and Sales
  • Experience in startups or scale-ups, ideally in education, hospitality, travel, membership, or experience-led businesses
  • Ideally, personal experience with Boundless Life or a strong affinity with family mobility and international living
  • Ability and willingness to travel to our locations frequently

✨ What's next?

  • First call with our Recruiter (30 min)
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (45 min)
  • Panel interview with the Sales & Operations and Hospitality Heads (60 min)

The process might change slightly as we go along - we’ll keep you posted at all times.

Want to know more about working at Boundless Life? Check out our story!

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in post-training methodologies, with a special focus on agentic behaviors and tool use. Your work will refine pre-trained models so that they not only deliver enhanced intelligence and domain specific capabilities, but also learn to reason, plan, and autonomously invoke external tools to solve real world, multi step tasks and applications on edge devices (i.e., smartphones).

You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from streamlined, resource efficient agents that run on limited hardware to complex multi modal architectures integrating text, images, and audio, all optimized for tool augmented decision making.

We expect you to have deep expertise in large language model architectures and substantial experience in post-training for agentic workflows, including tool use fine tuning, function calling, and reinforcement learning from feedback on multi turn interactions. You will adopt a hands-on, research driven approach to developing, testing, and implementing new post-training algorithms that unlock goal directed behavior, self correction, and reliable tool invocation.

Your responsibilities include curating agentic training data (e.g., trajectories of tool use, reasoning chains, environment interactions), strengthening baseline performance, and identifying as well as resolving bottlenecks in post-training for tool augmented agents to achieve SOTA model quality. The goal is to build models that do not just know but also act, use tools, and adapt, pushing the limits of what agentic AI can achieve.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct end-to-end research and engineering initiatives to advance post-training of agentic and tool-use models to achieve SOTA results.

  • Drive broad, cross-cutting model improvements, including factuality, instruction adherence, tool/function use, multi-agent coordination, and reasoning calibration.

  • Design and enhance large-scale post-training systems, including data pipelines, training workflows, evaluation frameworks, and benchmark infrastructure.

  • Develop rigorous evaluation suites and diagnostic tools to assess model readiness for deployment.

  • Strengthen feedback loops from real-world product usage, incorporating both explicit and implicit user signals into post-training.

  • Collaborate with tooling, product, and training teams to improve the usefulness, reliability, and agentic capabilities of frontier models.

  • Closely liaise with research, engineering and cross-functional teams to determine which integrations are production-ready for inclusion in major model releases.

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field; advanced degree (MS/PhD) preferred with a strong publication record in top-tier AI conferences.

  • Experience with multimodal post-training workflows and data pipelines, particularly for agentic systems and tool use.

  • Hands-on experience applying post-training at scale using distributed training frameworks (e.g., multi-node GPU environments).

  • Demonstrated experience improving model capabilities in areas such as reasoning, tool use, and multi-agent coordination that achieve SOTA results.

  • Proven track record of open-source contributions related to agentic systems or tool use (code, datasets, or models) on platforms such as GitHub or Hugging Face.

  • Publications at leading AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, CVPR, ECCV).

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

jobs.excerpt: About the ClientOur client operates a high-volume B2C creator platform in the entertainment industry, serving more than 200,000 active users and 30,000 creators, with payment events flowing through the platform every second.
jobs.description:
About the Client

Our client operates a high-volume B2C creator platform in the entertainment industry, serving more than 200,000 active users and 30,000 creators, with payment events flowing through the platform every second.

Data is one of the company’s most valuable competitive advantages. In this role, you will work closely with an experienced data analyst to transform a continuous flow of events into clean, reliable, and query-ready data that supports product, payments, and growth decisions.

The Role

We are looking for a Data Engineer who will take end-to-end ownership of the company’s ETL pipelines - the systems responsible for moving data from the transactional platform, including MongoDB, payment streams, and behavioral events, into the analytics environment where it can be turned into actionable insights.

This is not simply a dashboard integration role.

You will design and maintain pipelines that remain accurate, reliable, and timely while millions of events are processed and financial transactions occur every second.

Data integrity is critical. A missing payment event or duplicated transaction is not merely a technical issue—it can have a direct financial impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the pipelines: Design, build, and maintain ETL and streaming pipelines that ingest high-volume event and payment data and deliver it to the analytics warehouse reliably and accurately.

  • Model the data: Partner closely with the Lead Data Analyst to create warehouse schemas that answer essential business questions related to creator earnings, payment throughput, retention, lifetime value, and cohort behavior.

  • Engineer for failure: Build idempotent, replayable, and observable jobs that can withstand traffic spikes, retries, and partial failures without compromising downstream data.

  • Process high-volume events: Move data through queue infrastructure including BullMQ and Redis, AWS SQS, and RabbitMQ, while instrumenting pipelines through OpenTelemetry.

  • Protect data integrity: Implement reconciliation checks, deduplication, backfills, and reliable handling of late or out-of-order events.

  • Protect financial transactions: Collaborate with payments and platform teams to ensure that every transaction is captured once, accurately, and on time.

The Technology Stack

  • Languages: Node.js and TypeScript as the primary technologies, with some .NET and C#

  • Data stores: MongoDB as the primary transactional database and Redis

  • Queues and streaming: BullMQ, AWS SQS, and RabbitMQ

  • Analytics and warehouse: PostHog, its data warehouse layer, and SQL data modeling

  • Platform: AWS, including S3 and SNS, Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions

  • Observability: OpenTelemetry tracing across every pipeline

Requirements

About You

You are a strong engineer with substantial experience building high-volume data and ETL pipelines.

You will ideally bring:

  • Approximately 5–10 years of relevant engineering experience

  • Strong experience with batch and/or streaming data pipelines

  • Deep knowledge of event-driven architectures and message queues

  • A strong understanding of idempotency, at-least-once versus exactly-once processing, retries, and out-of-order event delivery

  • Professional experience with TypeScript and Node.js

  • Solid SQL and data-modeling capabilities

  • The ability to collaborate with analysts and design schemas that make business queries efficient and intuitive

  • A strong focus on data integrity, particularly when working with payments and financial transactions

  • Experience implementing reconciliation, auditing, monitoring, and data-quality controls

  • Previous experience in a high-volume B2C environment such as gaming, gambling, fintech, payments, or another real-money platform

  • Experience with .NET or C# would be considered an advantage.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with payment or transaction data and financial reconciliation

  • Experience with MongoDB change streams or change data capture

  • Familiarity with data warehouse tooling and dbt-style modeling

  • Experience working with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code

About 2am.tech

We are 2am.tech, a team of builders and problem solvers united by a shared commitment to delivering excellence.

This commitment has shaped a company culture focused on creating solutions and products that consistently exceed expectations. Our drive to learn, evolve, and solve meaningful business challenges has taken us on a journey that goes #beyondsoftware.

As part of that journey, we partner with ambitious companies to help them identify and hire exceptional technology professionals.

We are currently managing the recruitment process for a client seeking an experienced Data Engineer — ETL & Pipelines to join its team.

This is a direct-hire opportunity. The successful candidate will be employed or engaged directly by the client, while 2am.tech will coordinate the recruitment and selection process.

jobs.excerpt: Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all.
jobs.description:
Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world – one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs.
We’re a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we’re looking for passionate people to help us get there.
For more information, visit .

Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia

At Arcadia, the Enterprise Implementation Manager (EIM) is the customer's primary point of accountability from contract signature through the life of the relationship. The EIM manages a portfolio of enterprise accounts, leading each customer through onboarding and the technical work required to bring them live — including project managing new data connector builds — but the role exists to protect and grow the value the customer realizes from Arcadia's platform. EIMs proactively build the client relationship, drive adoption, resolve risk before it threatens retention, and act as the customer's trusted advisor long after go-live, ensuring customer value is clearly tracked & regularly reviewed.

The ideal candidate is a relationship-first operator: someone who can run a technical delivery workstream competently, but who is just as comfortable owning a client conversation, coaching a teammate, or spotting an account risk before it becomes a retention problem.

What Success Looks Like

In 3 months

  • Complete onboarding and current product and enablement certifications; build a working understanding of the platform, data model, and Arcadia's customer success playbooks. The optional Arcadia Certified Professional program is available for continued growth. Shadow tactical client touchpoints and status conversations to learn how EIMs build trust and manage expectations across a client relationship
  • Take ownership of a defined workstream — for example, project managing a new data connector build — with support from your manager and technical partners

In 6 months

  • Independently manage cross-team workflows (data integration, configuration, connector builds) while keeping priorities visible and surfacing risk early
  • Lead tactical client conversations and standing touchpoints, delivering clear, timely updates that keep stakeholders aligned and confident
  • Proactively identify and escalate delivery or account risk, applying established playbooks to resolve issues efficiently and maintain momentum
  • Begin building trusted relationships with client stakeholders, understanding their unique technical and business priorities
  • Contribute to Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), or steering committees for your accounts, and become fluent in maintaining account health scores in Planhat
  • Build fluency with Arcadia's customer feedback channels, including the Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT), as part of engaging your accounts

In 12 months

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts as the primary point of contact — coordinating delivery, connector project management, and ongoing value acceleration & account health under one roof
  • Drive accountability for on-time, high-quality delivery of commitments, from new data connector implementations to platform adoption milestones
  • Independently lead recurring QBRs, EBRs, or steering committees, and own the Planhat health score and NPS trajectory for your portfolio, working toward a consistently green status
  • Partner effectively with the Customer Growth and Retention (CGR) team on renewal and expansion conversations, providing account context and continuity while CGR owns the commercial process
  • Identify and document process or value improvements, contributing refinements that strengthen delivery consistency and customer outcomes
  • Share lessons learned and best practices with peers, informally mentoring newer EIMs and Project Associates

What You'll Be Doing

    Customer Relationship & Trust

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts, serving as the customer's primary point of contact throughout the engagement.
  • Lead tactical status conversations and standing project meetings, delivering clear, timely updates on progress, risk, and next steps.
  • Facilitate regular touchpoints to align priorities, answer client questions, and maintain stakeholder trust.
  • Prepare accurate, client-ready documentation and materials that support transparent communication.

    • Account Health & Governance

  • Serve as the customer's primary point of accountability for delivery outcomes and overall account health across your portfolio.
  • Lead recurring QBRs, EBRs, or steering committees with client leadership, tying progress to shared goals, ROI, and next steps.
  • Maintain each account's health score in Planhat, incorporating usage, engagement, and other signals; own the goal of moving accounts toward a consistently green status. Contribute to your segment's (Core, Enterprise, or National) Net Promoter Score (NPS), which factors into incentive compensation at the segment level rather than by individual account.
  • Build fluency with Arcadia's customer feedback channels — including CSAT — as part of the company's growing Voice-of-Customer program.
  • Partner with the CGR team on renewal and expansion conversations, providing account context, continuity, and delivery insight; CGR owns the commercial renewal and upsell process.
  • Proactively identify and escalate delivery and account risk; apply established playbooks to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Maintain project and account momentum through consistent follow-through and clear ownership of open items.
  • Drive accountability for commitments by managing dependencies and communicating progress across all workstreams.

    • Implementation & Data Connector Project Management

  • Project-manage new data connector builds and platform configuration workstreams from kickoff through validation and go-live.
  • Ensure smooth data orchestration through configuration validation, and maintain detailed documentation of process flows and integrations.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Data & Health Platform (DHP) teams and engineering to resolve data alignment issues and strengthen reporting reliability.

    • Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Manage workflows to maintain alignment and efficiency across internal teams, third parties, and the client.
  • Coordinate delivery activities and track interdependencies so priorities stay visible and risks surface early.
  • Ensure project team collaboration and escalate promptly if a workstream is tracking behind.

    • Value Realization & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify and document process or workflow enhancements that improve customer outcomes and internal efficiency.

    • Coaching & Knowledge Sharing

  • Apply feedback to continuously refine your own skills and performance, modeling a growth mindset for the team.

    • AI & Technology Fluency

  • Apply sound judgment around risk, privacy, security, and quality when using AI tools, and continuously build fluency in evolving practices.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field.
  • At least 3 years leading account implementation and customer success processes in software/technology, ideally in healthcare, with claims and clinical data integration experience.
  • In-depth knowledge of project management & customer success principles, tools, and methods; ability to identify and mitigate project- and account-level risk.
  • Extensive healthcare industry experience, including population health and value-based care; ability to master Arcadia's solutions, client strategic context, and industry trends well enough to advise clients as a trusted partner.
  • Demonstrated ability to own a portfolio of client relationships over time — not just a project — including retention-oriented communication and stakeholder management.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to client sites, executive business reviews, and industry conferences — typically quarterly, with increased frequency depending on client activity and event schedules.

Would Love for You to Have

  • Excellent presentation and communication skills, including the ability to build client-ready materials in PowerPoint, Excel, and Word, and lead meetings with executive, operational, clinical, and technical stakeholders.

What You'll Get

About Arcadia

Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near-real time. We are passionate about helping our customers drive meaningful outcomes. We are growing fast and have emerged as a market leader in the highly competitive population health management software market and have been recognized by industry analysts KLAS, IDC, Forrester, and Chilmark for our leadership. For a better sense of our brand and products, please explore our website.

Highlights:

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB. The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React, with nearly all code written in TypeScript. For high-throughput messaging and background processing, we use Kafka (for millions of events) and Bull (Redis). Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse, and we use Elasticsearch for search.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Many of our developers bring 5 - 10+ years of experience, and we foster a culture of deep technical curiosity and knowledge sharing.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About the Role

As a Backend Engineer, you will be a key architect of the engine that powers our global platform. You'll resolve complex challenges in a high-load, distributed system, building and scaling the infrastructure that processes millions in donations. This is not a maintenance role; it's a high-impact, product-focused engineering position where clean architecture, performance, and reliability are paramount.

You will work on a complex product ecosystem—from our modern checkout experience to donor portals and massive analytics pipelines—all powered by a cutting-edge tech stack.

  • Backend: Node.js (Koa, NestJS), TypeScript
  • Database: MongoDB
  • Infrastructure: Kafka for event streaming, Bull (Redis) for background jobs, ClickHouse for analytics, and Elasticsearch for search.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable backend services in Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Develop new product features from concept to deployment, collaborating closely with product managers and frontend engineers.
  • Own key parts of our backend architecture, making critical decisions that enhance performance, reliability, and security.
  • Write comprehensive unit tests and conduct thorough code reviews to maintain code quality.
  • Proactively identify and implement system improvements, refactoring legacy code where necessary.
  • Contribute to a culture of engineering excellence by mentoring others and sharing your expertise.
  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work and understand where it adds value and how it can improve the way you operate.

Requirements

  • Experience: 7+ years of backend development experience, preferably in a product-driven environment.
  • Node.js Expertise: Strong, hands-on experience with Node.js and modern frameworks like Koa or NestJS.
  • TypeScript Pro: Deep expertise in TypeScript, including its advanced typing and module systems.
  • Database Skills: Solid experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
  • Distributed Systems: Familiarity with event-driven architecture using tools like Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Bull/Redis.
  • Data & Search: Hands-on experience with ClickHouse (or similar analytics DBs) and Elasticsearch.
  • Architectural Mindset: A strong understanding of system design, clean architecture principles, and performance optimization.
  • Ownership: The ability to work independently, take ownership of your work, and see projects through to completion.
  • Communication: Comfortable working within a Russian-speaking team.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience working in a remote-first, globally distributed team.
  • Experience with performance monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog).
  • A genuine interest in the non-profit technology sector.
  • A hypothesis-driven mindset and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Bonus points

  • Curiosity and a hypothesis-driven mindset
  • Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership
  • Comfort working in fast-paced, data-rich environments

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds.
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders.
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people.
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next.
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is: €5,300 - €6,200 gross per month.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and alignment with the role's requirements.

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance for the employee and their family.
  • 22 paid vacation days per year.

This phase would be scoped and contracted separately.

About the Role

We are seeking a senior PR / Comms Copywriter (Freelancer) for a focused, full-time, one-month engagement to build the strategic foundation for a third-party citation pilot on a major consumer health platform. Search engines and AI platforms trust content more when credible outside sources back it up. Before we can go build those citations, we need a clear-eyed view of where the opportunity actually is: who is already being cited, which publications carry credibility with which audiences, and what realistic pathways exist for this brand to earn the same standing.

That is the entire job this month. You are not writing placements yet and you are not building the roadmap yet; you are producing the research, point of view, and strategic proposal that gets the client’s Comms team to the table and de-risks their approval. The single deliverable is a proposal strong enough to drive a collaborative conversation with Comms and internal stakeholders about what to activate and how.

This is a highly regulated pharma account, so recommendations have to be credible to a Comms team that will scrutinize them. Success looks like a tight, well-evidenced proposal delivered inside four weeks, with options that are specific enough to act on and honest about tradeoffs.

Scope of Work

Competitive & Citation Audit

  • Conduct a competitor placement and citation audit — where competitors are being cited, by whom, and through what kind of content.

  • Run citation teardowns on the strongest examples to identify what earned them the citation and what is reproducible.

  • Identify whitespace and opportunity areas where the brand can credibly compete rather than chase.

Audience & Credibility Mapping

  • Map which placements carry genuine credibility for each priority persona and condition area — trade, consumer health, clinical, caregiver, and adjacent media.

  • Assess publications and platforms for domain authority and citation likelihood, not just brand-name recognition.

  • Flag the sources most likely to be surfaced and cited by AI platforms in the relevant condition areas.

Options Development & Strategic Proposal

  • Propose content, placement, and activation options for generating external citations — digital PR, trade press, contributed bylines, data assets, and other credible pathways.

  • Pressure-test each option against feasibility, regulatory reality, and likely Comms objections.

  • Write the full strategic proposal — findings, point of view, recommended options, rationale, and open questions — built to drive collaborative conversation with the client Comms team and internal stakeholders.

  • Draft supporting narrative language and framing for the recommendation as needed.

jobs.excerpt: Narvar is growing!  We are hiring a Technical Project Manager to drive our most complex, multi-team engineering initiatives — the ones with no single owning team, where progress depends on getting the sequencing right across groups that don't naturally coordinate with each other.
jobs.description:
Narvar is growing! We are hiring a Technical Project Manager to drive our most complex, multi-team engineering initiatives — the ones with no single owning team, where progress depends on getting the sequencing right across groups that don't naturally coordinate with each other.

This is not a status-reporting role. You won't be writing production code, but you will build and maintain the real dependency graph behind a project: which team's output blocks which other team's start, where the critical path actually runs, and what has to happen in what order for the whole thing to land. You'll follow technical discussions closely enough to spot those dependencies before they become blockers, and you'll proactively pull in the right people — across engineering, product, design, data, or leadership — before gaps turn into delays.

Core responsibilities

  1. Dependency mapping and critical path management
  • Map cross-team dependencies for projects that span multiple engineering teams with no single owning team — identify what blocks what, and in what order work needs to happen
  • Maintain a live view of the critical path, not just individual teams' task lists, and flag when a slip in one team changes the achievable timeline for others
  • Surface hidden or emerging dependencies before they become blockers, particularly ones that no single team has visibility into because they sit at the seams between teams
  • Distill the graph into concise, honest updates for non-technical stakeholders and leadership — what's driving the timeline, what's at risk, and why
  1. Cross-functional coordination
  • Identify when product management, design, data, legal, or other stakeholders need to be looped in — and act on it proactively, without waiting for engineers to flag it
  • Recognize when a dependency crosses team boundaries and make sure the teams on both sides of it are actually talking to each other, not just individually on track
  • Chase down answers, escalate when needed, and keep work moving forward
  • Serve as the connective tissue across engineering and adjacent functions throughout the delivery lifecycle — especially where no single team is positioned to see the whole picture
  1. Technical context and decision support
  • Follow technical discussions closely enough to grasp the tradeoffs being made — architecture decisions, infrastructure choices, API design, build vs. buy — and understand how those choices ripple into other teams' work
  • Reason about sequencing implications of technical decisions: does this choice change what can be built in parallel versus what must be serial?
  • Surface implications of technical decisions for timeline, scope, or other teams
  • Know when a decision warrants broader input and facilitate getting it, without creating unnecessary process overhead
  1. Documentation and operational hygiene
  • Keep the dependency graph, specs, decisions, and timelines documented and accessible
  • Ensure decisions made in Slack or ad-hoc meetings don't get lost, especially ones that affect teams beyond the room they were made in
  • Make it easy for anyone joining a project mid-stream to get up to speed quickly — including understanding why the sequencing is what it is

What we're looking for

  • Systems and dependency thinking: You can look at multiple teams' plans and identify where they interlock — where a change in one ripples into another — even when no one team has full visibility into the whole
  • Technical fluency: You don't need to write code, but you need to follow engineering conversations comfortably — architecture diagrams, system tradeoffs, sprint planning — without hand-holding
  • Project management experience: 4+ years managing complex, multi-team software projects with several workstreams and stakeholders in a fast-moving environment — ideally including projects with no single owning team
  • Strong written communication: Able to distill a complex dependency picture into crisp, accurate updates for non-technical audiences
  • Proactive by default: You identify when to loop someone in without being asked, and you follow through without needing to be chased
  • Calm under ambiguity: Able to drive clarity and keep work moving without waiting for perfect information, a fully defined process, or a single team to own the outcome
  • Cross-functional credibility: Comfortable holding a room with engineers, product managers, designers, and executives — and earning trust from all of them

Nice to have

  • Prior experience as a software engineer, QA, or technical analyst
  • Familiarity with agile and scrum methodologies; experience with tools like Jira, Linear, or Shortcut, especially for modeling cross-team dependencies
  • Experience running programs (not just single-team projects) — i.e., initiatives coordinated across multiple teams toward a shared outcome
  • Experience working with distributed or remote engineering teams

Why Narvar?

We're on a mission to simplify the everyday lives of consumers. Post-purchase is a critical phase of the customer journey. That's why we created Narvar - a platform focused on driving customer loyalty through seamless post-purchase experiences that allow retailers to retain, engage, and delight customers. If you've ever bought something online, there's a good chance you've used our platform!

From the hottest new direct-to-consumer companies to retail’s most renowned brands, Narvar works with GameStop, Neiman Marcus, Sonos, Nike, and 1300+ other brands. With hubs in San Francisco, Atlanta, London, and Bangalore, we've served over 125 million consumers worldwide across 10+ billion interactions, 38 countries, and 55 languages.

Pioneering the post-purchase movement means navigating into the unknown. Our team thrives on this sense of adventure while nurturing a mindset of innovation. We're a home for big hearts and we leave our egos at the door. We work hard but we always make time to celebrate professional wins, baby showers, birthday parties, and everything in between.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Content Engineer (Internal)
jobs.excerpt: About Discovered LabsDiscovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR.
jobs.description:
About Discovered Labs

Discovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR.

We are trusted by hyper-growth companies like Instantly, Granola, incident and other $10M+ ARR B2B SaaS companies who want to get more leads and customers from both Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT.

We do this through a mixture of content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification (PR, backlinks, Reddit marketing).

View recent case studies at

High-level overview of our approach:

  • AI automation and workflows: We build marketing programs as we would a product. Rather than waste several hours per week on repetitive tasks, our in-house team of ML engineers create workflows with custom technology that let us focus on the high-impact stuff.

  • Senior expertise: To ensure everything is done to a high standard and differentiated, everything we do is managed and elevated by a team of experts. We don't let automation get in the way of quality.

  • Full-stack: SEO and AEO rarely work as isolated tasks. We work across the entire funnel and multiple surface areas to ensure we own the outcome and clients win.

Note: If you want to stand out, please include a Loom video showing a tool, system or deliverable you've produced and are proud of. We'd love to see it!

This role

This is Discovered Labs' first in-house owner of an established content operation. We already publish founder content, work with YouTube and video partners, maintain content pillars, and use systems that mine sales calls, customer conversations and market activity for ideas.

Your job is to take ownership of that operation, raise its editorial standard and expand what it can produce without making the founders the bottleneck.

You will orchestrate our internal systems, employees and agency partners. You will not personally write every asset from a blank page. You will decide what is worth making, ensure the work is recognisably ours, and take drafts and production outputs from nearly there to publishable.

This requires more than project management. You need the editorial taste to recognise what is weak, the writing ability to fix it, and the performance mindset to decide what we should do next.

This is a senior individual-contributor role reporting to co-founder Liam. It is fully remote, ideally within +/-4 hours of GMT.

This role is not for you if…

  • You are strongest at making calendars and briefs for other people, but cannot show work you personally produced and published. We need someone who sets direction and ships.

  • You wait for a complete brief before starting. We need someone who mines the material, finds the point and brings a recommendation.

  • You treat AI purely as a text generator. We want someone who can build an inspectable workflow, explain every editorial choice and why guardrails exist.

  • You report impressions and engagement without deciding what to make next. We need someone who can turn performance into a marketing decision.

What you'll do

You will own four connected initiatives. The constant is that you take work from source material to a publishable asset, then use performance to decide what the operation does next.

  • Take ownership of founder content: run the founder-content operation we already have across LinkedIn and other active channels. Use our existing intelligence, content pillars and source material to choose the strongest ideas.

  • Take work to publishable quality: move each founder piece through production and get it to the point where the founder is reviewing a strong recommendation rather than rewriting a first draft.

  • Launch employee-generated content: give employees clear topic lanes, training, examples, prompts and editorial feedback so they can publish useful, original work under their own names.

  • Enable rather than ghostwrite: build employees' ability to create and revise their own work. The goal is a repeatable employee publishing motion, not a queue of posts for you to write on everyone's behalf.

  • Raise the quality of agency-produced content: own the final editorial mile for YouTube and short-form video. Our partners handle primary scripting, editing and production.

  • Make agency-producted work recognisably ours: ensure scripts and edits reflect our frameworks, point of view, tone and structure before they reach the founders or go live.

  • Use performance to improve the operation: connect leading indicators such as reach, engagement and qualified attention with meetings and pipeline. Decide what to repeat, improve, stop or test next.

  • Improve the existing system through use: make targeted changes to workflows, templates, training and quality checks when the evidence shows they are limiting output or quality. This is continuous improvement of a working operation, not a mandate to rebuild it.

The ideal person for this role

  • You have editorial judgement. You can look across a body of work, identify the missing argument, cut the repetitive ideas and choose one direction.

  • You can finish work in someone else's voice. You can preserve the author's real voice while restructuring, rewriting and sharpening a draft. Your edit makes the person sound more like themselves, not more like you.

  • You make complex production move. You can keep internal contributors, systems and external partners moving towards one publishable result without becoming a passive project manager or taking every task back yourself.

  • You improve systems through use. You learn an existing operation before changing it, identify the actual constraint, and make targeted improvements while continuing to ship.

  • You can act on data. You can name a piece that underperformed, explain what the data suggested and show what you changed next.

  • You can direct specialists. You give an editor or agency enough direction to do strong work, then give clear feedback without taking the work back and doing it yourself.

Requirements

  • A portfolio showing work you personally took to publication, with a clear explanation of your contribution when collaborators or agencies were involved.

  • Evidence of editing, ghostwriting or shaping content in another person's voice.

  • Experience owning a recurring content operation across internal contributors, external partners or multiple channels.

  • Strong enough writing and editing ability to take an incomplete or off-brand draft to publishable quality.

  • A clear example of using performance evidence to change a content decision.

  • Experience creating training, standards, templates or feedback loops that helped other people produce better work.

  • Hands-on use of AI inside an inspectable professional workflow, with strong source-verification habits.

  • Native or near-native written English, the ability to edit your own work to a high standard, and availability for a working day that overlaps meaningfully with GMT.

Nice-to-haves (not required)

  • Experience interviewing founders, executives or subject-matter experts.

  • Experience directing a video editor, design partner, agency or freelancer.

  • Familiarity with LinkedIn, YouTube, website publishing, SEO or Answer Engine Optimisation.

  • B2B SaaS, agency, founder-brand or demand-generation experience.

  • Experience helping employees or internal experts publish under their own names.

  • Familiarity with content analytics, CRM attribution and distinguishing sourced from assisted pipeline.

We do not require SEO or AEO depth, B2B SaaS pedigree, agency experience, paid-media experience, video editing or design. Those can be taught or bought. We are hiring for editorial judgement, final-mile writing and editing, dependable orchestration, systems thinking and the ability to learn from performance.

Culture fit

You should ideally believe:

  • Original material beats generic commentary. The best content starts with evidence, experience or a point of view somebody has earned.

  • AI is most useful when it makes a good operator more capable and the work more inspectable. It never removes responsibility for the final output.

  • Speed and quality can coexist when the workflow is clear and people take ownership.

You'll thrive here if:

  • You like small teams, direct feedback and a high degree of autonomy.

  • You would rather publish, learn and improve than protect a perfect plan.

  • You are comfortable making the recommendation and explaining the evidence behind it.

  • You learn the existing system, run it reliably and improve it where the evidence warrants it.

You won't thrive here if:

  • You need heavy management or wait for perfect instructions.

  • You mistake volume for quality or strategy for production.

  • You hide uncertainty, publish unsupported claims or defend work you cannot trace to source.

  • You need a large team around you before you can produce.

What's in it for you

Benefits

  • Compensation: $45k - $65k PA (or EUR/GBP equivalent)

  • Fully remote: work from where you do your best work, with meaningful overlap with GMT.

  • Access to a working content stack: use and improve the research, evidence, editorial and distribution systems our team has already built.

  • Real autonomy: you will own the recommendation, calendar, production briefs, experiments and systems behind the work.

  • Paid holidays

Work in a new type of agency

  • We build our own tools. Engineers work alongside marketers to remove repetitive work and make the important decisions easier to inspect.

  • We connect content to commercial outcomes. Reach matters, but the work must ultimately help create meetings and pipeline.

  • We publish what we learn. Our research and methodologies become public assets rather than staying buried in client decks.

  • We use scorecards. You will know what you own, how success is measured and where founder sign-off begins and ends.

  • We keep the team small. The person closest to the work has real decision rights and visible responsibility for the result.

  • Turn existing judgement into a clearer standard. Build on our current voice guidance, checks and founder feedback so employees and partners can clear the bar more consistently.

This candidate should be an experienced leader who thrives on turning ambiguity into a clear strategy, builds trust quickly with sales partners, and knows how to design an outreach strategy and event experience compelling enough to draw prospects through the door. This person moves the program beyond attendance and event-day metrics, building toward conversion rates, deal velocity, and pipeline attribution. Lead the full lifecycle of field events, from strategy and budget through onsite execution and post-event pipeline reporting, for both net-new and existing-pipeline programs.


Design a repeatable playbook, including event formats, invite strategies, sales enablement kits, and follow-up cadences that regional teams can execute consistently.


Manage and mentor event planners and coordinators who support execution, providing strategic direction while they own logistics.


Measure and report on event performance against pipeline and revenue goals, using data to continuously refine the strategy and prove ROI to marketing and sales leadership.

  • A deep understanding of SaaS sales cycles and buyer personas relevant to our audience
  • Strong analytical rigor, with experience owning pipeline and ROI metrics to guide investment decisions, using tools such as Salesforce and Tableau to track attribution and conversion
  • Exceptional communication skills and a collaborative approach to working across marketing and sales teams
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

Forbes Advisor is hiring a Senior Manager, Post Production to build and lead the team that edits and delivers our paid social and native ads. The team is made up of Editors, who shape the story, pacing, and feel of every ad, and post specialists who assist with ingestion, color correction, and organization/DAM.

You will also hire and manage the small team of post specialists who prep the media for the editors. Leading them well takes real command of post workflow and systems: you own how footage moves from shoot to editor, set the standards that keep color consistent and the media library clean and easy to search, and keep improving how the pipeline works, from the tools to the structure to the process, so it stays reliable and fast as volume grows. When the process slows your editors down, you are the one who fixes it.

You also know the post side well, including how footage gets ingested, color-corrected, and organized, so you can lead the specialists who run it and keep the pipeline sharp.

  • Manage the team's workload and priorities so the right work reaches the right person and deadlines are met.
  • Partner with the Head of Creative Production and the Creative Directors on hiring and on raising the craft bar as the team grows.
  • Make sure finished ads meet the required legal and brand guidelines before they go live.

REQUIREMENTS

  • A strong portfolio of short-form video editing for paid social, direct-response, or performance content. We want to see the actual work.
  • 2 to 3+ years managing editors: hiring, leading, and developing a team. It does not need to have been a large one.

The Social Studies Content Coach serves as a content-area resource to help teachers maintain a clear understanding of what students are expected to learn, what standards and content have been taught, what remains to be addressed, and where adjustments to pacing or instructional priorities may be necessary to support student achievement.

Please note – while this is an online school position and all instruction occurs virtually, travel and face to face attendance will be required several times per year to support in person state testing and student events.

jobs.description:
About the Role
We are hiring a Channel Account Manager to build our European channel: recruiting, signing and activating partners country by country, standing up regional distribution, and carrying a partner-sourced number against the APEX Partner Program we have already built. This is a build role with a running start — the programme, commercial terms, deal registration and enablement assets all exist. What Europe needs is someone to turn them into a producing channel.

You will report to the VP of Global Channel & Alliances and work daily with Solutions Engineering, direct Sales, Partner Marketing, RevOps, Legal and Finance. You will also work alongside our existing global partner ecosystem — including distributors and VARs such as SHI, Vertosoft, FIERCE Software and Azul Systems, and technology and advisory partners such as Sonatype, Snyk, Mend.io, Acquia, Anchore and Crosslake — as we extend that footprint across Europe.

Key Responsibilities

Recruit and activate partners

  • Build a country-by-country partner map for Europe — who resells security, DevOps and application modernisation into the enterprise and public sector, and which of them own the accounts we want.
  • Source, pitch, negotiate and sign new resellers, distributors, consultancies and referral partners, using the APEX track that fits each partner's business model rather than forcing everyone into the same one.
  • Run structured onboarding: contracting, price list access, deal registration setup, portal access, NFR/evaluation licences and first-deal support.
  • Kill dormant relationships honestly. A short list of producing partners beats a long list of logos.

Run the distribution and transacting motion

  • Own day-to-day distributor relationships: price lists, quoting, purchase order flow, credit terms, multi-currency pricing and renewal processing.
  • Work with Finance, Legal and RevOps on the practicalities of transacting across European markets — entity and VAT treatment, local contracting requirements, GDPR and data residency questions, and localised reseller agreements.
  • Support partner-led routes into public sector and regulated buyers, including framework agreements and tender processes where our partners hold the vehicle.
  • Manage referral partners end to end, from introduction through to commission payout on first-year ACV once the deal closes through distribution.

Drive partner-sourced revenue

  • Build and execute joint business plans with tier-one partners, with named target accounts, agreed pipeline goals and quarterly reviews.
  • Get in front of end customers alongside partner sellers — this is a co-selling role, not a programme-administration role.
  • Maintain an accurate partner pipeline and forecast in Salesforce and HubSpot, and report on sourced versus influenced contribution.
  • Coordinate with our direct Account Executives and Solutions Engineers on account mapping, rules of engagement and conflict resolution.

Enable and market with partners

  • Train partner sales and technical teams on the NES value proposition: the true cost of an unplanned migration, the risk of unmaintained dependencies, and how a drop-in replacement changes the conversation.
  • Equip partners to lead with the European compliance narrative — CRA, NIS2 and DORA — in language their customers already use.
  • Plan and manage marketing development funds: co-branded campaigns, webinars, regional events and partner-hosted EOL assessment workshops.
  • Deliver EOL roadmap briefings so partners know what is going end-of-life next and can get ahead of it with their install base.

Feed the programme

  • Bring European market reality back to the APEX programme team — where margins, tiers, terms or tooling need to flex for this region.
  • Contribute to pricing and packaging discussions for partner-led motions in Europe.
  • Help define what the next channel hire in this region should look like.
What we're looking for

Required

  • 3–6 years in channel, partner or alliances roles at a B2B software vendor, with at least two of those years covering multiple European countries.
  • Demonstrable partner-sourced pipeline and closed revenue you can speak to specifically — which partners, what motion, what number.
  • Hands-on experience with a two-tier model: distributors above, resellers below, and the quoting and PO mechanics that sit between them.
  • Comfort co-selling into technical buyers. You will be in rooms with CTOs, CISOs, VPs of Engineering and platform leads, and you need to hold your own on software lifecycle, dependencies and security risk.
  • Fluency in the operational side of channel: deal registration, margin and discount structures, MDF, QBRs and joint business planning.
  • Business-fluent English, plus the willingness to travel roughly 30% across the region.
  • Self-direction. This is a remote role in a region without a large local team around you.

Strongly preferred

  • A second European language — German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch or a Nordic language.
  • Background in open source, application security, DevSecOps, SCA/SBOM tooling, or application modernisation and migration services.
  • Experience selling into compliance-driven buying cycles, and familiarity with CRA, NIS2, DORA or equivalent regimes.
  • Existing relationships with European VARs, distributors or systems integrators in the security or developer tooling space.
  • Public sector channel experience, including framework agreements and tender-led procurement.
  • Salesforce and HubSpot proficiency, and a genuine habit of keeping a CRM clean.

You'll do well here if

  • You are comfortable being the first serious channel presence in a region, and treat ambiguity as room to work rather than a blocker.
  • You would rather have five partners who sell than fifty who signed.
  • You are credible with engineers and with procurement, and can move between those conversations without changing your story.
  • You respect the open source community we come from and can represent it honestly.

Air Traffic Control Radar Systems Engineers

30% Travel | United States | Full-Time

Position Overview

Crown Innovations is seeking Air Traffic Control Radar System Engineers with experience supporting digital Primary Airport Surveillance Radar (DASR) systems, including FAA ASR-9 and ASR-11 models, as well as FAA Secondary Radar Systems such as ATCBI-6/Mode-S or comparable military primary and secondary radar systems.

These roles support the preparation of Site Readiness, Site Design, and Site-Specific Implementation Plans (SSIP) for radar system installations. Military personnel with radar system experience across various branches of the U.S. Armed Forces, including operation and engineering support of radar equipment, are encouraged to apply.

This role supports federally regulated infrastructure projects and requires alignment with technical, regulatory, and operational requirements.

This role may require up to 30% travel and supports a remote work environment.

Positions Available

• Junior Systems Engineer

  • Mid-Level Systems Engineer

• Senior-Level Systems Engineer

  • System Engineering positions for Site Design, Site Readiness, and Site-Specific Implementation Plans (SSIP) may be performed remotely, with travel to sites as needed

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Engineering

  • System engineers for site design are responsible for the comprehensive planning, development, and implementation of new radar installation projects, ensuring alignment with technical, regulatory, and operational requirements
    • System engineers for site design in radar systems are responsible for the comprehensive planning, development, and implementation of radar equipment installations, ensuring optimal performance and integration within their operational environment
    • System Engineers are involved in the entire lifecycle of newly installed radar systems, from initial concept through to in-service support, ensuring that the site design meets technical, operational, and safety standards

Implementation Planning

  • Prepare a System Level Implementation Plan (SLIP) for government approval activities to include Site Surveys, Site Design, Facility Adaptation (Site Preparations), Installation Optimization and checkout, acceptance testing, and Equipment Cutover
    • Prepare a Site-Specific Implementation Plan (SSIP) based on a Generic Site Implementation Plan (GSIP), including a complete set of drawings, specifications, plans, and designs for construction, site preparation, installation, optimization, testing, legacy equipment removal, and disposition
    • Ensure SSIP includes all electrical, mechanical, test equipment, and physical installation aspects for new equipment installation solutions, including interfacing with government-specified demarcation points

Minimum Required Qualifications

  • Background in electrical engineering, systems engineering, or a related field, typically supported by a BSEE or MSEE degree
    • Experience in radar system design, testing, and integration
    • Knowledge of electronics, radar systems, and troubleshooting, typically gained through formal education or specialized technical training
    • Proficiency with diagnostic tools including oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, power meters, and signal generators
    • Ability to analyze facility drawings for accuracy and provide red-line changes where appropriate
    • Knowledge of Microsoft Office tools for documentation and high-level reporting
    • Ability to meet background investigation requirements associated with federal contract work

Experience Requirements by Level

Junior Systems Engineer

  • Demonstrated foundational experience or training in radar systems, electronics, or systems engineering
    • Exposure to radar system design, testing, or integration through education, military experience, or professional work

Mid-Level Systems Engineer

  • Minimum of six (6) years of experience in radar signal processing, digital and analog circuits, microprocessors, and antenna performance for primary and secondary radar systems
    • Ability to use diagnostic tools and software

Senior-Level Systems Engineer

  • Minimum of twelve (12) years of experience in radar signal processing, digital and analog circuits, microprocessors, and antenna performance for primary and secondary radar systems
    • Ability to use diagnostic tools and software

Additional Technical Knowledge

  • Understanding of structural components, MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) systems, equipment conditions, or network configuration

Work Environment

  • Remote-based role; candidates may reside anywhere within the United States
    • Approximately 25–30% travel required to project sites as needed
    • Travel expenses are reimbursed in accordance with company policy

Compensation

Air Traffic Control Radar System Engineers (Junior, Mid-Level, Senior) - $45.00 – $80.00 hrs. equivalent

Compensation is determined based on experience, qualifications, level (junior, mid, senior), geographic location, and internal equity considerations.

Crown complies with all applicable state and local pay transparency laws. The listed compensation range represents the good faith hourly range for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, geographic considerations, and business needs.

Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits package including a matching 401K, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, and generous PTO. Crown has been voted one of the best places to work in the Washington, DC area; we built this reputation by hiring great people who value and support the mission of our customers.

About Us

Crown Innovations is a recognized leader in research, development, and engineering with deep expertise in air traffic management, infrastructure modernization, lifecycle data management, and National Airspace System integration.

For over 30 years, Crown has supported a diverse portfolio of clients including the FAA, NASA, federal agencies, state and local governments, and commercial organizations.
