jobs.excerpt: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer — Ecosystem Experience At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact.
jobs.description:
Senior Fullstack Software Engineer — Ecosystem Experience

At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software.

Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

You’ll join our Ecosystem Experience team — the group that connects Semble to the wider healthcare ecosystem: labs, pharmacies, partner APIs, webhooks, and Semble Connect, our automation platform built on Workato.

We work closely with Product, Business, and external partners, and we ship in a large TypeScript monorepo used across the company.

We are a passionate and driven team, proud to unite under strong cultural drivers:

  • Impact — We do work that matters.
  • Collaboration — We are in it together.
  • Human touch — We care deeply

We are also quick to embrace new technologies: we have rapidly adopted AI internally, and we are always looking to work with people who are excited to augment their work with AI.

This role can be fully remote in the UK and EU, with occasional travel to our London or Paris offices, within +/- 2 hours of the GMT time zone. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

What You Will Be Doing

As a senior engineer on Ecosystem Experience, you’ll own problems end to end — from partner discovery through design, implementation, rollout, and production reliability.

We expect you to operate with a high degree of autonomy and to raise the technical bar for the team.

  • Lead the design and delivery of integrations that move clinical and operational data safely between Semble and external systems, including REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, HL7, SFTP, and iPaaS/automation flows.
  • Work across the stack in our Yarn/Nx TypeScript monorepo: React on the frontend, Node.js services and domain modules on the backend, GraphQL (internal and public APIs), and MongoDB.
  • Take ambiguous partner specs and product goals and turn them into clear technical designs, sequenced delivery plans, and clinically safe, testable solutions.
  • Make sound architectural trade-offs — simplicity vs flexibility, build vs buy, speed vs long-term maintainability — and document the decisions so others can follow them.
  • Own production outcomes: monitoring and alerting (e.g. Datadog), incident diagnosis, root-cause analysis, and durable fixes — not just shipping features.
  • Improve reliability and operability: failure handling, retries, idempotency, credentials/secrets, multi-tenant config, and safe rollouts across many production environments.
  • Contribute to Semble Connect and related automation — provisioning, connections, recipe/webhook patterns, and the product surfaces that expose them to practices.
  • Set a high quality bar through design reviews, thorough code reviews, automated tests (unit, integration, e2e), and pragmatic CI/CD improvements.
  • Mentor and unstick teammates; give clear feedback; help more junior engineers grow without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Influence the Ecosystem Experience roadmap and technical standards — surfacing risks early, proposing better approaches, and aligning stakeholders when requirements conflict.

What We Are Looking For

We’re looking for a senior fullstack engineer who enjoys messy real-world integrations as much as clean product UI — someone comfortable reading a partner OpenAPI spec in the morning and shipping a resilient production path by the afternoon.

You should already be operating at a senior level: driving work independently, elevating those around you, and thinking beyond the ticket in front of you.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years' professional experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript, including substantial time operating as a senior / staff-of-one on complex features.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Node.js backends and APIs (REST and/or GraphQL).
  • Proven experience integrating with third-party systems — APIs, webhooks, auth flows, retries, idempotency, credentials/secrets.
  • Ability to design systems, not just implement tickets: break down large problems, define interfaces/contracts, and leave codebases easier to change than you found them.
  • Comfort working in ambiguity — clarifying requirements, challenging weak specs, and driving decisions when information is incomplete.
  • A production ownership mindset: debugging complex issues across services, reading logs/metrics traces, and preventing the same incident twice.
  • Solid automated testing habits (unit/integration/e2e) and comfort with CI/CD; you know when to add coverage and when not to over-engineer.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB or similar) and cloud-hosted applications (AWS preferred).
  • Strong written and verbal communication — RFCs/tech notes, partner discussions, and clear updates for Product and other engineers.
  • Collaborative leadership without needing formal authority: mentoring, reviewing thoughtfully, and aligning people around a plan.
  • Security and privacy awareness appropriate for handling sensitive healthcare data — least privilege, secrets hygiene, safe logging.
  • Comfort using AI coding tools to accelerate delivery without lowering the quality bar.

Strong Pluses

  • Healthcare, HL7/FHIR, lab/pharmacy, or other regulated-domain integrations.
  • iPaaS / automation platforms (Workato or similar).
  • Design systems / component libraries, and large monorepo experience.
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / CDK), observability (Datadog or similar), and multi-tenant SaaS.
  • Experience leading technical delivery across multiple engineers or workstreams.
  • Playwright or Cypress e2e experience.
  • Bilingual English–French.

What You’ll Get in Return

  • The great feeling coming with knowing you do something that matters: improving healthcare!
  • £70,000–90,000 package, based on your experience and the value you can bring.
  • Autonomy and ownership — we’ll set the vision and share the context, then we trust you to run with things – that’s the reason we hire you!
  • 36 days off: 25 holidays + bank holidays + 3 extra days (birthday and ‘feel good’ days) — that we will expect you to actually take so you can recharge and rest.
  • Company Equity — We appreciate and recognise all of our employees’ contributions, so everyone is eligible for Semble share options!
  • Comprehensive health & wellbeing support — including private health insurance, and mental health support and free therapy sessions through Oliva.
  • Hybrid & flexible work environment — work from anywhere in the UK, with also some flexibility to work across Europe. You decide how much or how little you go to the office.
  • Get the tech you need — You will get the latest MacBook (unless you prefer Windows) and take your pick across a wide range of equipment to setup your home office ergonomically.
  • Work alongside an inspiring team — our two founders have started Semble after a successful startup exit, and your future colleagues are all knowledgeable and innovators in their field.
  • Fantastic office space in Central London, right outside Monument — with a roof terrace, weekly activities, loads of natural light, and cute doggies!
  • The usual free bits coming with nice offices — barista coffee, tea, fruits, happy hours and activities...

Equality Now is seeking an experienced People & Culture Special Projects Consultant to provide project-based support to the People & Culture team from approximately September 1 through December 15, 2026. The focus is on project execution, developing practical tools and resources, and moving initiatives through completion and implementation.

  • Automate elements of onboarding and offboarding where possible.
  • Develop reminders, approvals, checklists, and workflows.
  • Support testing, implementation, and user guidance.

5. Recruitment Tools and Processes

  • Standardize recruitment templates and workflows.
  • Develop structured interview guides and candidate assessment tools.
  • Create practical resources for hiring managers.
  • Improve recruitment tracking and documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve consistency and efficiency.

The consultant will not serve as Equality Now's primary recruiter unless separately agreed.

6. Employee and Manager Resources
Develop practical resources such as manager toolkits, employee FAQs, templates, checklists, onboarding and offboarding materials, policy guidance, documentation resources, and recruitment tools.

7. Special Projects and Implementation
The consultant may also support other discrete People & Culture projects through research, benchmarking, project planning, stakeholder coordination, drafting materials, tracking deliverables, implementation support, and project handover.

jobs.description:
Role Description

At Dropbox, people are our greatest asset. The People Analytics team partners closely with leaders across the company to help them make better, data-informed decisions about how we identify, attract, develop, and retain top talent. As Dropbox continues to scale and evolve its Talent Acquisition strategy, we’re looking for a Data Analyst who is passionate about problem-solving and using data to shape how we hire.

In this role, you’ll partner deeply with Talent Acquisition, People Partners, and business leaders to analyze hiring data, uncover trends, and surface insights that influence workforce planning, recruiting strategy, and candidate experience. You’ll work across quantitative and qualitative data to understand what drives successful hiring outcomes, where bottlenecks exist, and how we can improve efficiency, quality, and equity in our hiring processes.

You should have a demonstrated ability to think analytically about the business, translate ambiguous questions into structured analyses, and deliver clear, actionable insights. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, high standards for data quality, and the ability to communicate findings in ways that drive real decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Partner on analytics initiatives to understand and improve the effectiveness, efficiency, and quality of hiring across Dropbox.
  • Create clarity from ambiguity, bringing structure to complex data and stakeholder narratives to identify the underlying question, establish analytical rigor, and drive actionable conclusions.
  • Monitor and analyze core Talent Acquisition metrics, proactively identifying trends and uncovering the“what” and“why” behind changes in performance.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders; lead requirements gathering and translate business questions into clear analyses and insights that inform People and business leader decisions.
  • Answer complex business questions through independent investigation and data forensics, leveraging the data warehouse to deliver timely, high-impact insights.
  • Uphold high standards for data quality and consistency by validating data, standardizing definitions and calculations, and contributing to shared data toolkits and enablement materials.
  • Ability to treat employee experience as a product, applying product management and design thinking to understand needs, prototype solutions, and drive execution through strong project management and data-driven iteration.

Requirements

  • BA/BS in an analytical or quantitative field such as Industrial/Organizational Psychology, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in an HR-focused, stakeholder-facing Data Analytics role, with at least 1 year of experience focusing on Recruiting/Talent Acquisition insights.
  • Fluency in SQL and advanced Excel; experience using statistical or analytical tools such as R or Python.
  • Strong storytelling skills with data, including the ability to select appropriate analytical approaches and visualization techniques for different audiences and decision contexts.
  • Proven ability to analyze large, complex datasets, synthesize insights quickly, and communicate clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Demonstrated experience driving analytics projects end to end, from problem framing and analysis through to execution and impact.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools in the flow of work. Candidates with a pre-existing comfort level & familiarity using AI to enhance productivity are strongly preferred.
  • Ability to think creatively and critically and thrive in a fast-paced, multifaceted, and often ambiguous environment.
  • Collaborative, humble team player who proactively supports teammates and shared goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to conceptualize employee experience as a product, with proven success applying product management principles(roadmapping, user journeys, feature prioritization) to HR initiatives
  • Proficiency in leveraging design thinking methodologies to deeply understand employee needs, rapidly prototype experience solutions, and implement data-driven iteration cycles that measurably enhance engagement and retention

Preferred Qualifications

  • IO Psychology/assessment background
  • Prior roles in People analytics(vs. other analytics)
  • Strong exec presence / verbal presentation skills

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

jobs.description:
What we're looking for

Role: Senior Research Director

Team: Research

Reports To: Managing Director, Research

Supervisory Responsibility: This role will have 2-4 direct reports and oversee teams of 6-8 Research Directors and Research Managers.

Location: We have a remote working policy, so we are looking for teammates anywhere in the US! However, we do have pods in NYC, Chicago, and D.C., where we would love for you to work any time you’d like. Our standard operating hours are Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm EST. Actual work schedules will be based on the candidate's time zone and client requirements.

Travel: This role will occasionally be expected to travel for ad hoc in-person customer requests, in-person internal working sessions, and our once per year US All Team Summit.

A little about us

Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.

Overview

The purpose of the Senior Research Director role is to to lead a pod of researchers to deliver exceptional client outcomes while directly owning and executing high-impact, complex research engagements. As both a people leader and a hands-on research leader, this role is responsible for ensuring successful delivery across their pod’s portfolio of accounts, while serving as the first point of escalation for client and project challenges. The Senior Research Director’s impact is ultimately measured by customer satisfaction, growth, and retention, as well as successfully helping the GTM team land new clients to Knit.

You will own

The research function is a primary contributor to Knit's shared business objective of growing Contracted Annual Recurring Revenue (CARR) — through both customer retention and upsells, measured by Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and through successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions that convert new logos into recurring revenue.

The levers the Senior Director - Research owns to influence these key business objectives are:

  • Research Pod Leadership → Structuring and optimizing pod operations to drive high performance, accountability, and quality, while contributing to the evolution of broader research processes and operating models across Knit. Leads, develops, and motivates team members, setting the standard through hands-on, high-impact client leadership.
  • Driving Research Success → Ensuring the research pod works effectively with Customers to successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their projects with Knit, measured by successfully achieving Research Objectives and delivering on Knit’s Quality & Speed service-level agreements (SLA’s).

Primary responsibilities:

  • Serving as the person ultimately accountable for research project success across their pod of RDs and RMs — acting as the primary point of escalation for Research Directors when research needs exceed what they can own independently
  • Successful & effective people management, ensuring they are successfully fulfilling their role’s responsibilities and growing in impact (People Management at Knit includes driving performance, driving clarity and accountability, hiring, onboarding, upskilling competencies, performance management, conflict resolution, and morale building.)
  • Driving and documenting in-depth project scoping to uncover a deep understanding of research objectives and project context to set up project success, including building out the client's Research Context Library (RCL) — capturing norms, standards, and preferences to align Knit's outputs to client-ready deliverables
  • Driving as the strategic problem solver, research subject matter expert, and solutions architect for for our highest potential prospects and customers, working with Sales to educate them on Knit’s research capabilities, consulting with them to adjust for fringe requirements, and proposing solutions to maximize project success
  • Participating in continuous product innovation by driving a tight feedback loop between customer delivery and Knit's product team — surfacing gaps between Knit's AI output and human-researcher quality, documenting "last mile" needs (what happens after delivery to get a project truly "stakeholder ready"), and ensuring that feedback is shared back with the team and acted upon to close those gaps
  • Partnering with the sales team on new business conversations — including scoping calls, capabilities presentations, and proposal input — to support successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions and new logo acquisition
  • Helping drive research team adoption of Knit’s product as new workflows and tooling become available

About you:

  • Must have 10+ years of market research experience, including at least 3 years of team management experience, with the majority of the time spent on the supplier side in a market research agency environment.
  • Must have experience leading discovery and scoping calls, writing and editing quant and qual questionnaires from scratch, drafting analysis plans, and creating and presenting stakeholder-ready insights topline & reports.
  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes in ambiguous environments, both for navigating complex customer needs and Knit internal business changes. Proven track record successfully operating in an early stage startup (<50 employees) is a plus.
  • Proven track record of owning client relationships with customers at Enterprise, Fortune 500 US-based companies, specifically working with insights professionals to scope and achieve desired research outcomes, resulting in customer retention and growth.
  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes successfully in environments with competing priorities, multiple research projects on at a given time, and simultaneous internal business demands.
  • Effective People Manager - specifically in driving clarity and accountability, hiring, onboarding, performance management, conflict resolution, and morale building.

Benefits

Upon joining the Knit team, you will receive a competitive salary, Equity Options, Healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), and Additional Coverage, a company laptop and one-time, onboarding Technology Stipend, a 401(k) with company match, flexible time-off, hybrid working, and more!

Our Company Values

We are the Championship Team. This means we:

Fullstack Team Lead (m/f/d)

India, Remote

Hello 👋 I am Servesh, Co- founder and CTO at Kayzen, and I am now looking for a Fullstack Team Lead to lead our Fullstack team. 🙌 But wait, you have not heard of Kayzen before? 😃

Kayzen is a mobile demand-side platform (DSP) dedicated to democratizing programmatic advertising. We enable leading apps, agencies, media buyers, and brands to run programmatic customer acquisition, retargeting, and brand performance campaigns through its self-serve and managed service options. Built on the three core pillars of performance, transparency, and control, Kayzen powers the world’s best mobile marketing teams with bespoke solutions that fuel business growth and deliver a competitive advantage. With an unprecedented scale of 160B+ daily ad requests from 1.6B+ unique users worldwide, we serve up to 1B+ ads per day in 180 countries. Kayzen is accessible through our APIs and user interface.

The Team

The Fullstack team owns the user-facing applications and interfaces that power the Kayzen platform — from our self-serve campaign management dashboard and real-time reporting suite to internal tooling used by our managed service teams. We work closely with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data teams to deliver seamless, high-performance experiences. We are responsible for some of the most impactful work at Kayzen, including:

  • “The Console” which is the face of Kayzen we are very proud of.
  • Complex features which surface a lot of backend infrastructure via console
  • Almost 100% uptime with very well planned & executed project management

Sounds interesting. Isn’t it?

About the Role

We are looking for a coding-first Fullstack Team Lead who is as comfortable in the IDE as they are in a sprint planning session. You should be an early adopter of AI-assisted engineering (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) not just for your team's productivity, but in your own daily coding workflows. You will own the translation of complex product requirements into high-performance UIs while managing the 'execution gap' across your team's projects.

Responsibilities

  • Core responsibilities
    • Lead and mentor a team of Fullstack engineers, fostering a culture of quality, ownership, and continuous improvement
    • Hands-on contribution to the codebase — writing production code, conducting code reviews, and setting coding standards
    • Collaborate closely with Product, Design,QA and Backend teams to deliver cohesive, user-centric features
    • Define and drive the Fullstack technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap
    • Recruit, onboard, and grow fullstack engineering talent
  • Hands-on AI Implementation
    • Lead by example by integrating AI-powered coding agents and automated LLM-based testing into your own daily development cycle to set the pace for the team.
    • Architect and build 'AI-First' UI patterns, moving beyond static dashboards to generative, prompt-driven interfaces in collaboration with the LLM Platform team.
  • Project & Execution Management
    • Manage the 'Execution Gap' within the Fullstack pod, ensuring that high-level product roadmaps are broken down into actionable, high-velocity engineering sprints with zero 'slippage'
    • Drive 'Ruthless Prioritization' within the team to maintain a high delivery heartbeat, balancing technical debt with feature velocity.

Requirements

Fullstack Technical Excellence (Core Focus)

  • 10+ of professional Fullstack development experience with majority of experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Deep expertise in at least one major framework (React, Angular, or Vue) and its ecosystem
  • Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility
  • Experience building complex, data-heavy UIs with real-time data visualization
  • Solid grasp of Fullstack performance optimization — bundle size, rendering, lazy loading, caching strategies
  • Experience with state management patterns (Redux, MobX, Zustand, or similar)
  • Proficiency with Fullstack testing methodologies — unit, integration, and end-to-end (Jest, Cypress, Playwright, or similar)
  • Familiarity with design systems and component library development
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) to boost engineering productivity

Leadership & Engineering Maturity

  • 2+ years of experience leading or managing a Fullstack engineering team is a must
  • Proven track record of mentoring engineers and conducting impactful code reviews
  • Experience defining Fullstack architecture for large-scale applications
  • Strong understanding of APIs, RESTful services, GraphQL, and system design
  • Ability to balance technical debt management with feature delivery
  • Excellent communication skills — can articulate technical decisions to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

Startup Mindset

  • Bias for shipping and iteration — you deliver incrementally and learn from real users
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change in a fast-paced environment
  • Thinking in terms of leverage and reuse, not one-off solutions
  • Pragmatic about trade-offs between perfectionism and speed of delivery

Less About

  • People-only managers who have drifted away from active development. We need someone who can jump into a critical bug or a complex refactor alongside their team, leveraging the latest AI tools to solve problems faster.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with ad-tech, real-time bidding platforms, or high-traffic data products
  • Contributions to open-source Fullstack projects or community involvement
  • Experience building Fullstack interfaces for AI/ML-powered products (e.g., chatbots, recommendation engines, AI-generated content displays)
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs and prompt-driven UI patterns

What do we offer?

  • Reporting directly to Co-founder & CTO
  • Direct access to top management and an extremely “visible” role
  • Exceptional career growth and learning opportunity
  • A unique opportunity to be part of an experienced team of industry experts and entrepreneurs who bring massive change to the Adtech market
  • A fun, driven, and multinational team located across Germany, India, UK, Argentina, Ukraine, Turkey, Spain and many more countries
  • A flexible work-from-home arrangement
  • A 500-dollar home-office setup budget
  • A 1000-dollar annual learning and development budget

The Senior Security Operations Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and improving Data Loss Prevention (DLP) protections across Included Health's corporate and cloud environments. You will lead hands-on deployment and tuning of DLP controls, including endpoint, network, and SaaS. You will investigate and respond to potential data exfiltration events. Additionally, you will drive remediation and hardening based on real-world incidents and detections.

You will own the operational lifecycle of our DLP stack. It involves building and refining policies, partnering with stakeholders to validate business-safe controls, automating response playbooks, and turning signals from alerts and logs into durable security improvements. You will also contribute to adjacent security operations functions, including incident response and vulnerability management, where they intersect with data protection.

You will play a crucial role within the Security Engineering team, reporting directly to the Senior Manager, Security Engineering. This is a remote role.

Responsibilities:

    • Lead the response to DLP and data security incidents, including investigation, containment, remediation, and root cause analysis for suspected data exfiltration or improper data handling.

    • Own the deployment, configuration, and continuous tuning of DLP controls across endpoints, network egress, SaaS applications, and cloud storage to protect PHI, PII, PCI, and other sensitive data.

    • Develop and maintain DLP policies, rules, and classifications that balance security, usability, and regulatory/client requirements.

    • Build and refine automated response playbooks and workflows that enrich, triage, and respond to alerts, reducing manual effort and mean time to respond.

    • Perform proactive hunting for anomalous data movement, including unusual destinations, channels, or volumes.

    • Define and track key DLP metrics (coverage, detection quality, MTTD/MTTR, false positive rate) and communicate progress to security leadership and cross-functional partners.

Qualifications:

    • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, or security engineering roles, with a strong emphasis on data protection and DLP.

    • Direct, hands-on experience deploying, tuning, and operating

      • DLP tools (endpoint, network, SaaS, and/or cloud)

      • Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) or similar SaaS security controls in a production environment.

      • DLP signals into SIEM/SOAR workflows (e.g., CrowdStrike, Splunk, Sentinel)

      • Advanced scripting/automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell, KQL/SQL) used to enrich, tune, and report on DLP/IR telemetry at scale.

      • Experience designing and maintaining data classification and policy frameworks for PHI, PII, PCI, and other sensitive data types.

Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. A companhia impulsiona a transformação digital de grandes empresas habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis, possibilitando assim que seus clientes ofereçam produtos e experiências digitais a todo o seu ecossistema.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:


Qual a missão do Cargo?

Manter de pé, observável e previsível a plataforma que sustenta as operações de Soluções Open em produção. É um ambiente multi-tenant, em cloud (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform), onde indisponibilidade não é inconveniente operacional — é descumprimento de obrigação regulatória, com janela de reporte e prazo definidos por regulador. O desafio central é deslocar a operação de reativa para preventiva: construir observabilidade que antecipe problema em vez de constatá-lo depois, e eliminar por automação o trabalho manual repetitivo. A pessoa nesta posição irá responder pelas soluções Open atuando junto de arquitetos cloud e de software, além de desenvolvedores, com responsabilidade compartilhada pelo que está no ar.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Observabilidade e monitoração: Construir e evoluir a monitoração dos ambientes de produção, com foco em antecipar falha; Definir e instrumentar indicadores que representem experiência real de uso, não apenas saúde de recurso; Reduzir ruído de alerta e falso positivo; Manter dashboards que sustentem decisão técnica.
  • Automação e redução de toil: Identificar e eliminar trabalho manual repetitivo: provisionamento, configuração, rotinas operacionais; Evoluir infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Helm) como fonte única de verdade; Desenvolver scripts e automações em Python e Shell para operações recorrentes; Converter procedimento não documentado em runbook executável.
  • Sustentação e resposta a incidente: Atuar na triagem, mitigação e resolução de incidentes de produção; Documentar e apoiar post-mortem com foco em causa raiz e ação preventiva; Sustentar os ambientes junto do time de engenharia; Acompanhar consumo e custo de infraestrutura, gerando visibilidade para decisão técnica

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

Experiência demonstrável, não familiaridade conceitual:

  • Ter operado Kubernetes em produção: debug de pod, análise de consumo de recurso, entendimento de modos de falha Cloud em ambiente de missão crítica — AWS preferencialmente
  • Ter escrito e mantido infraestrutura como código com Terraform e Helm, incluindo revisão de mudança de outra pessoa
  • Ter construído monitoração com Prometheus e Grafana: criação de métrica e regra de alerta, não apenas consumo de dashboard pronto
  • Troubleshooting em Linux com autonomia: serviços, processos, rede, disco, análise de log
  • Automações em Python ou Shell que outras pessoas passaram a usar
  • Participação em resposta a incidente de produção, com clareza sobre quando resolver e quando escalar
  • Conhecimento de rede suficiente para investigar: segmentação, DNS, TLS, VPN, ferramentas de debug

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiência em ambiente regulado: financeiro, seguros ou similar
  • Vivência com APIs, REST e gateway de API
  • Gerenciamento de logs em escala (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Loki ou equivalente)
  • Construção e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD
  • Prática de definição de SLI e SLO, e uso de error budget para orientar decisão
  • Configuração como código (Ansible ou equivalente) Inglês para leitura de documentação técnica

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.

  • Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.
    Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

  • Pensando em promover times cada vez mais diversos e ambientes de trabalho plurais, nossa missão é mapear os diferentes públicos que alcançamos com ele! Por isso, faremos algumas perguntinhas relacionadas à diversidade*, tudo bem? =)

jobs.excerpt: Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.
jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

TopDog Law is scaling quickly, and Intake sits at the center of that growth. We are looking for a Director of Intake Operations who can build the leadership, operating discipline, and execution needed to turn demand into qualified opportunities, signed clients, and an exceptional first experience with our firm.

This is a build-and-lead role, not a maintenance role. You will lead a multi-function organization spanning Intake, In-House Signing, White Glove, and Reception/Client Success and create the structure, accountability, and operating rhythm that allow each team to perform at a high level as we continue to grow.

You will be accountable for execution against the KPIs that matter most to Intake, including true-to-routed rate, sign rate, speed to lead, answer rate, contact rate, intake quality, and agent productivity. The VP of Contact Strategy will set the direction, priorities, and target outcomes; your job is to turn that direction into clear operating plans, develop the leaders responsible for delivery, remove barriers, and make sure improvements stick. The Manager of Intake owns the day-to-day operation of Intake and

In-House Signing, while White Glove and Reception/Client Success leadership report directly to the Director until those functions require additional manager-level structure.

What You Will Own

Turn Strategy Into Execution

  • Take Contact Strategy priorities, KPI targets, and major firm initiatives and turn them into clear operating plans with owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
  • Build a consistent operating cadence across Intake, In-House Signing, White Glove, and Reception/Client Success so leaders know what matters, where performance stands, and what needs action.
  • Create alignment across specialized teams without forcing a one-size-fits-all approach to workflows, skills, or client handling.
  • Make change stick by ensuring new processes are communicated clearly, trained effectively, measured, and reinforced by leaders.

Know the Numbers and Drive Performance

  • Own execution against established Intake KPIs, including true-to-routed rate, sign rate, speed to lead, answer rate, contact rate, intake quality, and agent productivity.
  • Run disciplined business reviews that move beyond reporting the numbers to identifying root causes, assigning actions, and following through to results.
  • Translate department goals into clear expectations for managers, supervisors, teams, and individual contributors so every level understands how it contributes to the outcome.
  • Partner with Analytics to build trusted, actionable reporting and use the data to spot trends early, test solutions, and measure impact.

Build Leaders Who Build High-Performing Teams

  • Lead and develop the Manager of Intake and other functional leaders, giving them clear ownership, decision rights, expectations, and coaching.
  • Hold direct reports accountable for the day-to-day performance of Intake and In-House Signing, including supervisor effectiveness, productivity, coaching, quality, and process adherence.
  • Directly lead White Glove and Reception/Client Success leadership and determine when growth, complexity, or span of control warrants additional manager-level structure.
  • Build leadership bench strength and succession plans so the organization can continue to scale without creating single points of dependency.

Keep Intake Ready for What Comes Next

  • Make sure Intake is ready to execute new law firm initiatives, state launches, policy changes, case-evaluation updates, and new workflows from day one.
  • Partner with Learning & Development, Quality Assurance, and Legal to ensure training is accurate, practical, timely, and reinforced in the operation.
  • Use QA findings, conversion trends, decline patterns, and performance data to identify where the team needs stronger knowledge, coaching, or retraining.
  • Set a high bar for decision accuracy, routing quality, documentation, client communication, and process compliance across every Intake function.

Improve Conversion and Prospective Client Experience

  • Drive initiatives that make it easier and faster for prospective clients to reach us, complete Intake, understand next steps, and move toward the right outcome.
  • Find and eliminate friction, unnecessary handoffs, inconsistent processes, and missed opportunities throughout the prospective-client journey.
  • Raise the bar on follow-up execution, objection handling, intake decision quality, case routing, and signing readiness.
  • Standardize the fundamentals while preserving the specialized approach required for catastrophic, high-value, sensitive, or complex client interactions.

Stay Ahead of Demand

  • Partner with Workforce Management to connect lead volume and marketing investment to forecasting, staffing, schedules, hiring plans, and capacity decisions.
  • Keep staffing and leadership capacity ahead of anticipated demand so growth does not come at the expense of speed, conversion, quality, or client experience.
  • Use productivity, adherence, shrinkage, overtime, coverage, and capacity trends to identify where operating changes are needed before they become performance problems.
  • Make balanced operating decisions that consider service, conversion, employee experience, quality, and cost together.

Connect Intake to the Rest of the Business

  • Serve as the senior Intake partner to Contact Strategy Platforms, Workforce Management, Quality Assurance, Learning & Development, Analytics, Marketing, Legal, and other operational teams.
  • Turn business problems into clear requirements for Genesys, Salesforce, Filevine, reporting, automation, AI, and other tools that support Intake.
  • Own operational readiness for technology and workflow changes by making sure testing, training, communication, and adoption are complete before and after launch.
  • Drive cross-functional issues to resolution when they are affecting conversion, client experience, quality, productivity, or employee performance.

Protect the Business and Communicate Clearly

  • Ensure Intake consistently follows approved legal, compliance, calling, recording, documentation, data-handling, and client-communication requirements.
  • Surface material operational, client, compliance, staffing, or capacity risks early and bring forward clear recommendations, owners, and next steps.
  • Give the VP of Contact Strategy a concise, transparent view of performance, risks, priorities, execution progress, and resource needs.
  • Build a culture where leaders move with urgency, own their results, solve problems at the right level, and keep the client at the center of decisions.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in legal intake, contact center operations, sales, customer acquisition, or another high-volume, performance- driven service environment, including 5+ years leading managers, supervisors, or multiple layers of frontline leadership.
  • Demonstrated success improving conversion, contact rate, speed to lead, service, quality, productivity, or comparable operating metrics.
  • Experience leading multiple operational functions, teams, shifts, or locations with different workflows, customer needs, and performance expectations.
  • Strong working knowledge of performance management, workforce planning, quality, training, and operational analytics, with the ability to diagnose root causes and turn data into action.
  • Strong executive communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to create clarity, influence decisions, and move work forward in a fast-changing environment.
  • High ownership, strong judgment, and the ability to balance growth, client experience, employee development, compliance, operational discipline, and financial performance.

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Experience with Salesforce, Genesys Cloud CX, Filevine, or comparable CRM and contact center platforms.
  • Experience leading teams across multiple locations, countries, or time zones and driving large-scale operational change, automation, or AI-enabled workflows.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

jobs.excerpt: About UsAre you looking to make a meaningful impact through your work?
jobs.description:
About Us

Are you looking to make a meaningful impact through your work? Join us at the Long-Term Stock Exchange (LTSE). We are an SEC-registered national securities exchange designed to promote fair and orderly markets, as well as help long-term focused companies get the credit they deserve. We are an innovative business ecosystem dedicated to reimagining the role of capital markets for a more equitable and sustainable future.

At LTSE, we work with companies to identify long-term investors that will value their efforts to prioritize sustainable, long-term growth. As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to leverage your diverse background and skills toward a compelling mission that delivers tangible results. By supporting businesses in creating multi-stakeholder value, we generate a positive ripple effect that benefits communities, employees, and beyond.

Founded by Eric Ries, a visionary entrepreneur and creator of the Lean Startup methodology, LTSE offers a unique and rewarding environment where you can contribute to building a better future for all. Apply today.

The Opportunity

LTSE is looking for an Enterprise Risk Manager who brings both rigor and practical judgment to complex business and regulatory questions. In this role, you will help shape and operate an enterprise risk management program that supports sound decisions, responsible growth, and the resilience of the exchange.

This is an opportunity for an experienced risk professional who wants meaningful ownership - not simply maintaining a framework, but working directly with leaders and teams across the company to surface risk early, challenge assumptions thoughtfully, and turn analysis into action. You will lead significant ERM work, advise cross-functional partners, and help make risk management a useful part of how LTSE operates.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead significant components of LTSE's enterprise risk management program, including risk identification, assessment, monitoring, governance, documentation, and reporting.
  • Plan and facilitate enterprise and functional risk assessments, bringing together quantitative and qualitative information to identify priorities and recommend action.
  • Own the quality and ongoing maintenance of the enterprise risk register, including risk ratings, controls, mitigation plans, accountable owners, and progress updates.
  • Monitor key risk indicators, incidents, control issues, audit findings, regulatory developments, market trends, and emerging risks—and ensure material concerns are surfaced promptly.
  • Partner with colleagues across trading, compliance, legal, finance, technology, operations, marketing, and other functions to embed effective risk practices into decisions and day-to-day work.
  • Develop and improve risk policies, procedures, frameworks, standards, and tools so they remain practical, current, and responsive to LTSE's evolving needs.
  • Design and lead scenario analyses, stress tests, control evaluations, and other complex risk reviews, selecting the right approach for each question.
  • Prepare clear risk reporting and recommendations for senior leaders and governance forums, and support materials for the Audit Committee, regulators, and external auditors.
  • Lead assigned workstreams for regulatory examinations, internal and external audits, and other assurance activities—from coordinating responses through driving follow-up actions.
  • Serve as a trusted risk advisor on cross-functional projects, business changes, and new initiatives, helping teams balance opportunity, regulatory expectations, and LTSE's risk appetite.
  • Own LTSE’s third-party vendor management review process, and seek out smarter ways to work by improving or automating risk processes, data collection, reporting, and controls.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Deep working knowledge of enterprise risk management frameworks, methods, and tools, with the judgment to adapt them to complex business and regulatory questions.
  • Experience independently planning and leading complex risk work, establishing an effective approach, coordinating contributors, and knowing when an issue needs to be escalated.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, paired with the ability to synthesize complexity into clear, practical recommendations.
  • The confidence and credibility to ask thoughtful questions, constructively challenge assumptions, and influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to make risk information useful to technical, business, executive, and governance audiences.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, attention to detail, and a strong commitment to confidentiality and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience in enterprise, operational, compliance, technology, financial, or a related area of risk management—ideally within financial services, a regulated organization, an exchange, broker-dealer, fintech, or market infrastructure environment.
  • Deep understanding of market structure, trading mechanisms, regulatory requirements, internal controls, audit, or governance processes.
  • At least 6-8 years of directly related or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with risk reporting, data visualization, or workflow automation tools.
  • A relevant professional certification, such as FRM, CRMP, RIMS-CRMP, CISA, or a comparable credential.

How We Work

At LTSE, long-term thinking and urgency go hand in hand. We value people who take responsibility, work transparently, seek out different perspectives, and approach difficult problems with curiosity and precision. In this role, you will have room to lead while working closely with colleagues who care about building durable systems, learning quickly, and improving how work gets done.

Why This Role Matters

Enterprise risk sits at the intersection of nearly every important decision an exchange makes. The person in this role will have visibility across the organization and the opportunity to influence how LTSE anticipates challenges, makes tradeoffs, and builds for resilience. Your work will help protect the business while enabling teams to move forward with greater clarity and confidence.

LTSE's Compensation Philosophy

The target salary range for this role is $155,000 - $195,000 with an anticipated starting salary at the midpoint of $175,000.

Base compensation is part of a total rewards package including stock options and benefits, and may include additional performance incentives. We review all employee pay and compensation programs annually using multiple databases including Pave, Radford, McLagan, and other peer sets, to ensure competitive and fair pay.

To determine the compensation for the role, we use a data-driven, blended rate approach to ensure we are paying competitively among our peers by benchmarking to companies of similar size and stage, and hire at the 50th percentile of the salary range.

Benefits

Some benefits may only be available for full-time employees. Please check with your recruiter to find out which benefits you are eligible for.

  • Drive Innovation. Make an impact working with a mission-driven company that shares your desire to create a new kind of public market.
  • Meet Great People. Work with skilled, committed, and supportive teammates, that have a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  • Achieve Balance. Enjoy the LTSE commitment to a sustainable remote-first work environment, including a flexible vacation policy.
  • Prioritize Health. Take charge of your health with rich medical, dental, vision, and EAP benefits. 100% of employee costs are sponsored by LTSE and there is a small, fixed employee contribution for dependent costs.
  • Focus on Family. All new parents receive up to 4 months of caregiver leave including 8 weeks of full salary continuation, all while keeping your full company-sponsored benefits for up to the full 4 months.
  • Foster Holistic Wellness and Growth. Receive reimbursements for up to $2000 worth of physical fitness, mental health and wellness, family care, pet care, and learning and development purchases and/or charitable giving annually with our Lifestyle Spending Accounts.
  • Get Set Up for Success. Launch quickly with your company provided laptop, cell phone reimbursement, and $500 home-office stipend.
  • Invest in Savings. Enroll in our 401k program offered through Human Interest, and other benefit programs offered through Gusto.
  • Take Ownership. Full-time employees receive LTSE equity options in both of our entities, with a generous exercise period for those who reach a 2-year milestone.

LTSE offers remote employment to candidates who reside in select states.

LTSE is committed to championing a performance based culture to advance the LTSE mission. This requires the highest level of employee engagement with a broad diversity of perspective, background and capability to accelerate mission actualization and impact. We believe that inclusion is a team effort, and every team member is expected to participate in building a welcoming and representative culture.

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran, genetic information, marital status or any other legally protected status.We enthusiastically work to make our application and interview processes accessible for candidates with disabilities.

jobs.description:
Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low-cost electricity into always-on heat and power, without supply-constrained critical minerals or multi-year construction timelines.

We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low-cost energy.

About The Role

Antora Energy is looking for a full-stack product engineer to build the software products that power our business - from external customer experiences to internal tools used by teams across Business Development, Operations, and R&D.

In this role, you’ll help shape product vision, design the underlying data models, and connect AI systems with the business logic that makes them useful. You’ll own products end to end, working directly with users to understand their workflows, translate ambiguous needs into practical solutions, and ship software that performs reliably in production.

You’ll also help build Antora’s long-term software capabilities. That means creating systems, standards, and guardrails that allow partner teams to safely modify existing tools and build new ones within our ecosystem - without engineering becoming a bottleneck.

This is a highly autonomous role with direct influence over how software is designed and built at Antora. We’re looking for deep expertise in one or more core areas - such as software engineering, data modeling, AI integration, or product development - along with the curiosity and practical judgment to work across the full stack.

What You'll Do
Build Full-Stack Products

Design, build, deploy, and maintain internal and external software products across the frontend, backend, data, and AI layers. Own the complete product lifecycle, including architecture, observability, reliability, and ongoing maintenance.


Enable Self-Service

Put workflow creation directly into users’ hands. Build systems that allow analysts, operators, and other domain experts to adapt their own tools without filing a ticket and waiting for engineering support.


Co-Create with Users

Work alongside the people doing the work. Learn their processes, build solutions with them, and give them the tools and confidence to continue improving those solutions independently.

When users contribute their own code or workflows, you’ll make those contributions safe to run, easy to review, and straightforward to maintain.

Establish a Unified Data Model

Design the data foundation that powers Antora’s products. Connect business systems, operational data, and plant telemetry through tested transformation pipelines and a governed semantic layer.

You’ll help ensure that critical concepts—such as revenue, availability, and delivered steam—have consistent definitions across dashboards, AI assistants, applications, and autonomous agents.

Design for Data Security

Build and enforce strong access controls for sensitive, proprietary, and counterparty-restricted data. Ensure every product, workflow, and AI interface consistently respects authorization boundaries.

At Antora, an AI system that answers an unauthorized question is not a clever feature—it is a business risk.

Build Proactive AI Guardrails

Make evaluation a core part of product development rather than a final checkpoint. Create systems that identify task failures, tool-calling errors, grounding gaps, security issues, and regressions before they reach users.

Where AI systems influence financial decisions, operational dispatch, or customer commitments, you’ll build safeguards that are rigorous, reliable, and easy for teams to use.

Set Engineering Standards

Help define architectural patterns, development practices, and technical guardrails across Antora’s software ecosystem. Distinguish between controls that prevent real failures and processes that create unnecessary friction.

What We're Looking For
  • Strong product judgment. You can turn vague, shifting requests into a clear product direction, write an effective specification, and ship a solution. You know how to challenge a feature request that misses the underlying problem while maintaining stakeholder trust.
  • Production software engineering experience. You have strong Python and TypeScript skills and are comfortable working across frontend and backend systems. You have owned applications end to end, including deployment, observability, reliability, and maintenance.
  • Experience shipping AI-powered products. You have built and deployed LLM-powered systems used by real users - and have learned from the unexpected ways those systems failed in production.
  • Strong data fundamentals. You are comfortable with SQL, warehouse modeling, and tools such as dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks. You have shipped data changes through CI and think proactively about data quality, freshness, lineage, and testing.
  • A collaborative approach to building. You have a track record of building with non-engineers, not simply building for them. You’re comfortable pairing, teaching, reviewing someone’s first pull request, and helping users become increasingly self-sufficient.
  • Clear cross-functional communication. You can connect product, data, AI, and software engineering considerations - and communicate technical decisions in a way that allows everyone in the room to contribute.
  • Practical risk judgment. You can distinguish between controls that prevent meaningful failures and ceremony that slows teams down. You know where users can safely make changes independently and where review or stronger governance is required.
  • A growth mindset. We do not expect one person to be an expert in every discipline. We value deep expertise, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to learn across the stack.
Bonus Qualifications
  • Experience building or maintaining semantic layers using tools such as dbt or Cube
  • Familiarity with ClickHouse, time-series data, or IoT systems
  • Experience with agent protocols such as MCP or with plugin and tool APIs
  • Background in energy, industrial technology, or manufacturing
  • Experience managing AI model usage, performance, and cost governance

Work Location: Remote / US based

Salary Range: $183-240k USD

Salary Basis:

Please note that the salary range listed above reflects Antora Energy's estimated pay for this position. The actual salary offered will be within the posted range and determined based on several factors including but not limited to a candidate's experiences, credentials and expertise, as they pertain to the position's requirements.

In addition to a competitive base salary, Antora Energy’s Total Rewards program includes equity compensation in the form of stock options, a premium health benefits package with life and disability insurance, a 401K plan with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts, and an industry leading paid-time-off policy that features flexible and inclusive holiday observance, as well as paid volunteer time off.

  • Practical understanding of cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP), OS fundamentals (Windows, macOS, Linux), networking concepts, and authentication protocols

  • Hands-on configuration experience with SSL/TLS inspection, DLP, SIEM integration, log streaming (NSS), and EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon
  • Strong network troubleshooting skills utilizing tools like tcpdump, Wireshark, ping, and traceroute/MTR alongside familiarity with DevSecOps workflows

ABOUT CITY SCIENCE

City Science was founded in 2015 with a core mission of delivering decarbonisation. We help organisations who are committed to decarbonisation achieve meaningful and quantifiable carbon reductions quickly and efficiently. We work collaboratively across our business to provide integrated solutions to our clients. Our range of clients is extensive and includes major bodies such as DESNZ, the Climate Change Committee (CCC), and a range of forward-thinking local authorities. Our business includes award-winning research, software and product development teams who produce innovative and uniquely insightful digital tools, like our GIS software, Cadence, to successfully deliver our projects.

Our Energy & Environment team leads complex consulting commissions across a broad range of technical disciplines and technologies. Examples of the projects we deliver includes:

  • District Heat Network studies (we are a supplier on the Heat Network Zoning DESNZ framework)

  • Local Area Energy Plans (LAEP) and Local Heat & Energy Efficiency Strategies (LHEES)

  • Renewable & Low Carbon Energy Assessments

  • Alternative Fuel Strategies (e.g. Hydrogen, SAF) and Industrial Decarbonisation

  • Technology specific research (such as our DACCS work for the Climate Change Committee)

Further information about some example projects we have delivered can be found on our website.

ABOUT THE ROLE

City Science is seeking a Consultant level candidate who can support delivery of our broad range of consulting commissions in our Energy & Environment Team.

We are particularly interested in candidates with a technical background (e.g. physical sciences or engineering), or those with an economics/finance background but with experience of applying these skills to the energy and low-carbon sectors.

Whilst our preference is for candidates with professional experience (2+ years), we encourage applications from those who have recently completed a relevant PhD. Experience in areas such as district heat networks, carbon accounting (particularly scope 3 emissions), local area energy plans, community energy and renewable energy is highly desirable.

You will contribute to the delivery of projects via research, report writing, analysis, and the production of models. Whilst a key requirement of this role is technical proficiency, we also have an expectation that you will contribute to common consultancy non-technical tasks such as project management, bid writing, stakeholder engagement, and client relationship management. As a Consultant within City Science’s Energy & Environment team, you will be responsible for:

· Data analysis (in Excel predominantly).

· Producing high quality reports and presentations for clients

· Supporting business development and the winning of new work, including preparing proposals, identifying new opportunities and promoting our business.

· Providing quality assurance for projects and technical deliverables

· Build and maintain strong client relationships.

Requirements

You’re motivated, proactive and customer-focused with exceptional attention to detail and the needs of our clients. You have broad technical knowledge and a genuine interest in decarbonisation, sustainability and low carbon solutions.

You’re a great collaborator, committed to the success of the team, with the flexibility to intelligently adapt to the task at hand. Most importantly, you are motivated to deliver high-quality work, solve complex problems and contribute positively to the success of the team.

Essential Requirements

Desirable

Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced QA Fullstack Engineer to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites across API (REST Assured), web UI (Selenide), and mobile (Appium) layers;

  • Where applicable, contribute to accessibility (A11Y) testing efforts;
  • Conduct performance/load testing using JMeter and provide optimization recommendations based on results.

Requirements

  • Manual Testing

- API testing: ability to read API specifications/documentation, independently build a test collection, and test a service using any common tool (Postman, Insomnia, SoapUI, etc.);

- Log analysis: ability to read logs and independently identify or localize defects;

- Mobile testing: familiarity with mobile-specific testing tasks — responsiveness, permissions handling, screen size/OS version coverage, application lifecycle testing.

  • Automation

- Java: confident, object-oriented programming skills; experience building test automation frameworks from scratch; clean, reusable code; familiarity with JUnit, TestNG, Maven/Gradle;

- REST Assured: automated REST API testing; solid grasp of HTTP methods, status codes, JSON, authentication; able to write and parameterize complex API test cases; integration with JUnit/TestNG;

- Selenide: automated UI testing for web applications; knowledge of the Page Object Model; stable, maintainable tests for dynamic interfaces; integration with JUnit/TestNG;

- Appium: automated mobile testing (Android/iOS); experience with emulators/simulators; native and hybrid app testing; CI/CD integration.

Would be a plus:- A11Y (accessibility) testing: awareness of inclusive design principles, WCAG Level A requirements, and practical use of accessibility tools (TalkBack, VoiceOver, NVDA, or JAWS);

- JMeter: performance/load testing; familiarity with Thread Group, Sampler, Listener, Assertion components; ability to load-test APIs, databases, and web applications; results analysis and optimization recommendations.

Project Coordinator (Asana, Trello, Monday.com & Project Operations) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (flexibility required around deadlines and project priorities)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Project Coordinator to bring structure, accountability, and visibility across multiple projects and operational workflows.

This is not a passive administrative role. You’ll act as the execution backbone of the team, coordinating timelines, tracking deliverables, maintaining project documentation, following up with stakeholders, and identifying risks before they impact deadlines.

You’ll work across tools such as Asana, Trello, Monday.com, Smartsheet, and Microsoft Project to ensure projects remain organized, visible, and on track.

If you’re highly organized, proactive with follow-ups, comfortable managing multiple moving parts, and skilled at keeping teams accountable, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Project Planning & Timeline Management

Support the planning and execution of multiple projects from kickoff through completion.

You’ll:

  • Maintain and update project plans and timelines.
  • Track milestones, dependencies, deadlines, and deliverables.
  • Keep project trackers accurate and current.
  • Monitor progress against established schedules.
  • Follow up on overdue or at-risk tasks.
  • Help teams stay aligned on priorities and upcoming deadlines.
  • Flag schedule conflicts and potential delays early.

You may work inside:

  • Asana
  • Trello
  • Monday.com
  • Smartsheet
  • Microsoft Project

Task, Milestone & Deliverable Tracking

Maintain clear visibility into project execution.

You’ll:

  • Create and update tasks and project boards.
  • Assign and track task ownership.
  • Monitor completion status across active projects.
  • Track dependencies between teams and deliverables.
  • Maintain milestone and deadline visibility.
  • Follow up proactively with task owners.
  • Ensure completed work is properly documented.
  • Prevent important deliverables from falling through the cracks.

Stakeholder Communication & Coordination

Act as a central coordination point between:

  • Project Managers
  • Team members
  • Leadership
  • Internal departments
  • Vendors and contractors
  • External stakeholders

You’ll:

  • Communicate project priorities and deadlines clearly.
  • Follow up consistently on outstanding action items.
  • Coordinate information between stakeholders.
  • Document important decisions and next steps.
  • Surface blockers requiring leadership attention.
  • Escalate delays before they impact project timelines.
  • Maintain clear visibility into ownership and accountability.

Meetings, Action Items & Follow-Up

Support productive project meetings by keeping discussions organized and action-oriented.

Responsibilities include:

  • Preparing meeting agendas.
  • Organizing relevant project materials.
  • Taking clear meeting notes.
  • Documenting decisions and action items.
  • Assigning owners and deadlines.
  • Distributing meeting recaps.
  • Following up until action items are completed.

Project Documentation & Reporting

Maintain organized and accessible project documentation using systems such as:

  • Google Drive
  • SharePoint
  • Confluence

Prepare and maintain:

  • Project plans
  • Meeting notes
  • Action-item trackers
  • Status reports
  • Risk registers
  • Project dashboards
  • Process documentation
  • Supporting project files

Ensure documentation remains current, structured, and easy for stakeholders to access.

Project Status Reporting

Prepare regular project updates for leadership and stakeholders.

Reports may include:

  • Overall project status
  • Milestone completion
  • Upcoming deadlines
  • Overdue tasks
  • Risks and blockers
  • Resource constraints
  • Key dependencies
  • Required decisions
  • Next steps

Translate project activity into clear, concise updates that allow leadership to understand where projects stand and where attention is needed.

Risk & Issue Management

Proactively identify potential project risks, including:

  • Delays
  • Bottlenecks
  • Missed dependencies
  • Resource constraints
  • Communication gaps
  • Quality concerns

Maintain risk and issue trackers and escalate concerns appropriately.

The goal is to identify problems before they become missed deadlines or operational disruptions.

Resource & Workflow Coordination

Support efficient allocation and coordination of project resources.

You’ll:

  • Monitor team capacity and task ownership.
  • Identify competing priorities.
  • Track dependencies between teams.
  • Coordinate handoffs between stakeholders.
  • Surface resource constraints.
  • Help maintain smooth project workflows.

Vendor & External Stakeholder Coordination

When projects involve external partners, you’ll:

  • Coordinate communication with vendors and contractors.
  • Track external deliverables and deadlines.
  • Maintain documentation and project updates.
  • Follow up on outstanding commitments.
  • Escalate delays or quality concerns.
  • Ensure external work remains aligned with project timelines.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • 2+ years of experience in project coordination, project support, operations coordination, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience with project management tools such as:
    • Asana
    • Trello
    • Monday.com
  • Experience maintaining:
    • Project plans
    • Timelines
    • Task trackers
    • Milestones
    • Deliverables
  • Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.
  • Experience building and maintaining operational trackers.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and documentation abilities.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong follow-up and accountability mindset.
  • Comfortable coordinating remotely across multiple stakeholders.
  • Availability during U.S. client business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with:
    • Smartsheet
    • Microsoft Project
    • Jira
    • Confluence
    • SharePoint
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets capabilities, including:
    • Pivot Tables
    • Conditional Formatting
    • Tracking dashboards
  • Familiarity with:
    • Agile
    • Scrum
    • Sprint planning
    • Project lifecycle methodologies
  • PMP, CAPM, Agile, Scrum, or similar certification — completed or in progress.
  • Experience supporting projects within:
    • SaaS
    • Marketing
    • Professional Services
    • Construction
    • Operations-heavy businesses
  • Experience coordinating vendors or external contractors.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Are extremely organized and detail-oriented.
  • Naturally follow up without needing reminders.
  • Keep projects moving instead of simply documenting what happened.
  • Can manage multiple deadlines without losing visibility.
  • Communicate clearly with different stakeholders.
  • Identify potential delays before they become problems.
  • Maintain clean and reliable project documentation.
  • Understand the importance of ownership and accountability.
  • Stay calm when priorities shift.
  • Know when to solve an issue independently and when to escalate it.
  • Enjoy turning complex projects into structured, manageable workflows.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing project dashboards and upcoming deadlines.
  • Updating project plans and task trackers.
  • Following up with team members on outstanding deliverables.
  • Coordinating meetings across stakeholders.
  • Preparing agendas and project materials.
  • Taking meeting notes and documenting action items.
  • Updating project status reports.
  • Reviewing risks, dependencies, and blockers.
  • Escalating potential delays.

  • Maintaining organized project documentation.
  • Preparing leadership updates on project progress.

In short: you ensure projects remain organized, visible, accountable, and on track from kickoff through completion.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time completion of project tasks and milestones.
  • Accuracy and consistency of project trackers.
  • Timeliness of stakeholder follow-ups.
  • Reduction in missed deadlines caused by coordination gaps.
  • Early identification and escalation of project risks.
  • Accuracy and quality of project reporting.
  • Clean and accessible project documentation.
  • Completion rate of meeting action items.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction with communication and coordination.
  • Overall reliability of project execution.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership across multiple projects and operational workflows.
  • Direct exposure to leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Clear impact on project execution and delivery quality.
  • Hands-on experience with modern project management systems.
  • Opportunity to strengthen project management, operations, and stakeholder coordination skills.

Apply Now

We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer focused on high-throughput platform development to design, build, and operate the foundational platforms and shared services that other engineering teams rely on to deliver their products. This role focuses on building backend platform capabilities — request routing, traffic management, data fan-out, caching layers, asynchronous job execution, and durable event processing — that must handle very high traffic volumes with predictable latency and minimal operational toil.   • Design and operate caching, rate-limiting, and request-shaping layers that protect upstream systems and enable safe scaling under bursty workloads.
  • Develop platform abstractions, SDKs, and paved-road libraries that codify best practices and let product teams consume capabilities without re-implementing them.
  • Establish robust observability, SLOs, and capacity-planning practices for platform services, raising the operational bar across the organization.

  • Lead incident response for high-impact platform issues, conduct blameless post-mortems, and drive durable engineering improvements that prevent recurrence.
  • Define and enforce platform-wide standards around API design, schema evolution, deployment, and backward-compatibility guarantees.
  • Optimize platform performance through careful profiling, data-driven tuning, and algorithmic improvements that move the needle on throughput and cost.
